AI.motivation: 过渡金属硫族化合物具有可调带隙、光学各向异性和机械柔性，但NbSxSe2-x中化学计量比、结构相与电子输运之间的关系尚需阐明。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延生长低维NbSxSe2-x薄膜，并用原位X射线光电子能谱分析化学组成；测量电阻率及电阻温度系数（TCR）以判断金属性与半导体性行为。
AI.result: 随着硫含量增加，NbSe2基薄膜电阻率升高，并发生由金属性向半导体性行为的转变。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可通过硫/硒组分调节TMD薄膜的电学输运性质，为可调纳米电子器件应用提供依据。

title: First-Principles Investigation of the {ScSe2} TMDs Monolayer: Structural Stability, Electronic and Optical Properties
summary: We present an ab initio investigation of the {ScSe2} monolayer using density functional theory (DFT), as employed in the CP2K code, to assess its structural stability and electronic properties. The electronic behavior of both phases is governed by the local coordination environment of scandium and the associated lifting of degeneracy of its $3d$ orbitals. The valence bands (VBs) are dominated by {Se}$-4p$ states in both phases, while the states near the Fermi level distinguish the metallic 1T phase from the semiconducting 2H phase. Optical response calculations reveal markedly different spectral signatures for the two polymorphs. Two findings emerge from this study: a polymorphism-driven metal-to-semiconductor transition without any change in chemical composition and distinct optical responses relevant to phase-selective optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 利用DFT（CP2K）从头研究ScSe2单层的结构稳定性、电子性质与光学响应，发现1T相金属性与2H相半导体性源于Sc配位环境及其3d轨道简并解除，并伴随显著不同的光学谱。
AI.motivation: 探究同成分ScSe2单层不同相的结构稳定性与电子/光学性质差异，识别由多晶型驱动的金属—半导体转变及其在相选择性光电器件中的潜力。
AI.method: 采用基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理方法，使用CP2K程序计算ScSe2单层的结构稳定性、电子能带与态密度，并进行光学响应计算；通过Sc局域配位环境及3d轨道简并解除解释电子行为。
AI.result: 两种相的价带均主要由Se 4p态主导；费米能级附近态决定1T相金属性与2H相半导体性。光学响应计算显示两种多晶型具有明显不同的光谱特征。
AI.conclusion: ScSe2单层存在无需改变化学成分即可由多晶型驱动的金属—半导体转变，且两相光学响应差异显著，适用于相选择性光电器件。

title: A Covalent Bonding Network Using p-Block Elements to Stabilize Lithium-Rich Cathode Materials
summary: Li-rich battery cathodes (LixMyOz, where x > y) have sparked significant attention for their high energy densities, but their practical application is currently limited by structural instabilities associated with high-valent redox. Recent work has demonstrated reversible high-potential (de)lithiation with low voltage hysteresis in Li4FeSbO6 (LFSO), but the stabilization mechanism for this unique charging behavior is not fully understood, limiting our ability to apply insights from LFSO to more earth-abundant cathodes. In this paper, we present a covalent Sb-O bonding network in LFSO which is facilitated by the p-block orbital character of Sb. Using ab initio computational modeling, we identify this bonding state and indicate its contributions to crystal stability; we also identify a signature for this bonding network using theoretical and experimental element-specific X-ray spectroscopy. Substituting Sb with other p-block elements preserves this stabilizing bond, pointing to a family of new cathode chemistries beyond LFSO. This work establishes a design principle for development of sustainable energy-dense batteries: p-block elements like Sb possess specific orbital-mediated oxygen bonding which contributes to stability of high-valent layered oxide cathodes.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示Li4FeSbO6中由Sb的p区轨道特性形成的共价Sb-O键网络可稳定高电位氧化还原，并提出以p区元素调控氧键合来设计高比能锂富集正极的原则。
AI.motivation: 锂富集正极（LixMyOz, x>y）能量密度高，但高价氧化还原伴随结构失稳，限制实际应用；Li4FeSbO6虽具可逆高电位脱锂和低电压滞后，其稳定机制尚不明确，阻碍向更丰产正极推广。
AI.method: 采用从头算计算建模识别Sb-O共价键合状态及其对晶体稳定性的贡献，并结合理论计算与元素分辨X射线谱学确认该键合网络的光谱特征；通过用其他p区元素替代Sb检验稳定键的普适性。
AI.result: 发现Sb的p区轨道特征促成本征共价Sb-O键网络，该网络有助于晶体结构稳定；理论/实验X射线谱学给出该键合网络的特征信号；其他p区元素替代Sb可保留此类稳定键合，指向LFSO之外的新正极化学家族。
AI.conclusion: 确立一条设计原则：Sb等p区元素通过特定轨道介导的氧键合增强高价层状氧化物正极稳定性，可用于发展可持续、高能量密度电池。

title: Persistent Neutron Irradiation Effects and Partial Recovery in Thin-Film CdS/CdTe Solar Cells
summary: Thin-film CdTe solar cells are promising candidates for lightweight space power, but device-level studies of their response to neutron irradiation remain scarce. Here, we report the device performance of CdS/CdTe solar cells irradiated for 10 to 150 min in the thermal irradiator of a TRIGA reactor (90 kW), corresponding to nominal total neutron fluences of 3.3 x 10^14 to 5.0 x 10^15 n cm-2. The cells were characterized after 18 months of post-irradiation storage, once the residual activity has decayed to background levels. Co-irradiated FTO-coated glass reference substrates exhibit a wavelength-dependent transmission loss, with the transmittance at 500 nm decreasing from 80 % to 50 % after 60 min of irradiation. The irradiated cells retain rectifying behavior, but the reverse-bias dark current, photocurrent, and efficiency generally decrease with exposure time. Post-irradiation annealing at 70 {\deg}C under one-sun illumination initially improves Jsc and Voc, with the highest efficiency after 4 h. Prolonged annealing, however, causes substantial FF degradation despite continued photocurrent recovery. These trends suggest that irradiation-induced changes in the glass substrate, CdTe absorber, and contacts respond differently to annealing. Understanding underlying defect chemistry and correlating it with device behavior are necessary steps toward radiation-tolerant CdTe photovoltaics for space applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了CdS/CdTe薄膜太阳能电池在TRIGA反应堆热中子辐照后的器件性能及后续退火恢复行为。
AI.motivation: 薄膜CdTe太阳能电池有望用于轻量化空间电源，但其器件级中子辐照响应研究仍很缺乏，需要理解辐照缺陷与器件性能的关系。
AI.method: 将CdS/CdTe电池在90 kW TRIGA反应堆热辐照器中辐照10–150 min，对应名义总中子注量3.3×10^14–5.0×10^15 n cm^-2；辐照后储存18个月待残余放射性衰变至本底后表征，并对共辐照FTO玻璃参考衬底及70 °C、一倍太阳光照退火行为进行分析。
AI.result: FTO玻璃出现波长相关透射损失，60 min辐照后500 nm透射率由80%降至50%；电池仍保持整流特性，但反向暗电流、光电流和效率总体随辐照时间下降。70 °C光照退火初期改善Jsc和Voc，4 h效率最高；延长退火虽继续恢复光电流，却导致FF显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 辐照引起的玻璃衬底、CdTe吸收层和接触层变化对退火的响应不同；需理解缺陷化学并将其与器件行为关联，以发展耐辐照CdTe空间光伏。

title: Interstitial Magnetoelectricity in Altermagnetic Electrides
summary: Electrides and altermagnets are two distinct yet intriguing classes of quantum materials, characterized by interstitial anionic electrons and nonrelativistic spin splitting, respectively. The recent prediction of Stoner-instability-driven altermagnetic electride provides a natural bridge between these two fields. Here, we investigate the magnetoelectric response and its related spin-polarized transport in the altermagnetic electride Zr$_2$N monolayer. Using the tight-binding Hubbard model and first-principles calculations, we find that the electric field can break the magnetic compensation between the two interstitial anionic electrons, inducing a finite net magnetization and giving rise to an interstitial electron mediated magnetoelectric response. The magnetoelectric response is further demonstrated through the electrical control of spin conductivity. Our results reveal a magnetoelectric effect in altermagnetic electrides, paving a way towards electride-based spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 研究了交错磁电子化物 Zr$_2$N 单层的磁电响应及其自旋极化输运，发现电场可打破两个间隙阴离子电子间的磁补偿，诱导净磁化并由间隙电子介导磁电效应，实现自旋电导的电学调控。
AI.motivation: 电子化物与交错磁体是两类不同但重要的量子材料，分别以间隙阴离子电子和非相对论自旋劈裂为特征；近期预测的 Stoner 不稳定性驱动交错磁电子化物为二者提供了天然桥梁，因此值得探究其磁电响应与自旋输运。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚 Hubbard 模型并结合第一性原理计算，研究 Zr$_2$N 单层的磁电响应及自旋极化输运性质。
AI.result: 电场能够打破两个间隙阴离子电子之间的磁补偿，产生有限净磁化，形成由间隙电子介导的磁电响应；该响应进一步通过自旋电导的电学调控得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了交错磁电子化物中的磁电效应，为基于电子化物的自旋电子器件提供了新途径。

title: Ultrahigh Thermal Conductivity and Mirror-Parity Constraints in a Corrugated Two-Dimensional Oxide
summary: Contrary to the expectation of poor heat transport in oxides, first-principles calculations predict an ultrahigh lattice thermal conductivity of 756 $\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ at 300 K in corrugated two-dimensional B$_2$O$_2$. Acoustic phonons dominate heat transport, with the flexural acoustic (ZA) branch contributing 40.62$\%$. Triplet resolved analysis including acoustic and optical partners finds that mirror forbidden three phonon scattering is negligible within numerical precision for sampled ZA modes. These results highlight horizontal mirror symmetry as a constraint on phonon scattering in corrugated oxides.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算预测褶皱二维B$_2$O$_2$在300 K具有756 $\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$的超高晶格热导率，声学声子主导热输运。
AI.motivation: 氧化物通常被认为热输运较差，作者旨在探究褶皱二维氧化物中声子散射机制及对称性对晶格热导率的影响。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算晶格热导率，分析各声子支贡献，并进行包含声学与光学伙伴的三重态分辨三声子散射分析，考察镜面禁戒散射。
AI.result: 300 K晶格热导率达756 $\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$；声学声子主导热输运，其中弯曲声学（ZA）支贡献40.62\%；对所采样ZA模态，镜面禁戒三声子散射在数值精度内可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 水平镜面对称性对褶皱氧化物中的声子散射构成重要约束，可导致超高热导率。

title: Tritium speciation and transport in molten FLiBe: parameters, uncertainties and validation priorities
summary: Molten lithium fluoride-beryllium fluoride (FLiBe) is a candidate liquid breeder material for fusion applications, but predictive modelling of tritium retention, transport and extraction depends on chemical and interfacial assumptions that remain only partly resolved. Tritium produced in lithium-bearing fluoride salts may occur in oxidised or fluoride-associated states and can exchange into molecular hydrogen-isotope species such as HT. The relative populations and apparent transport behaviour depend on salt composition and condition, redox state, and interactions at gas-liquid and salt-wall boundaries. This review assesses the evidence for tritium speciation and transport in molten FLiBe, with emphasis on the solubility, effective diffusivity, permeability, exchange and boundary-transfer parameters required by continuum models. The available evidence motivates a two-pool continuum description with separate oxidised or fluoride-associated and molecular-hydrogen pools, without assigning a unique microscopic species. This description applies where states omitted from these pools do not materially affect tritium inventory or transport in the salt. We distinguish directly measured quantities from fitted or inferred effective parameters, recommend how source-specific transport data should be reported and compared, and identify the measurements required to constrain the remaining uncertainties in speciation, exchange, bulk transport and boundary transfer.

AI.tldr: 该综述评估熔融FLiBe中氚的化学形态与输运证据，提出用于连续介质模型的“双池”描述，并明确需补充的实验约束。
AI.motivation: FLiBe作为聚变液态增殖剂候选材料，其氚滞留、输运和提取的预测依赖尚未完全确定的化学与界面假设；氚可能以氧化态/氟相关态及HT等分子氢同位素形式存在，且受盐组成、氧化还原态和气液/盐壁边界影响。
AI.method: 综述溶解度和有效扩散率、渗透率、交换及边界传递等连续介质模型所需参数，区分直接测量量与拟合/推断的有效参数，并评估气液和盐壁边界相互作用及salt composition/redox条件对氚形态和表观输运的影响。
AI.result: 现有证据支持采用包含“氧化态或氟相关池”和“分子氢池”的双池连续介质描述，但不指定唯一微观物种；该描述适用于未纳入池中的状态对氚库存或盐中输运无实质影响的情形。
AI.conclusion: 需按来源明确报告和比较输运数据，区分实测与有效推断参数，并开展测量以约束形态、交换、体相输运和边界传递中的剩余不确定性。

title: Synthesis Method-dependent Resist-like Behavior of Liquid Crystalline Graphene Oxide Films Under Electron Beam Irradiation
summary: Here, the electron-beam-induced structural evolution and patterning behavior of chitosan-functionalized GO films, specifically those using chemically vs electrochemically exfoliated GO, are investigated. Experimental results (supported by DFT calculations) revealed that electron irradiation drives controllable microstructure formation in GO by selectively triggering ablation and densification pathways, which are dictated by the GOs synthesis route and initial oxidation state. Furthermore, a comprehensive characterization study was conducted to compare the optostructural properties of the present system prior and subsequent to electron-beam irradiation. Moreover, a systematic study of the films mechanical properties across both micro- and macroscopic scales was also performed to elucidate the underlying mechanisms responsible for the observed phenomena. The results demonstrate that the integration of mask-free electron-beam patterning, multiscale characterization, and DFT modeling establishes a previously unexplored synthesis-structure-irradiation relationship in GO films, providing fundamental insights into irradiation-induced microstructure evolution and opening new avenues for the design of GO-based micro- and nanostructured materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示壳聚糖功能化氧化石墨烯薄膜在电子束辐照下的结构演化与无掩模图案化机制，并建立GO合成路线、初始氧化态与辐照诱导微结构之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 探究不同GO合成路线（化学剥离 vs 电化学剥离）和初始氧化状态如何决定电子束诱导的结构演化与图案化行为，以建立GO薄膜的合成-结构-辐照关系。
AI.method: 对壳聚糖功能化GO薄膜进行电子束辐照与无掩模图案化，比较化学剥离和电化学剥离GO的行为；结合辐照前后光学/结构表征、微尺度与宏观尺度力学测试，并用DFT计算辅助解释机制。
AI.result: 电子辐照可通过选择性触发烧蚀和致密化路径实现可控微结构形成，具体路径由GO合成路线和初始氧化态决定；辐照前后光结构与多尺度力学性能发生可表征的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了此前未探索的GO薄膜合成-结构-辐照关系，提供辐照诱导微结构演化的基础认识，并为GO基微纳结构材料的设计开辟新途径。

title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
summary: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. DeepDOSReasoner achieves the highest prediction accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both eDOS and phDOS, recovers element-resolved contributions without supervision, and most reliably identifies rare valence-band (VB) gaps. In a prospective screen of 8,106 uncharted materials validated by new DFT calculations, its predictions remain the most accurate among the methods evaluated, with 25 of its top 50 candidates confirmed as VB-gap materials. Three case studies spanning substituted compounds, photovoltaic chalcogenides, and a high-entropy alloy demonstrate transfer across materials classes. Ablations confirm that both stages are necessary, while the model retains comparable accuracy when trained on only 25% of the data. Predicting spectra in milliseconds enables exhaustive screening; we release predictions filling the missing eDOS for 91,405 and phDOS for 127,768 Materials Project entries. DeepDOSReasoner provides a blueprint for integrating machine learning with physical reasoning toward high-throughput spectral screening and autonomous materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeepDOSReasoner，一种融合原子到能量源注意力与连续性方程传输的物理约束框架，可从晶体结构高精度预测电子与声子态密度，并用于大规模材料筛选。
AI.motivation: 材料的电子和声子态密度决定关键电子、光学、振动与热力学性质，但DFT计算昂贵，Materials Project中约60%条目缺少eDOS、超过80%缺少phDOS；现有晶体到谱图模型采用池化结构表示和逐点回归，易模糊谱特征并破坏总态守恒。
AI.method: DeepDOSReasoner通过原子到能量源的注意力机制解码谱图，并对归一化DOS进行学习式连续性方程传输优化，在构造上保证非负性和总态守恒；模型无需监督即可恢复元素分辨贡献。
AI.result: 在eDOS和phDOS的所有评估指标上取得最高预测精度，最可靠识别稀有价带带隙；对8,106个未表征材料的前瞻筛选经新DFT验证仍最准确，前50个候选中有25个确认为VB带隙材料；跨取代化合物、光伏硫族化合物和高熵合金的案例显示可迁移性；消融证实两阶段均必要，仅用25%数据训练仍保持相近精度；毫秒级预测可支撑穷举筛选，并发布补齐Materials Project中91,405个eDOS和127,768个phDOS条目的预测结果。
AI.conclusion: DeepDOSReasoner提供了将机器学习与物理推理结合用于高通量谱图筛选和自主材料发现的蓝图。

title: CLFF: Automated Framework for Concurrent Learning Force Fields and Material Property Calculations
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer an efficient paradigm for large-scale atomistic simulations with near first-principles accuracy. However, developing and deploying these potentials often involves intricate procedures that require substantial manual effort and domain expertise. In this work, we present CLFF, an open-source Python framework designed to automate concurrent learning workflows for MLIPs. CLFF integrates model training, MLIP-driven sampling, uncertainty-based candidate selection, quantum-mechanical labeling, and dataset augmentation into a unified workflow. The framework currently supports several modern graph-based MLIP architectures and is compatible with widely used computational chemistry and materials science tools. A distinguishing feature of CLFF is its ability to asynchronously distribute computational tasks across multiple heterogeneous remote computing resources, enabling users to aggregate fragmented hardware infrastructure within a single controllable workflow. In addition to concurrent learning, CLFF provides automated workflows for initial data generation and material property calculations, including phonon dispersion and potential energy surface scans. By minimizing manual intervention and enhancing reproducibility, CLFF offers a flexible platform for developing and deploying MLIPs in computational materials research.

AI.tldr: CLFF 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于自动化机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的并发学习工作流，并支持跨异构远程计算资源的异步任务分发。
AI.motivation: MLIP 能以接近第一性原理的精度进行大规模原子模拟，但其开发与部署流程复杂、依赖大量人工操作和领域专家经验；同时需要提高可复现性并整合碎片化硬件资源。
AI.method: CLFF 将模型训练、MLIP 驱动采样、基于不确定性的候选筛选、量子力学标注和数据集增强集成到统一工作流中；支持多种现代图神经网络 MLIP 架构，兼容常用计算化学与材料科学工具，并可异步分配任务到多个异构远程计算资源。除并发学习外，还提供初始数据生成及声子色散、势能面扫描等材料性质计算自动化工作流。
AI.result: 该框架实现了 MLIP 并发学习与相关计算流程的自动化，减少了人工干预，增强了可复现性，并能在单一可控工作流中聚合碎片化计算基础设施；摘要未给出定量性能结果。
AI.conclusion: CLFF 为计算材料研究中 MLIP 的开发与部署提供了一个灵活、可复现的自动化平台。

title: AgenticMM: A Material-Centered Multi-Agent Architecture for Scalable First-Principles Materials Modeling
summary: Multi-agent frameworks are attracting increasing attention as a means of autonomously driving complex, long-running workflows in first-principles materials modeling. However, such frameworks commonly organize AI agents by computational task or scientific role. When scaled across many materials, this organization can require repeated transfers of material-specific context and complicate persistent execution and resource coordination. Here, we introduce AgenticMM, a material-centered multi-agent architecture in which each material has a persistent agent that owns its complete workflow and retains its scientific context, while a persistent coordinator allocates shared resources, mediates communication, and tracks campaign progress. AgenticMM is designed to incorporate reusable, prompt-based skills as modular definitions of these workflows. Using DefectSkills prompts, we demonstrate the feasibility of AgenticMM through a multistage point-defect campaign in which material-specific agents concurrently perform host electronic-structure, phase-stability, and intrinsic-defect calculations for five chemically diverse semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 提出以材料为中心的多智能体架构 AgenticMM，用持久化材料智能体与持久化协调器支持可扩展的第一性原理材料建模工作流，并通过五种半导体的多阶段点缺陷计算验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有材料建模多智能体框架常按计算任务或科学角色组织，跨大量材料扩展时需反复传递材料特定上下文，并增加持久执行与资源共享协调的复杂度。
AI.method: AgenticMM 为每种材料分配一个持久化智能体，由其负责完整工作流并保留科学上下文；持久化协调器负责共享资源分配、通信中介和活动进度跟踪；框架支持以可复用、基于提示的技能模块化定义工作流，并使用 DefectSkills 提示开展多阶段点缺陷计算。
AI.result: 在包含五种化学性质不同半导体的点缺陷研究中，材料特定智能体并发执行宿主电子结构、相稳定性和本征缺陷计算，展示了 AgenticMM 的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 以材料为中心的持久化多智能体组织方式可减少材料上下文重复传递并改善资源协调，为跨多种材料的复杂第一性原理工作流提供可扩展框架。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Accurate Quasiparticle Energy Levels in Large Supercells of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
summary:
The GW method is the one of the main workhorses of the materials science community to accurately calculate the electronic bandgap of materials, as it overcomes the gap underestimation problem from Density Functional Theory (DFT). Despite its accuracy, its computational cost becomes prohibitive when calculations have more than 10-100 atoms, which makes more difficult its use for defects, surfaces and moir\'e systems that demand large supercells. To overcome this problem, we developed a Graph Neural Network trained with smaller GW calculations which can make accurate predictions on large supercells at a small fraction of the computational cost.
  Our model uses as features the projection of DFT wavefunctions into localized atomic orbitals, while graph nodes represent the atomic positions and edges represent atom to atom distances, which captures the system geometry. We explore how to do "small AI", providing a workflow of how to create a personal and convenient dataset of GW calculations to train the model that can be applied to different materials so that the final user does not need to rely on massive datasets. We define what must be included in the training dataset to capture the physics of our objective simulation, and perform a Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters. In the case of monolayer MoS$_2$ with a sulfur vacancy our GNN models achieve high accuracy (MAE ranging 10 to 50 meV) with a simplified workflow applicable to other materials, accelerating accurate large electronic structure calculations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种用小型GW计算训练图神经网络的方法，以低得多的成本对大型超胞进行高精度GW能带预测。
AI.motivation: GW方法能克服DFT带隙低估，但计算成本随体系增大（超过10–100个原子）变得不可承受，限制其在缺陷、表面和莫尔体系等需大超胞问题中的应用。
AI.method: 模型以DFT波函数在局域原子轨道上的投影为特征，图节点表示原子位置、边表示原子间距离以刻画几何；作者给出构建个人化GW训练集的“小AI”流程，明确训练集需包含的物理信息，并进行贝叶斯超参数优化。
AI.result: 在含硫空位的单层MoS2上，GNN模型取得高精度，MAE约为10–50 meV。
AI.conclusion: 该简化工作流可推广到其他材料，加速准确的大体系电子结构计算。

title: Collineations of particles as a tool to study nucleation and crystallization processes in liquids
summary: We suggest several methods that can be used for identification of crystal nuclei in the studies of the nucleation and crystallization processes in multicomponent systems and in situations when the forming crystalline phase is different from the FCC, HCP or BCC lattices. We suggest several methods that can be used for identification of crystal nuclei in the studies of the nucleation and crystallization processes in multicomponent systems and in situations when the forming crystalline phase is different from the FCC, HCP or BCC lattices. The approaches are based on consideration of collineations of particles. They allow finding nuclei and separating them from each other. We demonstrate the methods by considering two systems. For a single-component system, we perform a comparison between the results derived from the collineations and those obtained using the coarse-grained bond-orientational order parameters. Further, we illustrate the methods by considering the crystallization process in a Wahnstr\"{o}m binary $BA_2$ system forming a rather complex crystal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出基于粒子共线关系识别晶核的方法，适用于多组分体系及非FCC/HCP/BCC复杂晶相，并在单组分与Wahnström二元BA2结晶体系中演示。
AI.motivation: 现有晶核识别方法多依赖FCC/HCP/BCC等简单晶格，难以处理多组分体系或形成复杂晶相时的晶核识别与分离。
AI.method: 利用粒子间的共线关系（collineations）识别晶核并将其彼此分离；在单组分体系中与粗粒化键取向序参量（coarse-grained bond-orientational order parameters）结果比较，并在Wahnström二元BA2体系的结晶过程中应用。
AI.result: 方法能够找到晶核并区分不同晶核；单组分体系中共线关系结果与粗粒化键取向序参量结果进行了对比，并在形成复杂晶体结构的Wahnström二元BA2结晶过程中得到演示。
AI.conclusion: 基于粒子共线关系的晶核识别方法可拓展晶核检测至多组分和非FCC/HCP/BCC复杂晶相体系，为成核与结晶研究提供有效工具。

title: Fully solid-state all-2D micro-supercapacitors for on-chip energy storage
summary: Integrating energy storage directly into microelectronic platforms remains a major challenge. Although solid-state micro-supercapacitors (MSCs) have been previously demonstrated, most still rely on liquid or solvent-containing gel electrolytes, which require additional encapsulation and complicate device integration. Here, we demonstrate wafer-scale fabrication of all-2D, fully solid-state MSCs by combining conductive Ti3C2Tz MXene electrodes with a natural vermiculite (VMT) clay solid electrolyte. Both materials are solution-processable and can be independently patterned using microelectronics compatible fabrication techniques, allowing for their integration across 4-inch Si/SiO2 wafers. The resulting devices showcase an active stack of only 28 nm thick, with an areal capacitance of 205 uF/cm2 and volumetric energy density of ~15.5 mWh/cm3. Notably, this work introduces a patterned 2D clay as a solid electrolyte in an on-chip electrochemical energy-storage device, extending the role of layered materials beyond electrodes to ion-conducting components. To investigate device behavior and degradation, we employ non-destructive imaging ellipsometry to map individual layer thicknesses and extract the spatial distribution of MXene conductivity across the chip. This approach reveals localized changes in electrode properties following prolonged electrochemical cycling, providing insight into degradation processes that are difficult to capture using conventional spatially averaged measurements. Together, these results establish a route towards fully solid-state, all-2D energy-storage devices and highlight the potential of solution-processable layered materials for integration into microelectronic systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作在全4英寸Si/SiO2晶圆上制备了全二维、全固态微型超级电容器，采用Ti3C2Tz MXene电极与天然蛭石黏土固态电解质，并利用成像椭偏术研究器件退化。
AI.motivation: 将储能器件直接集成到微电子平台仍具挑战；现有固态微型超级电容器多依赖液体或含溶剂凝胶电解质，需额外封装并增加集成复杂度。
AI.method: 以溶液加工的Ti3C2Tz MXene作为电极、天然蛭石黏土作为固态电解质，通过微电子兼容工艺分别图案化并在4英寸Si/SiO2晶圆上集成；测试面积电容和体积能量密度，并用非破坏性成像椭偏术映射各层厚度及MXene电导率的空间分布，分析长时电化学循环后的局部退化。
AI.result: 器件活性堆叠仅28 nm厚，面积电容达205 μF/cm²，体积能量密度约15.5 mWh/cm³；实现了晶圆级全固态全二维微型超级电容器，并首次将图案化二维黏土作为片上电化学储能器件的固态电解质；成像椭偏术揭示循环后电极性质的局部变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为全固态、全二维储能器件提供了可晶圆级集成的路线，并展示了溶液可加工层状材料在微电子系统中作为离子导电器件的潜力。

title: Engineering strategies for high-performance self-powered zinc oxide (ZnO) ultraviolet photodetectors: a design-oriented review
summary: Self-powered ultraviolet (UV) photodetectors generate a signal at zero applied bias, removing standby power and suppressing dark current, suiting battery-free Internet-of-Things sensing. Zinc oxide (ZnO) is the archetypal absorber for this task: UV-selective, earth-abundant, non-toxic, and processable at low temperature from solution. Operating it without bias, however, requires a built-in asymmetry that pristine ZnO rarely provides. Because the literature is organized by material or mechanism, the design logic remains obscured. Here we organize the field by engineering strategy, identifying five families of levers (junction and built-in-field engineering, doping and defect control, polarization coupling, interface/surface and photoelectrochemical engineering, and architecture and light management) and mapping each onto the metrics it serves and the trade-offs it imposes. A unifying lens is the zero-bias doping paradox: raising carrier density narrows the depletion region that zero-bias collection needs, so the self-powered optimum differs from the biased one. We flag the detectivity, speed, and active-area pitfalls that make zero-bias performance easy to overstate, and condense the synthesis into a decision tree linking target metric to strategy and growth route. The remaining bottlenecks (persistent photoconductivity, p-type ZnO, and reporting consistency) are problems of defect control and rigorous measurement, not of new materials.

AI.tldr: 该文以工程策略为主线综述ZnO自供电紫外光电探测器，提出零偏压掺杂悖论，并给出从目标指标到策略与生长路线的决策树。
AI.motivation: 自供电UV探测器需零偏压下产生信号以消除待机功耗并抑制暗电流，ZnO具备UV选择性、储量丰富、无毒、低温溶液加工等优势，但原始ZnO缺乏零偏压工作所需的内建不对称性；现有文献按材料或机制组织，掩盖了设计逻辑。
AI.method: 按工程策略重组领域，归纳五类调控手段：结与内建电场工程、掺杂与缺陷控制、极化耦合、界面/表面与光电化学工程、架构与光管理；将每类手段映射到其服务的指标及权衡，并以零偏压掺杂悖论为统一视角，指出易高估零偏压性能的探测率、速度和有效面积陷阱，最终凝练为连接目标指标、策略和生长路线的决策树。
AI.result: 识别出五类策略及其指标—权衡关系；阐明载流子密度升高会窄化零偏压收集所需耗尽区的零偏压掺杂悖论，说明自供电最优与加偏压最优不同；总结零偏压性能易被夸大的指标陷阱，并形成可操作的决策树。
AI.conclusion: 剩余瓶颈主要是持续光电导、p型ZnO和报道一致性，属于缺陷控制与严格测量问题，而非依赖新材料。

title: Ballistic propagation-mediated super-resolution light-element imaging: in-situ tracking dynamic hydrogen migration
summary: Transmission electrons - with few-picometer wavelengths - can theoretically resolve all atoms in solids. However, constrained by factors such as lens aberrations, Z-contrast dependence and poor temporal resolution, the scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) fails to tackle the long-standing challenge of hydrogen dynamics on atomic scale. Here, our experiment-guided simulations reveal that unlike heavy-atom imaging - governed by wave-based imaging process - ballistic propagation of particle-like electrons in Cs-corrected TEM enables super-resolution imaging (SRI) of light atoms, achieving a resolution down to 14 pm and a robust hydrogen contrast of ~24%. Our in-situ SRI study not only uncovers polymetric hydrogen aggregation in TiHx and H-LaAlO3, but also inter-site migration, rotational displacement of hydrogen species and collective hydrogen tunneling-induced polarization surge in the oxide. By exploiting the novel electron-matter interactions, our findings offer an unparalleled approach to probe hydrogen dynamics and establish accurate structure-property relationships in diverse functional materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，在Cs校正TEM中利用类粒子电子的弹道传播可实现轻原子超分辨成像，分辨率达14 pm、氢对比度约24%，并用于原位观测多种氢动力学过程。
AI.motivation: STEM受透镜像差、Z衬度依赖和时间分辨率差等因素限制，难以在原子尺度解析氢的动态行为，这是长期难题。
AI.method: 结合实验引导的模拟，对比重原子波基成像与轻原子弹道类粒子电子传播机制，并在Cs校正TEM中开展原位超分辨成像（SRI）。
AI.result: 实现低至14 pm分辨率和约24%的稳健氢对比度；在TiHx和H-LaAlO3中揭示聚合状氢聚集、位点间迁移、氢物种旋转位移，以及氧化物中集体氢隧穿诱导的极化激增。
AI.conclusion: 利用新型电子-物质相互作用，该工作提供了探测氢动力学和建立功能材料精确结构-性质关系的强有力方法。

title: MagPot: A magnetoelastic potential generator for molecular dynamics simulations
summary: Magnetoelastic phenomena originate from the coupling between atomic displacements and magnetic degrees of freedom, and their atomistic simulation requires interatomic models in which magnetic interactions depend explicitly on interatomic distance. This paper presents MagPot, a Python program that generates Bethe-Slater parameter sets for spin-lattice molecular dynamics simulations using the SPIN package of the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS). From a compact set of material properties, the program determines the radial functions describing Heisenberg exchange and the dipole and quadrupole contributions of the two-ion N\'eel interaction. Version 1.0 supports simple-cubic, body-centred-cubic and face-centred-cubic lattices with ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic configurations. A central feature of MagPot is its modular architecture, which allows the magnetic contribution it generates to be combined additively with a broad range of compatible non-magnetic interatomic potentials. The parameterisation workflow is assessed through equation-of-state, Curie-temperature, volume-magnetostriction, pressure-dependent magnetocrystalline-anisotropy and anisotropic-magnetoelastic tests. By automating the construction of the magnetic contribution to the interatomic model, MagPot offers a straightforward and reproducible route from material properties to LAMMPS-ready magnetic interactions, facilitating large-scale atomistic simulations of magnetoelasticity and magnetostriction, as well as physical phenomena associated with magnon-phonon coupling.

AI.tldr: MagPot 是一个 Python 程序，可根据少量材料性质自动生成 Bethe-Slater 参数集，为 LAMMPS SPIN 包提供自旋-晶格分子动力学所需的磁相互作用模型。
AI.motivation: 磁弹性源于原子位移与磁自由度的耦合，其原子尺度模拟需要磁相互作用显式依赖于原子间距的原子间模型，而此类模型的参数化通常繁琐且不易复现。
AI.method: MagPot 从紧凑的材料性质集合出发，确定描述 Heisenberg 交换以及双离子 Néel 相互作用中偶极和四极贡献的径向函数；1.0 版支持简单立方、体心立方和面心立方晶格及铁磁/反铁磁构型，并采用模块化架构，使生成的磁贡献可与多种兼容的非磁原子间势加和组合。
AI.result: 作者通过状态方程、Curie 温度、体积磁致伸缩、压力相关磁晶各向异性及各向异性磁弹性等测试评估了参数化流程，表明该工作流可从材料性质生成可用于 LAMMPS 的磁相互作用。
AI.conclusion: MagPot 自动化构建原子间模型中的磁贡献，为磁弹性和磁致伸缩的大尺度原子模拟以及磁子-声子耦合相关现象提供了一条直接且可复现的途径。

title: Giant magnetic anisotropy in layered polar metal Sr$_3$Co$_2$O$_7$ from Charge-disproportionation orbital unquenching
summary: Crystal-field quenching usually suppresses orbital angular momentum and limits magnetic anisotropy in transition-metal oxides. Here we identify charge disproportionation as a route to giant magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the layered polar metal Sr$_3$Co$_2$O$_7$. First-principles calculations reveal an energy preference of 234.0 meV per cell for in-plane [110] magnetization over [001]. Charge disproportionation and the associated polar displacement reconstruct the local cobalt crystal fields, creating inequivalent sites with distinct orbital hierarchies. This reconstruction enables a strongly directional orbital response, particularly at the displaced cobalt site, where orbital angular momentum is recovered for in-plane magnetization. Spin--orbit coupling converts this response into a large magnetic anisotropic energy. In the centrosymmetric reference, the orbital moments remain nearly quenched and the anisotropy is strongly reduced. A local Green-function and orbital-moment analysis connects the large energy scale to orbital unquenching, while the conventional second-order contribution is small within the adopted approximation. These results identify charge-disproportionation-driven orbital reconstruction as a design principle for large anisotropy and motivate layered perovskites and magnetic polar metals as platforms in the search for rare-earth-free permanent magnets.

AI.tldr: 在层状极性金属Sr3Co2O7中，电荷歧化与极性位移重构Co局域晶场并恢复轨道角动量，从而产生巨大磁晶各向异性，为无稀土永磁材料提供设计原则。
AI.motivation: 传统晶体场淬灭会抑制过渡金属氧化物中的轨道角动量，限制磁各向异性；作者寻找能突破该限制的新机制。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，并结合局域格林函数与轨道矩分析，比较极性Sr3Co2O7与中心对称参考结构中的轨道响应和磁各向异性能。
AI.result: 计算显示面内[110]磁化比[001]每原胞低234.0 meV；电荷歧化及伴随极性位移产生不等价Co位点和不同轨道层级，使位移Co位点在内面磁化时恢复轨道角动量，并经自旋-轨道耦合转化为大磁各向异性能；中心对称参考中轨道矩近淬灭、各向异性显著降低，传统二阶贡献在该近似下较小。
AI.conclusion: 电荷歧化驱动的轨道重构是获得大磁各向异性的设计原则，层状钙钛矿和磁性极性金属可作为探索无稀土永磁材料的平台。

title: Inferring Experimental Objectives in Microscopy Experiments from Decision Traces
summary: Modern microscopes can acquire, analyze and act on data far faster than human operators can decide what to measure next. Exploiting this speed in automated experiments requires the instrument to follow the scientific logic of the operator, and one way to encode that logic is through reward functions that become part of the operation process. Here we explore whether such reward functions can be learned from the decision histories of microscope operators. We propose multiple frameworks in which recorded choices among alternative measurement locations serve as comparative evidence about the operator's preferences, and we compare several algorithms for reconstructing the reward including interpretable linear models built on physically meaningful image descriptors, nonlinear functions of the same descriptors, an unsupervised image representation followed by preference modeling, and a preference trained deep kernel inspired model. The result of this analysis is a spatial field of reward functions over the sample that can be used to run the instrument. We also propose a way to benchmark these approaches, based on withheld decisions and on decision histories generated with known objectives. We then examine the possibility that a decision history contains changing priorities throughout the experiment. A hidden Markov model assigns distinct rewards to recurring selection strategies, whereas a continuous-state model tracks smoothly varying preference weights. Controlled sequences generated over real microscopy candidate sets show that both concealed switches and gradual drift can be recovered. These reward functions, learned directly from recorded decisions, provide candidate objectives for future automated microscopy experiments.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究如何从显微镜操作员的历史选择中学习奖励函数，并处理实验过程中偏好切换或渐变漂移的问题，从而为自动化显微实验提供可执行的目标。
AI.motivation: 现代显微镜的采集、分析和执行速度快于人决定下一步测什么；要让自动化实验遵循操作员的科学逻辑，可将该逻辑编码为运行过程中的奖励函数，因此需要探索能否从操作员决策历史中学习这种奖励。
AI.method: 作者将操作员在候选测量位置之间的选择视为关于其偏好的比较证据，提出多种奖励重构框架并比较算法：基于物理意义图像描述子的可解释线性模型、同类描述子的非线性模型、无监督图像表示加偏好建模、以及偏好训练的深度核启发模型；同时提出基于留出决策和已知目标生成决策历史的基准，并用隐马尔可夫模型区分反复出现的策略奖励、用连续状态模型跟踪平滑变化的偏好权重。
AI.result: 分析可得到样本上的空间奖励场并用于驱动仪器；在真实显微候选集上生成的控制序列表明，隐藏的策略切换和逐渐漂移均可被恢复。
AI.conclusion: 直接从记录决策中学习的奖励函数可作为未来自动化显微实验的候选目标。

title: Unveiling the Complex high-pressure phases of Sodium at the Melting Curve Minimum via Data-Drive Crystal Structure Prediction
summary: Sodium exhibits a remarkable concentration of complex crystalline phases near its melting-curve minimum, yet the atomic arrangements of several experimentally observed phases remain unresolved. Here, we combine CALYPSO crystal structure prediction with Deep Potential models developed through concurrent learning to explore this structural landscape. Searches over more than 1.6 million configurations recover the previously reported $I4/m$ structure of $tI50$ and identify candidate atomic arrangements for $oC120$ and $aP90$, together with three additional low-enthalpy structures, $tI52$, $oP72$, and $oP92$. The proposed candidates reproduce key features of the experimentally indexed cell geometries. First-principles enthalpy calculations, Gibbs free-energy comparisons, and solid--liquid coexistence simulations reveal close competition among these structures and established sodium phases. Near the calculated reference melting minimum, $tI50$ is favored over $cI16$ and $oP8$, whereas $oC120$ and $aP90$ remain closely competitive, with their relative stability sensitive to model accuracy. These results provide testable structural models for unresolved experimental phases and reveal multiple closely competing low-enthalpy configurations near sodium's melting minimum

AI.tldr: 结合CALYPSO晶体结构预测与并发学习训练的Deep Potential模型，系统搜索钠在熔点极小值附近的多晶相结构，为未解析实验相提出候选原子构型并评估其热力学竞争关系。
AI.motivation: 钠在熔点曲线极小值附近存在异常丰富的复杂晶相，但多个实验观测相的原子排布尚未确定，需要可靠的结构模型与热力学稳定性分析。
AI.method: 采用CALYPSO进行晶体结构预测，并通过并发学习构建Deep Potential模型，搜索超过160万个构型；随后用第一性原理焓计算、Gibbs自由能比较和固-液共存模拟评估候选结构与已知钠相的相对稳定性。
AI.result: 搜索复现了tI50的I4/m结构，并为oC120和aP90提出候选原子排布，同时发现tI52、oP72和oP92三个低焓结构；候选结构可再现实验指标化晶胞几何的关键特征。近计算参考熔点极小值时，tI50比cI16和oP8更有利，而oC120和aP90仍具强竞争性，其相对稳定性对模型精度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未解析的实验相提供了可检验的结构模型，并揭示钠熔点极小值附近存在多个能量接近、相互竞争的低温焓构型。

title: Pyroelectric Harvesting from Steady Heat Sources via Active Piezoelectric Thermal Switching
summary: This study demonstrates pyroelectric energy harvesting from a steady heat source using active piezoelectric thermal switching in a PZT/Si bimorph cantilever. The same PZT layer serves as both the mechanical actuator and the pyroelectric energy-conversion element. Dual output electrodes enable separation of the pyroelectric and piezoelectric signals. Pyroelectric energy harvesting is experimentally demonstrated at frequencies up to 110 Hz and temperature differences as small as 5 K. Comparison with the response predicted from the independently measured pyroelectric coefficient, together with transient thermal simulations, identifies dynamic interfacial heat transfer as a key limitation to high-frequency operation. This work demonstrates a compact MEMS approach for higher-frequency pyroelectric energy harvesting from low-grade steady heat sources.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用PZT/Si双压电晶片悬臂梁中的主动压电热开关，实现由稳定热源驱动的热释电能量收集，并验证了高频、小温差下的可行性。
AI.motivation: 低品位稳定热源的热释电收集通常受限于低频和温差需求，需要一种紧凑、可实现更高频工作的MEMS方案。
AI.method: 在PZT/Si双压电晶片悬臂梁中，同一PZT层同时作为机械致动器和热释电能量转换元件；采用主动压电热切换，并通过双输出电极分离热释电与压电信号。
AI.result: 实验在最高110 Hz频率和低至5 K温差下实现热释电能量收集；与独立测得的热释电系数预测响应及瞬态热仿真对比，表明动态界面传热是高频工作的关键限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一种面向低品位稳定热源、可高频工作的紧凑MEMS热释电能量收集方法。

title: Nonmonotonic In-Plane Thermal Transport in Metal-Embedded Graphitic Carbon Nitride
summary: Embedding metal atoms within the intrinsic cavities of graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) modifies its local bonding and vibrational properties, yet its consequences for lattice thermal transport remain poorly understood. Here, we combine a machine-learned potential (MLP) with homogeneous nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (HNEMD) to investigate in-plane thermal transport in Cu-embedded g-C3N4 across the full range of cavity occupation. The thermal conductivity exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence on Cu occupation, decreasing at intermediate occupation and partially recovering as the cavities approach full occupation. Frequency-resolved analysis reveals that this behavior originates from the competition between two phonon contributions. The low-frequency vibrations introduced by Cu couple to the intrinsic modes of g-C3N4, reconstructing the phonon dispersion and suppressing thermal transport below 10 THz. With increasing Cu occupation, the collective mechanical response of the N atoms surrounding the cavities is enhanced, accompanied by increased phonon group velocities in the 20-30 THz range and a corresponding recovery of the high-frequency thermal contribution. The competition between the saturating low-frequency suppression and the increasing high-frequency contribution gives rise to the nonmonotonic thermal conductivity. A similar occupation dependence and spectral redistribution are observed for Ag-embedded g-C3N4. These results identify competing phonon contributions as the microscopic origin of nonmonotonic thermal transport in metal-embedded g-C3N4 and suggest that occupation of intrinsic cavities provides a route to redistributing phonon transport in porous crystalline materials.

AI.tldr: 结合机器学习势与HNEMD，研究了Cu嵌入g-C3N4本征空腔对面向热输运的影响，发现热导率随Cu占据率呈非单调变化，源于低频声子抑制与高频声子贡献恢复的竞争。
AI.motivation: 金属原子嵌入g-C3N4空腔会改变局域成键与振动性质，但其对晶格热输运的影响尚不清楚，尤其缺乏覆盖全部空腔占据率的微观认识。
AI.method: 采用机器学习势（MLP）结合均匀非平衡分子动力学（HNEMD），计算Cu嵌入g-C3N4的面向热导率，并进行频率分辨声子分析与Ag嵌入对照。
AI.result: 热导率随Cu占据率非单调变化：中间占据率下降低，接近满占据时部分恢复。Cu引入的低频振动与g-C3N4本征模式耦合，重构声子色散并抑制10 THz以下热输运；随占据率增加，空腔周围N原子集体力学响应增强，20–30 THz声子群速度提高，高频热贡献恢复。Ag嵌入g-C3N4表现类似占据依赖与谱重分布。
AI.conclusion: 金属嵌入g-C3N4的非单调热输运由低频抑制饱和与高频贡献增强的竞争主导；占据本征空腔可调控多孔晶体材料中的声子输运谱重分布。

title: NEP-Spin: A spin-dependent neuroevolution potential for large-scale spin--lattice simulations
summary: NEP-Spin is a \glsentrylong{nep} for coupled atomic motion and variable-length magnetic moments. Local bond and spin tensors give an energy invariant under independent spin and spatial rotations without \glsentrylong{soc} and under joint rotations with it. We benchmark energies, atomic forces, and magnetic forces on public datasets for collinear Fe--Al and noncollinear Fe. In multiferroic \glsentrylong{bfo}, the predicted zero-field cycloid period is 69.7~nm, compared with 62--63~nm from neutron scattering. An electric field of 20~mV/\AA{} opposite to the polarization lengthens the period to 93.2~nm, while imposing the same polar displacement at zero field gives 85.1~nm. In a uniform antiferromagnetic cell at fixed lattice vectors, 6~T magnetic fields along orthogonal basal axes reorient the Fe moments and give opposite signs of the ionic polarization change $\Delta P_y$. First-principles ionic relaxations at the predicted moment vectors reproduce both signs. In a 2.79-million-atom ferroelectric twin, the cycloid rotation planes tilt by different amounts from their shared initial plane and remain distinct over 10~ps at 100~K. At 10~ps the propagation axes lie within about $7^\circ$ of their initial directions. With inertial spin dynamics, GPUMD advances a 5.93-million-atom BiFeO$_3$ cell at 21.8 million atom-steps per second on four RTX 4090 GPUs.

AI.tldr: NEP-Spin 是一种耦合原子运动与可变长度磁矩的机器学习势，具备自旋/空间旋转不变性，并在 BiFeO3 中复现和预测了磁电耦合、螺旋自旋序及大规模自旋动力学。
AI.motivation: 需要一种同时描述原子位移与磁矩（含非共线、可变模长）的势函数，在无/有自旋轨道耦合时分别满足自旋与空间独立/联合旋转不变性，并能支撑大规模磁电材料模拟。
AI.method: 构建基于局域键张量和自旋张量的 NEP-Spin 能量模型；在 Fe-Al 共线磁性与 Fe 非共线磁性公开数据上基准测试能量、原子力和磁力；对多铁 BiFeO3 进行零场/电场螺旋周期、磁场诱导极化翻转、铁电孪晶螺旋面演化及惯性自旋动力学 GPUMD 大规模模拟。
AI.result: Fe-Al 与 Fe 基准测试验证能量、原子力、磁力；BiFeO3 零场螺旋周期预测 69.7 nm（中子散射 62–63 nm），反向 20 mV/Å 电场使周期增至 93.2 nm，零场同极性位移为 85.1 nm；固定晶格的反铁磁胞中 6 T 正交基面磁场使 Fe 磁矩重取向并产生相反符号的 ΔP_y，第一性原理离子弛豫复现；279 万原子铁电孪晶中螺旋旋转面在 100 K、10 ps 内保持可区分，传播轴偏离初始方向约 7°；GPUMD 在 4 块 RTX 4090 上对 593 万原子 BiFeO3 达到 2180 万 atom-steps/s。
AI.conclusion: NEP-Spin 能准确且高效地耦合原子与自旋自由度，捕捉 BiFeO3 的磁电耦合和螺旋自旋动力学，并支持千万原子级 GPU 加速自旋动力学模拟。

title: Indentation-induced polar domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe4
summary: Controlling polar domains in conducting materials by external fields could unlock polarization-based electronic functionalities, yet remains experimentally challenging. While mechanical actuation driven by local strain, stress, or strain gradients has been proposed as an external-voltage-free route, its experimental demonstration in relatively conducting polar materials remains limited. Here we demonstrate mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave (CDW) semiconductor EuTe4 at room temperature, whose resistivity is on the order of 10 m$\Omega$cm. Polarized-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements reveal CDW-induced in-plane polarization domains with an approximately 90 $^\circ$ domain configuration. Local indentation with a $\sim$1 $\mu$m-apex-radius needle reconfigures these domains, producing write/erase-like changes in wedge-shaped regions. These results establish local mechanical-field domain engineering in a relatively conducting CDW semiconductor, with possible contributions from both ferroelastic-like and flexoelectric mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 在室温、较高电导的电荷密度波半导体EuTe4中，利用局域机械压痕实现极化畴的可逆重构，展示了无需外电压的机械畴工程。
AI.motivation: 外场调控导电材料中的极化畴有望实现基于极化的电子功能，但实验困难；机械驱动虽被提出为无外电压途径，却在相对导电的极性材料中缺乏实验演示。
AI.method: 以EuTe4（室温电阻率约10 mΩcm）为对象，结合偏振光显微镜与二次谐波产生测量识别CDW诱导的面内极化畴及约90°畴构型，并用针尖半径约1 μm的局域压痕进行畴重构。
AI.result: 局域压痕可在楔形区域内写入/擦除式地重构极化畴；结果表明CDW诱导的面内极化畴可被局部机械场调控。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在相对导电的CDW半导体中建立了局域机械场畴工程，机制可能同时涉及类铁弹与挠曲电效应。

title: Generation and non-thermal annealing of dislocations and atomic-scale roughness by nonlinear surface acoustic waves
summary: Surface acoustic waves (SAWs) are widely used to probe near-surface material properties and microstructure, but their potential to drive permanent structural modification remains largely unexplored. Large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal the mechanisms of defect generation and evolution induced by nonlinear Rayleigh waves in Pt. Strong crystallographic dependence of the nonlinear evolution is observed. SAWs on Pt(111) undergo rapid nonlinear sharpening and shock formation, with localized elastic energy and increasing near-surface stresses, whereas much weaker sharpening on Pt(001) allows dissipation to compete effectively with shock formation. For sufficiently strong SAWs on Pt(111), Shockley partial dislocations are emitted from the surface when the resolved shear stress approaches the theoretical shear strength. The highly localized and rapidly changing stress field at the shock front activates multiple slip systems and promotes crossslip and reactions between Shockley partials, producing complex dislocation structures with sessile stair-rod segments. Subsequent SAW interactions activate dislocation sources on slip systems where the stress is insufficient for homogeneous nucleation, leading, in one case, to sequential emission of Shockley partials and formation of a subsurface twinned domain. Repeated SAW passages progressively reduce dislocation density, demonstrating SAW-driven nonthermal annealing. Dislocation interactions with the free surface generate atomic-scale steps, terraces, and other under-coordinated configurations, providing a microscopic pathway for permanent surface modification that may contribute to the acoustically enhanced catalytic activity observed on Pt surfaces. These results establish nonlinear SAWs as drivers of nonthermal defect generation, restructuring, and annealing, opening opportunities for acoustic processing of near-surface microstructure.

AI.tldr: 大规模分子动力学模拟揭示，非线性瑞利表面声波可在Pt中驱动非热缺陷生成、位错结构演化、表面改性与退火，并表现出显著晶向依赖性。
AI.motivation: 表面声波（SAWs）常用于探测近表面材料性质与微结构，但其驱动永久结构改性的潜力尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 采用大规模分子动力学模拟，研究Pt中非线性瑞利波诱导缺陷产生与演化的机制，并比较Pt(111)与Pt(001)的晶向差异。
AI.result: Pt(111)上SAW快速非线性陡化并形成激波，局部弹性能与近表面应力升高；Pt(001)陡化较弱，耗散可与激波形成竞争。强SAW下，当分切应力接近理论剪切强度时表面发射Shockley不全位错；激波前沿高度局域且快速变化的应力场激活多滑移系，促进交滑移和Shockley不全位错反应，形成含 sessile stair-rod 段的复杂位错结构。后续SAW可激活应力不足以均匀形核的滑移系位错源，甚至导致Shockley不全位错顺序发射和亚表面孪晶畴形成。重复SAW通过降低位错密度实现非热退火；位错与自由表面相互作用产生原子级台阶、平台及欠配位构型，为永久表面改性提供微观路径，并可能贡献于Pt表面声学增强催化活性。
AI.conclusion: 非线性SAWs可作为非热缺陷生成、重构与退火的驱动因素，为近表面微结构的声学处理提供新机会。

title: Atomistic insight into defect-mediated boron redistribution and high-temperature strengthening in TiAl alloys
summary: Boron (B) microalloying can effectively refine microstructures of as-cast TiAl alloys and regulate their mechanical properties. Yet, how dilute B exists in TiAl and interacts with defects and how these interactions govern high-temperature deformation remain elusive. Here, we systematically elucidate defect-mediated B redistribution in TiAl alloys and its consequences for their deformation using hybrid grand-canonical Monte Carlo/molecular dynamics simulations augmented with a newly developed high-fidelity machine-learning potential. As a typical product of B microalloying, borides are markedly stiffer than the TiAl matrix and act as brittle reinforcing phases, while borides/matrix interfacial adhesion depends on surface termination and stacking sequence. In the bulk, interstitial B tends to be trapped at Ti-rich octahedral sites by high migration barriers but can kinetically evolve into substitutional dopants upon approaching Al vacancies. Increased tensile stress and vacancy concentration further promote B enrichment in the bulk. B is enriched at semi-coherent $\gamma/\alpha_2$ boundaries and preferentially partitions into the $\alpha_2$ phase. In polycrystalline TiAl, B accumulates primarily in disordered regions, raising the average flow stress by 9.4% at 1 at.% B and 900 K. This strengthening is accompanied by reduced shear strain accumulation. Simulated microstructural evolution and stacking-fault energetics indicate that B impedes dislocation glide via local pinning and suppresses deformation twinning, thereby increasing resistance to plastic deformation. By linking solute redistribution to defect interactions and deformation, these findings establish an atomistic framework for understanding and designing high-performance alloys based on interstitial solutes.

AI.tldr: 该文利用高精度机器学习势结合巨正则蒙特卡洛/分子动力学，揭示TiAl中微量B的缺陷介导再分布及其对高温变形的影响。
AI.motivation: B微合金化可细化铸造TiAl组织并调控力学性能，但稀B在TiAl中的存在形式、与缺陷相互作用及其如何控制高温变形尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用新开发的高保真机器学习势，结合杂化巨正则蒙特卡洛/分子动力学模拟，系统研究B在TiAl中的再分布、缺陷相互作用及变形行为。
AI.result: 硼化物显著硬于TiAl基体并作为脆性增强相，其界面结合取决于表面终止和堆垛顺序；间隙B易被Ti-rich八面体位置捕获且迁移势垒高，接近Al空位时可动力学转变为替位掺杂，拉应力和空位浓度促进B在体相富集；B富集于半共格γ/α2界面并优先分配至α2相，在多晶TiAl中主要聚集于无序区；1 at.% B、900 K下平均流变应力提高9.4%，伴随剪切应变积累减少；B通过局部钉扎阻碍位错滑移并抑制形变孪晶。
AI.conclusion: 研究将溶质再分布、缺陷相互作用与变形联系起来，为基于间隙溶质设计高性能TiAl合金提供了原子尺度框架。

title: High-Throughput Screening of Phononic Bandgap in Experimentally Realized Materials
summary: Materials with a phonon band gap offer a unique mechanism to restrict phonon scattering, making them promising candidates for developing functional materials for targeted thermal applications. Unlocking this mechanism across broad material classes requires systematic exploration, but first-principles methods and experiments are too expensive. Here, we used the universal machine-learning interatomic potential to quantify phonons and thermodynamic properties. We validated the accuracy of machine-learning-calculated results by comparing them with density-functional theory. We screened 154,879 materials and performed phonon calculations for 42,347 thermodynamically stable and experimentally observed compounds. We then performed phonon band gap analysis for dynamically stable materials and identified 11,176 materials with a phononic gap, including 10,960 materials with optical-optical gaps and 270 with acoustic-optical gaps. We also analyzed the lattice thermal conductivity of materials with phonon band gaps to identify candidates with acoustic-optical gaps and low thermal conductivity. Finally, by solving the linearized phonon Boltzmann equation from first principles, we demonstrate low room-temperature lattice thermal conductivities in three Li-metal binaries.

AI.tldr: 利用通用机器学习原子间势对约15.5万种材料进行声子筛选，识别出11,176种具有声子带隙的材料，并发现三种低室温晶格热导率的锂金属二元化合物。
AI.motivation: 声子带隙可限制声子散射，是设计热功能材料的重要机制；但传统第一性原理计算和实验成本高，难以大规模系统探索。
AI.method: 采用通用机器学习原子间势计算声子与热力学性质，并与密度泛函理论对比验证；筛选154,879种材料，对42,347种热力学稳定且实验已观测化合物进行声子计算；分析动态稳定材料的声子带隙和晶格热导率，并用第一性原理求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼方程验证候选材料。
AI.result: 识别出11,176种具有声子带隙的材料，其中10,960种为光学-光学带隙、270种为声学-光学带隙；进一步筛选出具有声学-光学带隙且低热导率的候选材料，并在三种锂金属二元化合物中证实低室温晶格热导率。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习原子间势可高效支撑大规模声子带隙筛选，加速发现用于热管理等功能应用的低热导率声子带隙材料。

title: Strain-Induced Tetragonal-to-Cubic Transition in MAPbI$_3$ from Machine-Learned Molecular Dynamics
summary: Metal-halide perovskites are promising photovoltaic absorbers whose optoelectronic properties are highly tunable. Epitaxial strain offers a route to stabilize desirable phases, tune band gaps, and reduce energetic disorder, but rational strain engineering requires predictive models. Static, zero-temperature "strained-bulk" density functional theory (DFT) calculations, successful for oxide perovskites, neglect the dynamic disorder and anharmonicity that govern halide perovskites at ambient temperature. Here, we show that molecular dynamics (MD) based on machine-learned force fields trained on-the-fly on DFT reproduces the structural and optoelectronic response of methylammonium (MA) lead iodide (MAPbI$_3$) to epitaxial strain at 300 K. We simulate bulk and free-standing slab models across experimentally accessible biaxial strains by locking the in-plane lattice vectors in nanosecond-long simulations. We predict a tetragonal-to-cubic transition at $\sim$0.5% tensile strain, marked by $c/a = 1$ and the loss of the $a^0a^0c^-$ tilting pattern, in agreement with experiments on epitaxial MAPbI$_3$ films on KCl. MA cations retain preferential orientations in the strain-induced cubic phase, unlike in its temperature-induced counterpart. Bulk and slab models yield consistent trends, with surface effects decaying within a few octahedral layers. Band gaps computed as ensemble averages over MD snapshots blue-shift under tensile strain, consistent with experiment, whereas static calculations on averaged structures predict a red shift. Our study positions MD with constrained lattice vectors as a method for predicting finite-temperature strain phase diagrams and guiding the epitaxial design of perovskite absorbers.

AI.tldr: 该文用基于机器学习力场的有限温度分子动力学预测MAPbI3在外延双轴应变下的结构与光电性质，揭示约0.5%拉伸应变诱导四方-立方相变及带隙蓝移。
AI.motivation: 卤化物钙钛矿的应变工程需要预测模型，但传统零温“应变体”DFT忽略室温动态无序与各向异性，难以可靠描述其应变响应。
AI.method: 在300 K下，用在线学习DFT训练的机器学习力场进行纳秒级分子动力学，锁定面内晶格矢量以施加实验可及的双轴应变，并比较块体与自由悬浮 slab 模型。
AI.result: 预测约0.5%拉伸应变发生四方到立方转变（c/a=1并失去a^0a^0c^-倾转），与KCl上外延MAPbI3实验一致；应变诱导立方相中MA仍保留择优取向；块体与slab趋势一致且表面效应数层内衰减；MD系综平均带隙在拉伸应变下蓝移，与实验一致，而静态平均结构计算预测红移。
AI.conclusion: 约束晶格矢量的机器学习分子动力学可用于预测有限温度应变相图，并指导钙钛矿吸收层的外延设计。

title: Manipulation of Ferroelectric Polarization Under Near-Gap Light
summary: Noncontacting light control of ferroelectric (FE) order has been receiving extensive interest in condensed matter physics. In this work, we investigate near-resonant light irradiation that induces structure-dependent photoexcited carrier density along the transition pathway. We combine a minimal Rice-Mele model containing intersite density-density correlations with ab initio calculations for realistic materials such as GeTe and SnTe. If the photon energy is below-gap without carrier excitation, only off-resonant scattering occurs and the FE order tends to be diminished. Slightly increasing photon energy at the near-gap regime would lead to a centrosymmetric non-polar (NP) to FE phase transition, which is not thermally accessible in conventional pressure-temperature phase diagram. This is in contrast to the well-above-gap light situation that tends to suppress the FE order under a fixed amount of photoexcitation. We apply phenomenological Landau theory and show that they belong to the continuous and first-order phase transitions, respectively. The occupation constrained calculations suggest that these reversible NP-FE phase transitions could be triggered under moderate light fluence. Our mechanism provides a potential route to reversible light-stabilized polar phases with reduced lattice heating and marginal lattice damages.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种通过近共振光激发调控铁电序的非接触机制：沿相变路径产生结构依赖的光生载流子密度，可在GeTe和SnTe等材料中实现常规热力学不可及的Center对称非极性到铁电相的可逆转变。
AI.motivation: 铁电序的非接触光调控在凝聚态物理中备受关注，但需要理解不同光子能量和光激发载流子密度如何影响铁电稳定性及相变路径。
AI.method: 结合包含格点间密度-密度关联的最小Rice-Mele模型与GeTe、SnTe等真实材料的从头算计算，并用唯象Landau理论分析相变性质；还采用占据数约束计算评估光 fluency 下的可逆相变。
AI.result: 低于带隙且无载流子激发时仅发生非共振散射，铁电序趋于减弱；近带隙略增光子能量可驱动Center对称非极性相到铁电相的转变，且该转变在常规压强-温度相图中热不可及，属于连续相变；远高于带隙的强光激发则在固定光激发量下抑制铁电序，属于一级相变。占据数约束计算表明 moderate light fluence 可触发可逆非极性-铁电相变。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为利用光稳定极性相提供了潜在途径，可在减少晶格加热和晶格损伤的情况下实现可逆铁电序调控。

title: Metal-Dielectric Bilayer Supported Nanoporous Silver Substrates for Ultrasensitive Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering
summary: Resolving the chemical footprint of molecules in analytes is of fundamental interest in biosensing and biomedical applications. Surface-enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS) spectroscopy is a powerful tool for non-invasive molecule investigation, and there is a continuous effort to develop highly efficient SERS substrates that can be fabricated at low cost and tuned to the desired spectral range of investigation. Here, we show that the Raman signal of porous silver films can be significantly enhanced by integrating a thin dielectric layer and a metallic backreflector underneath the porous metal film. We call this architecture nanoporous metal on dielectric metal (NPMoDM) and show that it leads to much stronger near-field enhancement in the bulk of the film. Additionally, the spectral band of enhanced sensitivity can be tuned by the thickness of the dielectric layer within the visible spectral range. With rhodamine 6G and para-aminothiophenol as target analytes, we demonstrate SERS detection of substrates incubated with zeptomolar concentrations of the analyte, which corresponds to only few molecules present on a mm2 surface area. Our approach introduces a tunable and scalable (lithography-free) platform for ultrasensitive SERS applications, with a readily accessible surface for analyte functionalization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“介质层上纳米多孔金属”（NPMoDM）SERS基底：在多孔银膜下引入薄介质层和金属背反射器，可显著增强拉曼信号并调节增强波段，实现zeptomolar级检测。
AI.motivation: SERS是無损分子检测的重要工具，但需要低成本、高效且可调谐至目标光谱范围的SERS基底，以解析分析物中的化学指纹。
AI.method: 构建NPMoDM架构，即在多孔银膜下方集成薄介质层与金属背反射器；研究其对薄膜内部近场增强的影响，并通过改变介质层厚度调节可见光范围内的增强敏感谱带；以罗丹明6G和对氨基苯硫酚为分析物进行SERS检测。
AI.result: NPMoDM结构在多孔膜内部产生更强近场增强，增强敏感波段可在可见光区随介质层厚度调谐；对经zeptomolar浓度分析物孵育的基底实现SERS检测，相当于每mm2表面仅有少数分子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可调谐、可规模化且无需光刻的超灵敏SERS平台，并具有便于分析物功能化的可接触表面。

title: Femtosecond laser-controlled production of functional titanium niobate layers from TiO$_{2}$/Nb$_{2}$O$_{5}$ powders
summary: Conventional synthesis methods of titanium niobates (TNO) require prolongated high-temperature treatments. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we have developed a confined powder-bed femtosecond (fs) laser-based technique to sinter TNO films starting from a mixture of TiO$_{2}$ and Nb$_{2}$O$_{5}$ powders, avoiding furnace-based approaches. The influence of laser-processing conditions on film formation, phase composition, and microstructure is systematically investigated, demonstrating that different TNO phases and morphologies can be obtained by controlling the laser pulse energy. A comprehensive characterization of the processed films has been performed, providing insights into the mechanisms governing their formation, which appear to share key features with laser-induced backward transfer (LIBT) processes. Our findings establish the relationship between laser-processing conditions and TNO film formation, highlighting the potential of confined powder-bed fs-laser processing as an alternative route for manufacturing functional oxide layers. Tentative applications of these layers are finally discussed.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种限域粉床飞秒激光烧结方法，直接由TiO₂和Nb₂O₅混合粉末制备铌酸钛(TNO)薄膜，避免传统长时间高温炉处理，并系统研究激光条件对成膜、物相和微结构的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统TNO合成依赖长时间高温热处理，能耗高、工艺受限；需要开发无需炉加热的可控薄膜制备路线。
AI.method: 将TiO₂与Nb₂O₅粉末混合形成限域粉床，采用飞秒激光处理制备TNO薄膜；系统调控激光脉冲能量等加工条件，并对薄膜形成、物相组成和微观结构进行综合表征，分析其形成机制。
AI.result: 激光脉冲能量可调控不同TNO物相和形貌；薄膜形成机制与激光诱导背向转移(LIBT)过程具有关键相似特征；建立了激光加工条件与TNO成膜之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 限域粉床飞秒激光处理可作为制备功能氧化物层的替代路线，并讨论了所得TNO薄膜的潜在应用。

title: Asymmetrical transport distribution function: skewness as a key to enhance thermoelectric performance
summary: How to achieve high thermoelectric figure of merit is still a scientific challenge. By solving the Boltzmann transport equation, thermoelectric properties can be written as integrals of a single function, the transport distribution function (TDF). In this work, the shape effects of transport distribution function in various typical functional forms on thermoelectric properties of materials are systematically investigated. It is found that the asymmetry of TDF, characterized by skewness, can be used to describe universally the trend of thermoelectric properties. By defining symmetric and asymmetric TDF functions, a novel skewness is then constructed for thermoelectric applications. It is demonstrated, by comparison with ab initio calculations and experiments, that the proposed thermoelectric skewness not only perfectly captures the main feature of conventional skewness, but also is able to predict the thermoelectric power accurately. This comparison confirms the unique feature of our proposed thermoelectric skewness, as well as its special role of connection between the statistics of TDF and thermoelectric properties of materials. It is also found that the thermoelectric performance can be enhanced by increasing the asymmetry of TDF. Finally, it is also interesting to find that the thermoelectric transport properties based on typical quantum statistics (Fermi-Dirac distributions), can be well described by typical shape parameter (skewness) for classical statistics.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究了输运分布函数（TDF）形状对热电性能的影响，并提出用于预测热电性能的“热电偏度”描述符。
AI.motivation: 高热电优值（ZT）仍是科学难题；作者希望通过TDF的形状特征建立与热电性能之间的普适联系。
AI.method: 通过求解Boltzmann输运方程，将热电性能表示为TDF的积分；系统考察多种典型TDF函数形式，定义对称与非对称TDF，并构造适用于热电的新偏度，结合从头算与实验进行验证。
AI.result: TDF的不对称性（偏度）可普适描述热电性能趋势；所提出的热电偏度既能捕捉传统偏度的主要特征，又能准确预测热电功率；增大TDF不对称性可提升热电性能；基于Fermi-Dirac分布的热电输运性质可由经典统计的典型形状参数（偏度）较好描述。
AI.conclusion: 热电偏度建立了TDF统计特征与材料热电性能之间的联系，可作为普适描述符并为通过调控TDF不对称性提升热电性能提供指导。

title: Electric Field Assisted Charge Transfer Mediated Electronic Coupling in Ferromagnetic/Multiferroic Hetero-structure
summary: The strongly coupled ferromagnet-multiferroic material could be a better alternative to complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) based data storage device or rather lone multiferroic oxide materials because it offers the electric field controlled conductivity and large magnetisation at the interfaces, but choosing a proper system is still very much challenging. In the present scenario, an interionic charge transfer from Co ion to Fe ion via oxygen is observed at the interfacial region of LaCoO3 (LCO)/BiFeO3 (BFO) grown on SrTiO3 substrate, leading to induce multivalency in Co, Fe ion and also induces exchange biasing in the system. The charge transferring between Co and Fe ions gets further enhanced by electric biasing across the bilayer in the low temperature region, which affects the polarisation behaviour of BFO layer. This confirms the electronic coupling between the ferromagnetic LCO and the multiferroic BFO layers, useful for the making of voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) systems.

AI.tldr: 在SrTiO3衬底上生长的LaCoO3/BiFeO3双层界面中观察到经氧介导的Co向Fe的层间电荷转移，并可由低温电场偏置增强，从而调控BFO极化并确认LCO与BFO之间的电子耦合。
AI.motivation: 铁磁-多铁强耦合体系有望替代CMOS基数据存储或单一多铁氧化物，因其界面具备电场可控电导和大磁化，但合适材料体系的选择仍具挑战。
AI.method: 研究LaCoO3（LCO）/BiFeO3（BFO）/SrTiO3界面，分析Co与Fe经氧的界面电荷转移、Co/Fe多价态、交换偏置，以及在低温下跨双层施加电场偏置对电荷转移和BFO极化行为的影响。
AI.result: 界面处发生Co至Fe的电荷转移，诱导Co和Fe多价态及交换偏置；低温电场偏置进一步增强Co-Fe间电荷转移，并影响BFO层极化行为。
AI.conclusion: 该结果证实铁磁LCO与多铁BFO层之间存在电子耦合，表明LCO/BFO体系有用于电压控制磁各向异性（VCMA）等电场调控磁电功能的潜力。

title: Coupled Altermagnetic and Valley Physics in Monolayer VBiSe$_3$
summary: The interplay of compensated magnetism, spin--orbit coupling (SOC), and valley degrees of freedom provides a promising route toward spin--valley control without conventional ferromagnetism. Here, using first-principles calculations combined with Wannier-based analysis, we reveal coupled altermagnetic and valley physics in monolayer VBiSe$_3$. In the absence of SOC, the compensated N\'eel antiferromagnetic state, whose opposite-spin V sublattices are related only by mirror operations, exhibits momentum-dependent spin splitting with a characteristic $i$-wave altermagnetic texture. Upon inclusion of SOC, the conduction-band states develop anisotropic Rashba-like spin splitting together with a sizable $K/K'$ valley splitting of about $112.2$~meV. Orbital analysis and an effective SOC Hamiltonian identify the hybridization between SOC-active Se-$p_{x,y}$ states and predominantly V-$d_{z^2}$ conduction-band states as an important microscopic origin of the valley splitting. The two valleys carry Berry curvature of the same sign but different magnitude, unlike the opposite-sign pattern of conventional valley Hall systems, so the large valley splitting, rather than a valley Hall effect, offers a possible route to valley-selective carrier occupation by gating. Moreover, a modest $-1\%$ biaxial compressive strain drives the system into a quasi-half-valley-metallic state with valley-polarized electrons and non-valley-polarized holes. These results establish monolayer VBiSe$_3$ as a promising platform for coupled altermagnetic, spin--orbit, and valley phenomena with strain-tunable electronic states.

AI.tldr: 单层VBiSe$_3$中实现交变磁性与谷物理的耦合，并可通过SOC和应变调控自旋—谷电子态。
AI.motivation: 探索无需传统铁磁性的自旋—谷控制途径，利用补偿磁性、自旋—轨道耦合与谷自由度之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算结合基于Wannier的分析，并进行轨道分析和有效SOC哈密顿量建模。
AI.result: 无SOC时，镜面联系的反自旋V子晶格形成i波交变磁织构的动量依赖自旋劈裂；引入SOC后，导带出现各向异性Rashba型自旋劈裂及约112.2 meV的K/K'谷劈裂，其微观起源与SOC活性的Se-$p_{x,y}$和以V-$d_{z^2}$为主的导带态杂化有关；两谷Berry曲率同号但大小不同；$-1\%$双轴压缩应变诱导准半谷金属态，电子谷极化而空穴不谷极化。
AI.conclusion: 单层VBiSe$_3$是研究交变磁性、自旋—轨道耦合与谷现象耦合及应变可调电子态的有前景平台，并可通过门控利用大谷劈裂实现谷选择性载流子占据。

title: The effect of isotopically-enriched 70Ge on the Raman scattering in Cr2Ge2Te6
summary: The highest-energy A5g Raman-active vibrational mode in chromium germanium telluride (Cr2Ge2Te6, CGT) exhibits a unique lineshape comprising a series of remarkably narrow peaks. While this multiplet was attributed to the natural isotope distribution of germanium affecting Ge-Ge pseudo-molecular vibrations, direct evidence has been lacking. Here, we present a Raman spectroscopy study of CGT isotopically enriched with 70Ge to validate this hypothesis. Upon isotopic enrichment, both the E5g and A5g modes exhibit a pronounced blue-shift. At room temperature, the A5g peak undergoes significant narrowing, while low-temperature measurements reveal a single, well-defined line instead of the previously observed multiplet. These observations align precisely with density functional theory calculations, confirming that the multi-line profile originates from Ge isotope distribution. Our findings demonstrate that similar isotope-induced Raman splitting may occur in other structurally analogous layered tellurides containing Ge or Si.

AI.tldr: 通过70Ge同位素富集Raman光谱和DFT计算，证实Cr2Ge2Te6中A5g模式的多峰结构源于Ge同位素分布。
AI.motivation: CGT的A5g Raman模式呈现异常窄的多重峰，此前推测由Ge天然同位素分布导致Ge-Ge赝分子振动分裂，但缺乏直接证据。
AI.method: 制备70Ge同位素富集的CGT样品，进行变温Raman光谱测量，并与密度泛函理论计算对比E5g和A5g模式行为。
AI.result: 同位素富集后E5g和A5g均显著蓝移；室温下A5g峰明显变窄，低温下由多重峰变为单一清晰谱线，与DFT计算一致。
AI.conclusion: A5g多线型源自Ge同位素分布；类似同位素诱导Raman分裂可能存在于其他含Ge或Si的层状碲化物中。

title: Janus Asymmetry Unlocks Rashba Spintronics and Chiral Phononics in Two-Dimensional Carbo-Chalcogenides
summary: Spintronics and chiral phononics offer complementary routes for nanoscale control, yet realizing both functionalities within a common two-dimensional platform remains challenging. Here, using extensive first-principles calculations, we show that Janus asymmetry simultaneously drives both effects in transition-metal carbo-chalcogenides (JTMCCs) along two chemically distinct routes, through either chalcogen or transition-metal substitution. Remarkably, both Janus routes yield giant Rashba responses, with $\alpha_\mathrm{R}\approx2$ eV {\AA} in Ta$_2$CSSe and NbTaCS$_2$, exceeding those reported for Mo/W-based Janus transition-metal dichalcogenides. Furthermore, Janus asymmetry lifts the degeneracy of opposite-chirality phonons, producing splittings as large as $\approx28$ cm$^{-1}$. More strikingly, asymmetry generates chiral carbon vibrations that were achiral in the centrosymmetric parent compounds, with splittings reaching $\approx8$ cm$^{-1}$. Finally, we show external electric fields tunability over Rashba strength and chiral-phonon splittings, providing a common control knob for electronic spin and lattice angular momentum. Our work offers a unified strategy for realizing spintronic and chiral phononic in two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 该文通过第一性原理计算表明，Janus不对称性可在过渡金属碳硫族化合物（JTMCCs）中同时驱动巨Rashba自旋轨道效应与手性声子分裂，并提供电场调控手段。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子学与手性声子学为纳米尺度控制提供互补途径，但在同一二维平台中同时实现二者仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用大规模第一性原理计算，研究Janus不对称的过渡金属碳硫族化合物，并比较硫族元素替代与过渡金属替代两条化学路径；同时考察外加电场对Rashba强度和手性声子分裂的调控。
AI.result: 两条Janus路径均产生巨Rashba响应，Ta2CSSe和NbTaCS2中α_R约2 eV Å，超过Mo/W基Janus过渡金属二硫族化物；Janus不对称使相反手性声子退简并，分裂达约28 cm^-1，并在原本中心对称母体中非手性的碳振动中诱导手性，分裂约8 cm^-1；外电场可同时调控Rashba强度与手性声子分裂。
AI.conclusion: Janus不对称可作为统一策略，在二维材料中同时实现自旋电子学与手性声子学功能，并以电场作为电子自旋和晶格角动量的共同调控旋钮。

title: Gallium at germanium surfaces: links to superconducting films and correlated adatom lattices
summary: Epitaxial films grown on Ge(001) show that germanium hyperdoped with substitutional Ga is superconducting. In earlier implanted films, Ga-rich precipitates obscured the origin of the superconductivity. This review examines the sites Ga occupies on Ge(001) and Ge(111) and how it enters the growing film. The Ga fraction expected from the growth fluxes is 17.9\%, yet the distribution of Ga among lattice sites is unknown. Comparisons include Ga on Si(001) and Si(111),In, Sn, Pb, Sb and P on Ge(001), and elemental and two-dimensional Ga. Where its surface coordination has been established, Ga has three bonds, whereas substitutional Ga in the films is fourfold coordinated and acts as an acceptor. Scanning tunnelling microscopy and X-ray standing waves have assigned Ga sites on Ge(111), but the dilute Ga site on Ge(001), where the films are grown, has yet to be measured. On Ge(111), Ga in the substrate may supply holes to the correlated Sn adatom lattice, as B supplies holes to the superconducting Sn lattice on Si(111). Whether Ga can supply holes depends on where it sits and whether it has three or four neighbours. On both surfaces, element-specific measurements and calculations comparing adsorption with substitution could settle the remaining site assignments.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦Ge(001)外延膜中Ga超掺杂超导性的微观起源，系统梳理Ga在Ge(001)/Ge(111)上的占位与掺入路径，并指出Ge(001)稀Ga占位仍未测定。
AI.motivation: 早期离子注入膜中的富Ga沉淀掩盖了超导来源；需明确Ga在晶格中的占位、配位与是否为替位受主，以解释超导并判断其能否向Sn相关晶格提供空穴。
AI.method: 以综述和对比分析为主：比较Ga在Ge(001)、Ge(111)及Si(001)、Si(111)上的行为，并对照In、Sn、Pb、Sb、P在Ge(001)上的情况；结合表面配位、STM与X射线驻波占位结果及元素特异性测量和理论计算。
AI.result: 生长通量预期Ga分数为17.9%，但其晶格位点分布未知；已确定表面Ga多为三键配位，而膜中替位Ga为四配位并作为受主。Ge(111)上Ga占位已由STM/XSW指认，但Ge(001)上稀Ga占位尚未测得；Ge(111)中Ga可能像Si(111)上的B向Sn晶格供空穴一样向相关Sn吸附原子晶格供空穴。
AI.conclusion: 需在Ge(001)和Ge(111)上开展元素特异性测量并结合吸附与替位对比计算，以最终确定Ga的占位、配位及其对超导/空穴供给的作用。

title: Altermagnetism of MnSiN2 and MnGeN2 in a wurtzite-based crystal structure
summary: Based on symmetry analysis, the Pna2_1 wurtzite-based crystal structure with Mn as a magnetic group-II element, MnSiN2 and MnGeN2 belong to the class of altermagnets because spin-up and spin-down Mn in the unit cell are related by rotation or mirror plane type operations rather than inversion or translation. Spin polarized density functional theory calculations and quasiparticle self-consistent (QS) GW calculations support the symmetry analysis and identify the lowest-energy spin configuration as Pna'2_1' in agreement with neutron diffraction data. The altermagnetic band splittings allowed for the three different antiferromagnetic ordering patterns are reported and symmetry analyzed. Additionally, spin wave dispersions, chiral magnon spltting, and Neel temperature estimates from the mean-field and random-phase approximations are provided, as well as calculations of the optical dielectric function using the Bethe-Salpeter Equation method. MnSiN2 exhibits both Wannier-type excitons with N-p to Si-s transition character and charge-transfer Frenkel-type excitons with hole on N-p and electron on Mn-d orbital character.

AI.tldr: 通过对称性分析并结合自旋极化DFT与QSGW计算，确认Pna2_1型纤锌矿结构MnSiN2和MnGeN2属于交替磁体，并系统给出其磁序、自旋波、Néel温度及光学激发性质。
AI.motivation: 探索以Mn为磁性II族元素的纤锌矿衍生氮化物中的交替磁性，明确其对称性起源、最低能反铁磁序及自旋与光学响应。
AI.method: 采用对称性分析、自旋极化密度泛函理论、准粒子自洽GW（QSGW）、自旋波色散计算、平均场与随机相近似（RPA）估算Néel温度，并用Bethe-Salpeter方程计算光学介电函数。
AI.result: 自旋向上与向下Mn由旋转或镜面操作联系而非反演/平移，支持交替磁性；最低能自旋构型为Pna'2_1'，与中子衍射一致；报道并对称性分析了三种反铁磁序的交替磁能带劈裂，给出自旋波色散、手性磁振子劈裂及Néel温度估计；MnSiN2具有N-p到Si-s的Wannier型激子和空穴在N-p、电子在Mn-d的电荷转移Frenkel型激子。
AI.conclusion: MnSiN2和MnGeN2是纤锌矿型交替磁体，其反铁磁序、能带劈裂、磁振子手性及激子光学响应可由对称性和第一性原理计算统一描述，并展现丰富的自旋与激子物理。

title: Generalized dielectric-dependent hybrid functional combining Gaussian and Yukawa screening
summary: We develop a generalized Coulomb-attenuated method (GCAM) for dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals that combines Gaussian and Yukawa-type screening functions to provide an accurate representation of the random-phase approximation (RPA) dielectric function. Through systematic fitting to RPA dielectric functions of semiconductors and insulators, and to the Lindhard dielectric function of the homogeneous electron gas, we demonstrate that GCAM significantly reduces errors in the model dielectric function across the full momentum range. However, despite this improved physical description of screening, band gap calculations reveal that GCAM yields larger errors compared to experiment than previous CAM approaches for wide-gap materials, but smaller errors for most narrow-gap materials. This counterintuitive result demonstrates that the success of CAM stems not purely from physical reasons, but also from a partial cancellation of errors. In contrast, for optical absorption spectra calculated within a model Bethe-Salpeter equation framework, GCAM systematically outperforms CAM, showing better agreement with the reference spectra obtained with the diagonal RPA screening in both peak positions and relative intensities. Our findings reveal the important role of error cancellation in dielectric-dependent hybrid functionals.

AI.tldr: 提出GCAM方法，用高斯与汤川型屏蔽函数组合更准确描述RPA介电函数，并揭示介电依赖杂化泛函中误差抵消的重要作用。
AI.motivation: 改进介电依赖杂化泛函对随机相位近似（RPA）介电函数的描述，尤其是全动量范围内的屏蔽效应。
AI.method: 构建广义库仑衰减方法（GCAM），将高斯型与汤川型屏蔽函数结合，并对半导体/绝缘体的RPA介电函数及均匀电子气Lindhard介电函数进行系统拟合。
AI.result: GCAM显著降低模型介电函数在全动量范围内的误差；但带隙计算中，宽禁带材料误差较此前CAM方法更大，多数窄禁带材料误差更小；在模型Bethe-Salpeter方程框架下计算光学吸收谱时，GCAM在峰位和相对强度上均系统优于CAM。
AI.conclusion: CAM的成功并非纯物理原因，而部分源于误差抵消；误差抵消在介电依赖杂化泛函中起重要作用。

title: Interface-Engineered Piezoelectricity and Electromechanical Coupling in Two-Dimensional van der Waals Heterostructures
summary: Interfaces between dissimilar two-dimensional (2D) materials provide a route to engineer electromechanical responses that are not intrinsic to the individual constituent layers. Here, we use high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations to investigate 461 van der Waals heterostructures constructed from 57 2D monolayers and establish a materials-design framework linking work-function mismatch, interfacial charge redistribution, dipole formation, and strain-dependent electromechanical response. We find that heterostructure formation generates out-of-plane interfacial dipoles via charge redistribution between the constituent layers, while biaxial in-plane strain systematically modulates them. The resulting heterostructures exhibit two distinct regimes: metallic interfaces with strain-tunable interfacial dipoles and semiconducting heterostructures with well-defined piezoelectric responses. For the latter, Berry-phase (BP) calculations independently validate the charge-density-difference (CDD) approach, which is generally applicable to all representative systems, with piezoelectric coefficients calculated via two methods agreeing to within 10%. Among 24 selected heterostructures, effective biaxial interfacial electromechanical coefficients reach 83.35 pCm-1 . These results demonstrate that the interface can serve as the active element governing electromechanical coupling and provide a computationally guided strategy for designing strain-tunable out-of-plane electromechanical responses in 2D van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过高通量DFT构建461种由57种二维单层组合而成的范德华异质结，建立从功函数失配、界面电荷重分布、偶极形成到应变依赖机电响应的设计框架，并证明界面可作为调控面外机电耦合的活性单元。
AI.motivation: 不同二维材料界面可产生单层本身不具备的机电响应，但缺乏系统性的材料设计规律与高通量筛选方法。
AI.method: 采用高通量密度泛函理论计算461种二维范德华异质结，分析功函数失配、界面电荷转移与面外偶极；施加双轴面内应变研究其调制作用，并用Berry相位法独立验证电荷密度差方法。
AI.result: 异质结形成通过层间电荷重分布产生面外界面偶极，双轴应变可系统调控偶极；体系分为金属界面（应变可调界面偶极）和半导体异质结（明确压电响应）。Berry相位与电荷密度差法计算的压电系数偏差在10%以内；24个优选异质结的有效双轴界面机电系数最高达83.35 pC m⁻¹。
AI.conclusion: 界面是控制二维范德华异质结机电耦合的关键活性元素，该研究提供了设计应变可调面外机电响应的计算指导策略。

title: Terahertz detection of magnon chirality in polycrystalline CsCuCl$_3$
summary: In antiferromagnets, the handedness of magnon precession is usually measured on single crystals. In a pressed pellet of the chiral helimagnet CsCuCl$_3$, whose grains carry both structural handednesses and all orientations, we found that, from 5 to 7 T, the sub-terahertz magnon absorbs one circular polarization more than 20 times as strongly as the other, which rules out precession about each grain's own axis. Spin-wave theory attributes this to the Zeeman frequency, here two to four times the exchange-enhanced gap, which locks the precession axis to the field in every grain. Magnon chirality in antiferromagnets is thus accessible without a single crystal.

AI.tldr: 在CsCuCl3多晶压片中观测到亚太赫兹磁振子对左/右圆偏振吸收相差20倍以上，表明无需单晶即可探测反铁磁磁振子手性。
AI.motivation: 磁振子进动手性通常只能在单晶上测量；本文探究结构手性和晶粒取向均混杂的多晶压片能否用于手性探测。
AI.method: 对CsCuCl3压片在5–7 T下进行亚太赫兹圆偏振吸收测量，并用自旋波理论分析进动轴与吸收差异。
AI.result: 一种圆偏振的吸收比另一种强20倍以上，排除了绕各晶粒自身轴进动的可能；理论归因于塞曼频率（为交换增强能隙的2–4倍）将每个晶粒的进动轴锁定到外场。
AI.conclusion: 反铁磁体中的磁振子手性无需单晶即可访问，多晶压片也可用于手性探测。

title: Solute-Aware Stochastic Korhonen Model of Electromigration in Wide vs Near-Bamboo Al-Cu Lines
summary: We couple an evolving Cu field to the one-dimensional Korhonen stress equation on random grain maps for wide (10 $\mu$m), narrow (3 $\mu$m) and near-bamboo Al-Cu lines. Earlier random-microstructure simulations fixed the Cu effect, and most continuum solute models used prescribed structures with all Cu mobile; we join the two and let only dissolved Cu move, the excess staying as immobile precipitate. With $10^3$ maps per condition at 200 $^\circ$C, we report nucleation times and sites, immortal fractions and Black's-law parameters. In cathode-limited lines Cu depletion shortens the median nucleation time 1.15- to 1.20-fold relative to immobile Cu for the cited Cu diffusivity; treating all Cu as mobile overstates this a further 2.24- to 2.36-fold at 2 wt%; the exponent stays near 2. In wide lines with reservoir ends, Cu steps left by the immobile precipitate become the failure sites, removing their Cu-free immortality if a quarter or more of the precipitate blocks Al diffusion. With Cu above the solvus the lifetime is not Arrhenius, as the dissolved fraction rises with temperature: a Black's-law fit at 250 to 300 $^\circ$C overestimates the median nucleation time at 150 $^\circ$C up to 2.33-fold at 2 wt% Cu with an exponent near 2. At the test durations the model qualitatively matches the cathode-side damage in narrow lines and the Cu build-up and mid-line peaks in wide lines but not the cathode-side Cu peaks or longer lives of narrow lines.

AI.tldr: 将可动溶解Cu场与一维Korhonen应力方程耦合到随机晶粒图上，发现仅溶解Cu迁移、过量Cu作为不可动析出物会显著影响Al-Cu互连的成核统计与Black定律参数。
AI.motivation: 以往随机微结构模拟多固定Cu效应，而连续介质溶质模型常采用预设结构并假设全部Cu可动；本文旨在统一这两类方法，在真实随机晶粒图上同时演化Cu分布与应力，并区分溶解Cu与不可动析出物。
AI.method: 对10 μm宽、3 μm窄和近竹节Al-Cu线，在随机晶粒图上耦合演化Cu场与一维Korhonen应力方程；仅溶解Cu可扩散，过量Cu保持为不可动析出物；每种条件约10^3张随机图，200 °C下统计成核时间与位置、不可死比例及Black定律参数，并比较固定Cu、全Cu可动等情形。
AI.result: 在阴极受限线中，Cu耗竭使中位成核时间相对不可动Cu缩短1.15–1.20倍；若把全部Cu视为可动，在2 wt% Cu下进一步高估2.24–2.36倍，指数仍接近2。宽线有储层端时，不可动析出物留下的Cu台阶成为失效位点；若至少四分之一析出物阻挡Al扩散，则消除无Cu区的“不可死”行为。Cu高于固溶度时寿命不服从Arrhenius关系，因溶解分数随温度升高；用250–300 °C的Black定律拟合外推150 °C，在2 wt% Cu下可高估中位成核时间达2.33倍，指数接近2。模型在测试时长内定性匹配窄线阴极侧损伤及宽线Cu积累和中线峰，但未匹配阴极侧Cu峰或窄线更长寿命。
AI.conclusion: 溶解/析出Cu的区分与随机晶粒结构对Al-Cu互连失效统计至关重要；忽略不可动析出物或假设全Cu可动会明显偏差成核时间与温度外推，且模型仅部分复现实验损伤形貌，仍需改进以解释阴极Cu峰和窄线寿命。

title: From raw magnetoresistance to reliable cyclotron masses: A practical guide to processing quantum oscillation data
summary: Quantum oscillations are an essential probe of the Fermi surface in conductors, and cyclotron masses extracted using the Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formula are used to evaluate correlation strength and the assignment of topological states. These masses depend on choices in signal processing, including the field window, method of background subtraction, and spectral window applied before the Fourier transform. These choices are often guided by visual inspection, yet they can alter spectral features and bias the extracted masses.
