We show that (1) representing a finite field interval by a single effective field can underestimate the cyclotron mass; (2) polynomial background subtraction can attenuate and shift low-frequency peaks; and (3) spectral tapering can reduce mass bias from leakage between neighboring peaks, at the cost of frequency resolution. We demonstrate these effects using numerical calculations and Shubnikov-de Haas experiments on the rare-earth tritellurides RTe3 (R = Pr, Nd, Gd, Tb) with a dense low-frequency spectrum in the charge ordered state. The examples reveal masses shifting by tens of percent with the field window, apparent peak shifts produced only by the background fit, and a reported departure from LK behavior that resolves into two neighboring frequencies.

AI.tldr: 量子振荡回旋质量提取对信号处理参数高度敏感；有限场窗、背景扣除和频谱窗会显著改变Lifshitz-Kosevich分析得到的质量与峰结构。
AI.motivation: 回旋质量用于评估关联强度和判定拓扑态，但其提取依赖场窗、背景扣除和傅里叶变换前频谱窗等常由目视决定的选择，可能引入系统偏差。
AI.method: 结合数值计算与RTe3（R=Pr, Nd, Gd, Tb）的Shubnikov-de Haas实验，在电荷有序态的低频密集谱中系统检验有限场区间、多项式背景扣除和频谱加窗对量子振荡谱及质量提取的影响。
AI.result: 用单一有效场代表有限场区间会低估回旋质量；多项式背景扣除会衰减并移动低频峰；频谱加窗可减小相邻峰泄漏导致的质量偏差但牺牲频率分辨率。实例中质量随场窗移动达数十个百分点，背景拟合可产生表观峰移，且原先报告的偏离LK行为可解析为两个相邻频率。
AI.conclusion: 量子振荡质量提取必须谨慎选择并明确报告信号处理流程；不规范的场窗、背景扣除和频谱加窗会影响回旋质量、关联强度评估及拓扑态判定。

title: Intertwined Magneto-Structural Criticality Driving Heterogeneous Collective-Pseudospin Dynamics in Sr2IrO4
summary: Correlated quantum phenomena arising from spin-orbit-coupled degrees of freedom provide foundational paradigms in emerging quantum technologies and spin-based functionalities. Elucidating the cooperative behaviors of these systems requires a precise probing of their intertwined magnetic and structural configurations. Using complementary resonant X-ray diffraction and high-energy total scattering measurements on single crystals of Sr2IrO4, we observe that spontaneous structural distortions scale quadratically with the magnetic order parameter. Importantly, the lattice distortion inherits the characteristic 2D XY -like critical behavior of the underlying antiferromagnetic order. X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) reveals multiscale, temperature- and wave-vector-dependent magnetic dynamics characterized by compressed-exponential relaxation and signatures of critical slowing down near the magnetic transition. These findings suggest the role of spin-orbit coupling and local structural distortions as the possible mechanism orchestrating such unconventional dynamics.

AI.tldr: 在Sr2IrO4单晶中，结构畸变与反铁磁序参量呈平方标度并继承二维XY临界行为，XPCS揭示多尺度磁动力学及临界慢化。
AI.motivation: 探究自旋-轨道耦合量子体系中相互交织的磁性与结构构型如何协同，并精确揭示其非常规磁动力学的微观机制。
AI.method: 结合共振X射线衍射与高能全散射测量Sr2IrO4单晶，并利用X射线光子相关谱（XPCS）探测温度与波矢依赖的磁动力学。
AI.result: 自发结构畸变随磁序参量二次标度，晶格畸变继承底层反铁磁序的二维XY型临界行为；XPCS观测到多尺度磁动力学，表现为压缩指数弛豫及磁转变附近的临界慢化特征。
AI.conclusion: 自旋-轨道耦合与局域结构畸变可能是协调此类非常规动力学的机制。

title: Minimal Three-Band Model and $d$-Wave Superconductivity in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_8$
summary: Motivated by the recent observation of ambient-pressure superconductivity in Pr- and Y-substituted La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_8$, we combined density-functional theory (DFT), dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), random phase approximation (RPA), and fluctuation exchange approximation (FLEX) methods to study its electronic structure and superconducting pairing symmetry. DFT band analysis indicates that the low-energy states are mainly dominated by three Ni-3$d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbitals with weak $d$-$p$ hybridization. Multi-orbital DMFT calculations yield an average $d_{x^2-y^2}$ filling of about 0.87, close to the optimal value for infinite-layer nickelates. By comparing the DMFT results of $d_{x^2-y^2}$ only and full Ni-3$d$ models, we find that their electronic properties are almost completely consistent, demonstrating the effectiveness of the simplified $d_{x^2-y^2}$ model. RPA and FLEX calculations based on this model consistently indicate a dominant $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing instability. These results establish La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_8$ as a system whose electronic structure closely resembles that of hole-doped cuprates, suggesting that the electronic pockets near the $\Gamma$- and $A$-points, which are characteristic of infinite-layer nickelates, may not be essential for superconductivity. The calculated superconducting transition temperature ($T_C$) is approximately 10\,K, in good agreement with experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 结合DFT、DMFT、RPA和FLEX研究La4Ni3O8的电子结构与超导配对对称性，发现主导d_{x^2-y^2}波配对，Tc约10 K，与实验一致。
AI.motivation: 近期在Pr和Y取代的La4Ni3O8中观察到常压超导，需要澄清其电子结构、配对对称性以及与无限层镍酸盐和铜氧化物的关系。
AI.method: 采用DFT能带分析；用多轨道DMFT比较仅d_{x^2-y^2}模型与完整Ni-3d模型；并在简化模型基础上用RPA和FLEX计算超导配对不稳定性。
AI.result: 低能态主要由三个Ni-3d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导且d-p杂化较弱；平均d_{x^2-y^2}填充约0.87；仅d_{x^2-y^2}与完整Ni-3d模型的电子性质几乎一致；RPA和FLEX一致给出主导的d_{x^2-y^2}波配对；计算Tc约10 K，与实验吻合。
AI.conclusion: La4Ni3O8的电子结构接近空穴掺杂铜氧化物；Γ和A点附近作为无限层镍酸盐特征的电子口袋可能并非超导必需；简化d_{x^2-y^2}模型有效。

title: Thickness-Dependent Morphology and Electrical Transport in Ultrathin Amorphous MoSi Films
summary: We investigate the thickness-dependent surface morphology and electrical transport of ultrathin amorphous Mo50Si50 films deposited by magnetron co-sputtering. Atomic force microscopy of Si-capped heterostructures on Si/SiO2 reveals smooth surfaces throughout the investigated thickness range, with RMS roughness below 0.2 nm and a non-monotonic thickness dependence characterized by a minimum at 1.92 nm. Room-temperature sheet resistance follows an approximately inverse-thickness dependence for films with nominal thicknesses of about 1.9-5 nm, whereas a pronounced deviation from this scaling develops below approximately 1.5-2 nm. Temperature-dependent measurements further reveal a superconducting transition in the 30-nm film, while the 1.54-nm film shows a strong resistance increase upon cooling clearly indicates a superconductor-insulator transition. In the 2-20 K range, the sheet conductance of the 1.54-nm film exhibits a reproducible logarithmic temperature dependence, Gs(T)=G0+Bln(T/T0), consistent with quantum corrections to diffusive transport in a strongly disordered quasi-two-dimensional conductor. These results identify a thickness-sensitive transport regime in ultrathin MoSi while demonstrating that the corresponding heterostructures retain comparatively smooth surface morphology.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁控共溅射超薄非晶Mo50Si50薄膜的厚度依赖表面形貌与电输运，发现约1.5–2 nm以下出现偏离反厚度标度的强无序二维输运及超导—绝缘转变，同时Si覆盖异质结表面仍保持平滑。
AI.motivation: 探究超薄非晶MoSi薄膜在厚度减小至纳米尺度时表面形貌和电输运如何演化，尤其是强无序准二维体系中可能出现的超导—绝缘转变和量子修正输运。
AI.method: 采用磁控共溅射沉积Mo50Si50薄膜，利用AFM表征Si/SiO2衬底上Si覆盖异质结的表面形貌，并进行室温薄层电阻和变温电输运测量，分析厚度与温度依赖关系。
AI.result: AFM显示所研究厚度范围内表面平滑，RMS粗糙度低于0.2 nm，且在1.92 nm处出现非单调最小；约1.9–5 nm薄膜的室温薄层电阻近似随厚度反比变化，但低于约1.5–2 nm时明显偏离；30 nm薄膜出现超导转变，1.54 nm薄膜降温电阻显著增大，表明超导—绝缘转变；1.54 nm薄膜在2–20 K范围内薄层电导呈可重复的对数温度依赖Gs(T)=G0+Bln(T/T0)，符合强无序准二维扩散输运的量子修正。
AI.conclusion: 超薄MoSi中存在对厚度敏感的输运区间，可观察到从超导到绝缘的转变及准二维量子修正输运，同时相应Si覆盖异质结仍保持较平滑的表面形貌。

title: Tuning of superconducting and physical properties of Mo$_{1-x}$Si$_x$ thin films for Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector Applications
summary: We investigate the normal-state electrical properties of ultrathin amorphous Mo$_{1-x}$Si$_x$ films deposited by DC magnetron co-sputtering over a broad range of compositions and thicknesses. Films with Si contents of $x = 0.14$ to $0.5$ were deposited on Si/SiO$_2$ and Si/Si$_3$N$_4$ substrates (monocrystalline Si with SiO$_2$ and S$_3$N$_4$ buffer layers respectfully); X-ray diffraction confirms an amorphous structure across the full composition range, while X-ray reflectometry is used to verify film thicknesses. The room-temperature sheet resistance ranges from 110 to 1990 $\Omega/\square$, corresponding to resistivities of 125-478 $\mu\Omega\cdot$cm. The sheet resistance generally increases with increasing Si content and decreasing film thickness, although the coupled variation of composition and thickness limits the quantitative separation of these effects. Additional measurements on thicker reference films show superconducting transition temperatures between 5.2 and 7.7 K, with $T_c$ decreasing monotonically at higher Si contents. A comparison of films on different substrate types shows no systematic difference between Si/SiO$_2$ and Si/Si$_3$N$_4$, while films on Al$_2$O$_3$ exhibit elevated sheet resistance at the lower thicknesses. These results characterize the accessible parameter space of our deposition process and provide a basis for the selection of film stoichiometry for detector fabrication.

AI.tldr: 研究了DC磁控共溅射超薄非晶Mo$_{1-x}$Si$_x$薄膜的正常态电学性质，覆盖宽成分与厚度范围，并建立沉积工艺的可达参数空间。
AI.motivation: 为探测器制造中选择合适的MoSi薄膜化学计量比提供依据，并理解Si含量、膜厚和衬底类型对正常态电学性能的影响。
AI.method: 采用DC磁控共溅射在Si/SiO$_2$和Si/Si$_3$N$_4$等衬底上沉积x=0.14~0.5的Mo$_{1-x}$Si$_x$薄膜；用X射线衍射确认非晶结构，用X射线反射测量厚度；测量室温方块电阻和电阻率，并对较厚参考膜测量超导转变温度，比较不同衬底的影响。
AI.result: 室温方块电阻为110~1990 Ω/□，对应电阻率125~478 μΩ·cm；方块电阻总体随Si含量增加和膜厚减小而升高，但成分与厚度耦合变化限制了对二者影响的定量分离。较厚参考膜的$T_c$为5.2~7.7 K，并随Si含量增加单调降低。Si/SiO$_2$与Si/Si$_3$N$_4$衬底间无系统差异，而Al$_2$O$_3$衬底上较低厚度薄膜的方块电阻升高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表征了沉积工艺的可达参数空间，为探测器制备中MoSi薄膜化学计量比的选择提供了基础。

title: Nonempirical Determination of the Optimal TAO-DFT Fictitious Temperature for Molecular Systems in the Lowest Singlet State
summary: Thermally-assisted-occupation density functional theory (TAO-DFT) [J.-D. Chai, J. Chem. Phys., 2012, ${\bf 136}$, 154104] has been developed to investigate the ground-state properties of large electronic systems exhibiting varying multi-reference (MR) character. As a central parameter in TAO-DFT, the fictitious temperature $\theta$ is closely linked to the degree of static correlation in an electronic system. While the conventional system-independent $\theta$-scheme is computationally efficient and broadly applicable, a fixed, preassigned $\theta$ can be overly large for single-reference (SR) systems yet too small for strongly MR systems. To overcome this limitation, we propose a nonempirical scheme based on spin-symmetry restoration to determine the optimal system-dependent fictitious temperature $\theta^{*}$ for molecular systems in their lowest singlet states. Across benchmark tests encompassing both MR systems (the bond dissociation of H$_{2}$, N$_{2}$, Li$_{2}$, and LiH, as well as the torsional rotation of twisted ethylene) and pure SR systems (the dissociation of He$_{2}$ and Ne$_{2}$), our nonempirical approach demonstrates superior overall accuracy compared with the conventional fixed-$\theta$ scheme. Furthermore, relative to standard Kohn-Sham density functional theory (TAO-DFT with $\theta = 0$), TAO-DFT employing $\theta^{*}$ yields substantial improvements for MR systems while preserving comparable accuracy in SR systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于自旋对称性恢复的非经验方案，为最低单重态分子体系确定体系依赖的最优虚拟温度 θ*，以改进 TAO-DFT 对多参考与单参考体系的总体描述。
AI.motivation: TAO-DFT 中固定的体系无关虚拟温度 θ 计算高效且通用，但对单参考体系可能过大、对强多参考体系可能过小，难以同时准确处理不同静态相关程度。
AI.method: 以自旋对称性恢复为依据，非经验地确定每个分子体系在其最低单重态下的最优 θ*，并在多参考体系（H2、N2、Li2、LiH 键解离及扭曲乙烯扭转）和纯单参考体系（He2、Ne2 解离）上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 与常规固定 θ 方案相比，θ* 方案总体精度更高；相对于标准 Kohn-Sham DFT（即 θ=0 的 TAO-DFT），θ* 方案显著改善多参考体系，同时在单参考体系中保持可比精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于自旋对称性恢复的体系依赖 θ* 方案克服了固定 θ 的局限，能更均衡地处理多参考与单参考分子体系，提升 TAO-DFT 的整体适用性和准确性。

title: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
summary: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The pipeline proposed 19,576 records; a cascade of gates rejected 659,252 field-level extractions, 644,438 of them for want of verbatim evidence, 13,121 because the text does not attach the value to the material, and 1,693 because the source sentence reads as a calculation. The database that survives holds 3,137 material records, each with the sentence its value came from. An audit of the survivors by two independent models, on 500 records drawn in proportion to the database, shows that the gates remove the errors that are mechanical: in 93.4% of the audited records the value is in the text and the text is about the compound the record names, and 91.8% of them are measurements rather than predictions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个用LLM从文献中抽取超导材料数据、并对每个数值进行源文核验的流水线，最终保留3,137条带出处句子的材料记录。
AI.motivation: 超导材料数据散见于论文的正文、表格和图中，LLM可读取文献并构建数据库，但关键难题是可信度：数值可能归属错误、计算值未标注、原文本身可能有误。
AI.method: 流水线用LLM抽取超导材料记录，并设置级联校验门控：检查逐字证据、数值是否与材料关联、句子是否表示计算；随后由两个独立模型按数据库比例抽取500条记录进行审计。
AI.result: 流水线提出19,576条记录；门控拒绝659,252条字段级抽取，其中644,438条缺少逐字证据，13,121条文本未将数值关联到材料，1,693条源句读作计算。最终数据库含3,137条材料记录。审计显示93.4%的记录数值在文本中且文本针对所命名化合物，91.8%为测量而非预测。
AI.conclusion: 源文核验门控能有效去除机械性错误并生成带出处句子的超导材料数据库，但审计比例未达100%，说明自动检查仍不能完全保证数据正确性，需进一步验证。

title: Accelerating interatomic potential development through student-driven exploration and reliability-aware distillation
summary: Conventional two-stage distillation first establishes a teacher through teacher-driven configuration exploration, a costly first stage for complex materials, and then uses its predictions to supervise students, potentially propagating teacher-label errors. Here, we propose distillation-driven teacher-student co-evolution (DICE), which uses a fast student to accelerate configuration exploration and replaces the fixed teacher-to-student sequence with alternating student and teacher updates. A representation-based support-assessment algorithm routes high-support configurations to teacher labelling and selects low-support configurations for density functional theory (DFT) calculations to update the teacher, thereby reducing the risk of teacher-label error propagation to students. Across Al2O3 (structural ceramics), yttria-stabilised zirconia (solid electrolytes) and MIL-120(Al) (a metal-organic framework), DICE develops reliable compact potentials using only 140-494 target DFT reference configurations per system; total recorded student exploration times per system are just 2.6-5.1% of the corresponding teacher-driven estimates. Combining computational efficiency with broad applicability across diverse material systems, DICE provides a practical route to developing reliable compact interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 提出蒸馏驱动的师生协同演化方法DICE，用快速学生模型加速构型探索并交替更新师生，减少教师标签错误传播，从而高效开发可靠的紧凑型原子间势。
AI.motivation: 传统两阶段蒸馏需先通过教师驱动的构型探索建立教师模型，对复杂材料成本高；随后用教师预测监督学生，可能传播教师标签错误。
AI.method: DICE以快速学生模型加速构型探索，并用师生交替更新替代固定教师到学生的单向流程；采用基于表示的支持度评估算法，将高支持度构型路由给教师标注，将低支持度构型用于DFT计算以更新教师。
AI.result: 在Al2O3结构陶瓷、氧化钇稳定氧化锆固体电解质和MIL-120(Al)金属有机框架上，DICE每体系仅需140-494个目标DFT参考构型即可开发可靠紧凑势；每体系记录的学生探索总时间仅为教师驱动估计的2.6-5.1%。
AI.conclusion: DICE兼顾计算效率与跨材料体系适用性，为开发可靠紧凑型原子间势提供了实用路线。

title: A response-based self-energy from equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory and its reduction to GW, GW+SOSEX, and GF2
summary: We construct a frequency-dependent one-particle correlation self-energy by coupling a reference Green's function to the neutral excitation response obtained from equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory with singles and doubles (EOM-CCSD). Direct, mixed direct-antisymmetrized, and fully antisymmetrized choices of the external interaction vertices define three approximations, all admitting an explicit spectral representation without numerical frequency integration. In the bare-state limit, the mixed and fully antisymmetrized forms recover second-order Green's-function theory (GF2), whereas the direct form retains only its ring contribution. With a direct random-phase approximation (RPA) response, the direct and mixed forms reduce to $G_0W_0$ and $G_0W_0$ plus second-order screened exchange (SOSEX), respectively. For molecular ionization potentials, replacing the RPA response by EOM-CCSD generally lowers the ionization energies, whereas introducing exchange at one external vertex raises them. These substantial opposing effects partially compensate, although the mixed approximation does not systematically improve upon conventional $G_0W_0$, either against IP-EOM-CCSD or QUESTDB reference energies (aug-cc-pVDZ mean absolute errors relative to the QUESTDB theoretical best estimates: 0.45 vs 0.36~eV). A third-order perturbative analysis reveals that the three approximations retain different contributions and weights of particle-hole diagrams while omitting explicit particle-particle and hole-hole ladder contributions and the static self-energy. In particular, the fully antisymmetrized form recovers GF2 at second order but assigns incorrect weights to its retained third-order diagrams. These findings highlight the importance of a balanced treatment of screening and vertex corrections in constructing accurate self-energy approximations.

AI.tldr: 该工作将参考格林函数与EOM-CCSD中性激发响应耦合，构造频率相关的单粒子关联自能，并比较三种外相互作用顶点近似；结果显示EOM-CCSD响应与交换顶点效应部分抵消，混合近似并未系统优于传统G0W0。
AI.motivation: 旨在超越传统G0W0中基于RPA的屏蔽描述，利用EOM-CCSD提供的中性激发响应改进频率相关自能，并厘清屏蔽与顶点修正在自能近似中的平衡作用。
AI.method: 以参考格林函数与EOM-CCSD响应耦合构造频率相关关联自能；采用直接、混合直接-反对称化和完全反对称化三种外顶点，均具显式谱表示而无需数值频率积分；在裸态极限及直接RPA响应下分析其与GF2、G0W0和G0W0+SOSEX的关系，并进行分子电离能计算和三阶微扰分析。
AI.result: 裸态极限下混合与完全反对称形式恢复GF2，直接形式仅保留环图贡献；直接RPA响应下直接与混合形式分别退化为G0W0和G0W0+SOSEX。对分子电离能，EOM-CCSD响应替代RPA通常降低电离能，而单外顶点引入交换会升高电离能，二者部分抵消；混合近似相对IP-EOM-CCSD或QUESTDB并未系统改善，aug-cc-pVDZ下相对QUESTDB理论最佳估计的MAE为0.45 eV，而传统G0W0为0.36 eV。三阶微扰分析表明三种近似保留不同的粒子-空穴图贡献与权重，但省略显式粒子-粒子/空穴-空穴阶梯图和静态自能；完全反对称形式虽在二阶恢复GF2，却对保留的三阶图赋予不正确权重。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，构建高精度自能近似需要平衡处理屏蔽与顶点修正；仅以EOM-CCSD响应替换RPA或局部引入交换并不能保证系统改进，三阶图权重和缺失的阶梯/静态自能项仍是关键限制。

title: Strain-induced non-trivial band topology and large magnetoresistance in epitaxial SrTaO$_3$ thin films
summary: Epitaxial thin films of complex transition metal oxides constitute an ideal platform for realizing correlated topological phases through strain engineering of crystal symmetry and band topology. Here, we investigate the electronic transport properties and the band structure of the 5$d^1$ paramagnetic metal SrTaO$_3$ thin film under epitaxial compressive strain. The film exhibits a large non-saturating quasi-quadratic magnetoresistance (MR) and a nonlinear Hall effect characteristic of two-band transport, together with the field induced re-entrant metallic behavior. The violation of Kohler's scaling further corroborates the scattering from multiple bands. Semiclassical two-band analysis yields carrier densities and mobilities of the order $\sim 10^{21}~\mathrm{cm^{-3}}$ and $\sim 10^{4}~\mathrm{cm^2 V^{-1} s^{-1}}$, respectively. The observed large mobility and unsaturated MR, indicates the presence of a non-trivial band structure. Consistent with this, results from density functional theory calculations and tight binding model studies reveal that the stable structure has an octahedral rotation $a^0a^0c^+$, where the non-symmorphic symmetry ensures the presence of topological nodal lines yielding finite Berry curvature in the vicinity of the Fermi level. Besides the nodal line, trivial electron and hole pockets exist near the Fermi level, contributing to electron transport. These findings establish that epitaxial strain drives SrTaO$_3$ into a nontrivial topological semimetal, a phase inaccessible in the bulk counterpart.

AI.tldr: 外延压应变调控5d^1顺磁金属SrTaO3薄膜，使其呈现多带输运、大非饱和磁阻及拓扑节线半金属特征。
AI.motivation: 复杂过渡金属氧化物外延薄膜可通过应变调控晶格对称性与能带拓扑，是实现关联拓扑相的理想平台；作者希望探索SrTaO3薄膜在压应变下能否获得体材料中不可及的拓扑半金属相。
AI.method: 对受外延压应变的SrTaO3薄膜开展电子输运测量与能带结构研究，结合双带半经典分析、Kohler定则检验、密度泛函理论计算和紧束缚模型。
AI.result: 薄膜表现出大且非饱和的准二次磁阻、双带输运特征的非线性霍尔效应以及场致再入金属行为，并违反Kohler标度；双带分析给出载流子密度约10^21 cm^-3、迁移率约10^4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1。理论表明稳定结构具有a^0a^0c^+八面体旋转，非对称群对称性保证费米能级附近存在拓扑节线并产生有限贝里曲率，同时存在琐碎的电子/空穴口袋参与输运。
AI.conclusion: 外延压应变将SrTaO3驱动为一种非平庸拓扑半金属，该相在体材料中不可获得，凸显了应变工程在氧化物中实现拓扑输运与关联拓扑相的作用。

title: Magneto-ARPES as a direct probe of Berry Curvature and the Orbital Magnetic Moment
summary: The Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment are central to the understanding of electronic transport phenomena such as the anomalous Hall effect, yet measuring these quantities directly with momentum resolution remains experimentally challenging. Here we show that angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements in a weak magnetic field (magneto-ARPES) provide a direct route to both quantities. We develop an analytic theory of photoemission in a weak magnetic field and show that, for any material, the first-order change in photoemission intensity is directly proportional to both the Berry curvature and the orbital magnetic moment, even in the presence of self-energy effects. For linearly polarised light, the matrix elements are unchanged to first order in the field, so the intensity change directly reflects these quantities. Using monolayer WSe$_2$ as an example, we show how both quantities can be extracted in a typical experiment. This finding thus points to magneto-ARPES as a general route for measuring the momentum-resolved Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并理论证明，弱磁场下的角分辨光电子能谱（magneto-ARPES）可直接测量动量分辨的Berry曲率与轨道磁矩。
AI.motivation: Berry曲率和轨道磁矩是理解反常霍尔效应等输运现象的核心量，但现有实验难以对其进行动量分辨的直接测量。
AI.method: 作者建立弱磁场下光电子发射的解析理论，证明光电子强度的一阶磁场变化正比于Berry曲率和轨道磁矩，且自能效应不影响该结论；在线偏振光下，矩阵元到磁场一阶不变，因此强度变化直接反映这两个量，并以单层WSe2为例说明提取方法。
AI.result: 理论表明，对任意材料，弱磁场引起的ARPES强度一阶变化同时包含Berry曲率和轨道磁矩信息；在单层WSe2示例中，二者可在典型实验中提取。
AI.conclusion: Magneto-ARPES可作为测量量子材料中动量分辨Berry曲率和轨道磁矩的通用实验途径。

title: Symmetry classes of hyperdeterminant wavefunctions: Application to phase transitions between a bosonic fractional Chern insulator and superfluids
summary: We study a phase transition between a superfluid phase and a fractional Chern insulator phase in a hard-core boson model on the honeycomb lattice using symmetric hyperdeterminant (Hdet) wavefunctions. Combining projective symmetry group analysis with variational Monte Carlo, we construct and optimize Hdet states in various symmetry classes. Based on the associated effective theories, we show that different symmetry classes, i.e., representations of the projective symmetry group, describe specific quantum phases. Compared with traditional fermionic parton construction, the symmetric Hdet wavefunctions are shown to improve microscopics significantly, allowing quantitative investigation of quantum phase diagrams. We argue that, in contrast with the common belief, this putative continuous phase transition is described by a fluctuating $SU(2)_g$ gauge field coupling with four Dirac nodes forming two $SU(2)_g$ doublets (i.e., $N_f=2$ QCD).

AI.tldr: 该文用对称超行列式波函数研究蜂窝晶格硬核玻色子模型中超流相与分数量子陈绝缘体相之间的相变，并提出该相变由 SU(2)_g 规范场耦合四个狄拉克节点形成的 N_f=2 QCD 描述。
AI.motivation: 厘清超流相与分数量子陈绝缘体相之间相变的微观本质，并检验通常认为该相变为连续相变的观点。
AI.method: 构造并优化蜂窝晶格硬核玻色子模型的对称超行列式（Hdet）波函数；结合投影对称群（PSG）分析与变分蒙特卡洛（VMC），按不同对称类优化 Hdet 态；借助对应有效理论识别各 PSG 表示所描述的量子相，并与传统费米子部分子构造比较。
AI.result: 对称 Hdet 波函数显著改善微观描述，使量子相图可定量研究；不同 PSG 对称类对应特定量子相；该超流—分数量子陈绝缘体相变并非通常认为的简单连续相变，而由涨落的 SU(2)_g 规范场耦合四个狄拉克节点描述，这些节点组成两个 SU(2)_g 双重态，即 N_f=2 QCD。
AI.conclusion: 对称 Hdet 波函数为硬核玻色子体系中超流—分数量子陈绝缘体相变提供定量变分研究框架，并表明其临界理论为 N_f=2 QCD 型 SU(2)_g 规范涨落理论。

title: Competing magnetic correlations in the square-lattice Hubbard model with spin-dependent nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor hopping
summary: Altermagnets have spin-split bands without net magnetization. The splitting can come from a spin-dependent nearest-neighbor (NN) hopping anisotropy $t_A$ or from a spin-dependent next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) hopping $t'$. Both change sign under a $90^\circ$ rotation and are present together when the lattice has no mirror planes, yet they have so far been studied only separately. Here we study the two-dimensional square-lattice Hubbard model with both $t_A$ and $t'$, using constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo at $U=4t$ and scanning the electron filling $n$, $t_A$ and $t'$. We find four types of magnetic correlations: N\'eel, stripe, diagonal, and spiral spin-density-wave. The phase diagram depends on both hoppings together. Diagonal correlations require finite $t_A$ and are suppressed by $t'$. Stripe correlations appear only once $t'$ is large enough to overcome the diagonal tendency set by $t_A$. N\'eel correlations survive at large $t_A$ and large $t'$, where the NNN model alone gives stripe or spiral correlations. The noninteracting susceptibility matches the dominant wavevector at small $t'$, but not the N\'eel correlations at $t'\geq0.3$, which come from the interaction. Finite-size scaling with three lattice sizes is consistent with long-range order only near half filling; at the stripe, spiral and diagonal points we tested, the structure factor per site extrapolates to zero. The joint behavior persists up to $U=6t$.

AI.tldr: 研究同时包含最近邻自旋相关跃迁各向异性 $t_A$ 与次近邻 $t'$ 的二维方格子Hubbard模型，发现磁关联相图由二者共同决定，并出现Néel、条纹、对角和螺旋自旋密度波四类关联。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体虽无净磁化但具有自旋劈裂能带，其劈裂可来自 $t_A$ 或 $t'$；二者在 $90^\circ$ 旋转下均变号，且在无镜面格子中可共存，但此前多被分别研究。
AI.method: 采用约束路径量子蒙特卡洛方法研究二维方格子Hubbard模型，固定 $U=4t$，同时引入 $t_A$ 和 $t'$，扫描电子填充 $n$、$t_A$ 与 $t'$，并结合无相互作用磁化率与三种晶格尺寸的有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 识别出Néel、条纹、对角和螺旋自旋密度波四类磁关联；对角关联需要有限 $t_A$ 且被 $t'$ 抑制，条纹关联仅在 $t'$ 足够大以克服 $t_A$ 诱导的对角倾向时出现，而Néel关联在 $t_A$ 和 $t'$ 均较大时仍可存活。小 $t'$ 时无相互作用磁化率可匹配主导波矢，但 $t'\geq0.3$ 的Néel关联来自相互作用。有限尺寸标度表明仅靠近半填充时与长程有序一致；所测试的条纹、螺旋和对角点中每格点结构因子外推为零。该联合行为可延续至 $U=6t$。
AI.conclusion: $t_A$ 与 $t'$ 的联合效应是决定交错磁关联相图的关键；相互作用可产生无相互作用磁化率无法解释的Néel关联，而条纹、螺旋和对角关联在所测参数下未显示长程有序。

title: Hartree--Fock analysis of the bilayer Hubbard model
summary: We study the half-filled Hubbard model on two parallel square lattices with on-site repulsion $U>0$ and with nearest-neighbor hopping specified by a constant $t>0$ within each plane and by another constant $t_\perp \geq 0$ between the planes. Working in the Hartree--Fock approximation, we obtain asymptotic formulas for the N\'eel temperature and the antiferromagnetic gap ratio in the weak coupling limit. We also determine the behavior of the antiferromagnetic gap ratio near the critical curve separating the paramagnetic and antiferromagnetic regions in the phase diagram. Furthermore, we present numerical phase diagrams away from half-filling, and we make an analytical conjecture regarding their structure.

AI.tldr: 在Hartree-Fock近似下研究双层平行方格半满Hubbard模型的弱耦合反铁磁性与相图。
AI.motivation: 考察层间跃迁 t_perp 对双层Hubbard模型反铁磁序、Néel温度、能隙及相图结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用Hartree-Fock近似；在弱耦合极限下推导渐近公式；计算偏离半满时的数值相图，并对相图结构提出解析猜想。
AI.result: 得到Néel温度和反铁磁能隙比的弱耦合渐近公式；确定能隙比在顺磁-反铁磁临界曲线附近的行为；给出偏离半满的数值相图。
AI.conclusion: 双层Hubbard模型的反铁磁相变和能隙在弱耦合及临界区域具有可解析描述，数值相图支持关于其结构的一般性猜想。

title: Finite-size reversal of a multiparticle correction to local spin spectra in a flux-disordered Kitaev honeycomb model
summary: A spin flip in the Kitaev honeycomb model changes the flux background and therefore the Hamiltonian seen by the matter fermions. Can a one-particle approximation with the correct total spin intensity nevertheless misestimate the depth of a depression in the local spin spectrum? We test this question in a frozen, flux-disordered ensemble by retaining the actual one-particle transition energies and relative spectral weights after the spin flip, then rescaling those weights to match the full intensity. We measure the depression by subtracting the central intensity from the average at two flanking frequencies. For spin-created states with odd final quasiparticle number and nonzero one-particle weight, restoring multiparticle weight shallows the depression on 24 sites and deepens it on both 1,536-site shapes and the 3,456- and 6,144-site tori, as judged by the median paired correction at each of two energy resolutions. For these states, the one-particle approximation overestimates the mean dip depth by about 16-18% on 24 sites and underestimates it by 33-56% in the 6,144-site sample. Extrapolating from 24 sites would therefore give the wrong sign for this correction on those four larger tori under the same disorder prescription.

AI.tldr: 在Kitaev蜂窝模型中检验“总自旋强度正确的一粒子近似”是否会误估局域自旋谱凹陷深度；结果显示恢复多粒子权重后的修正符号随体系增大而反转，从小尺寸外推会得到错误符号。
AI.motivation: 自旋翻转会改变通量背景，进而改变物质费米子所感受到的哈密顿量；因此需要判断在总强度归一正确但忽略多粒子权重时，一粒子近似能否可靠描述局域自旋谱的凹陷深度。
AI.method: 在冻结的通量无序系综中，保留自旋翻转后实际的单粒子跃迁能量与相对谱权重，再重标定这些权重以匹配全强度；用中心强度减去两个侧翼频率平均强度来度量凹陷，并在两种能量分辨率下比较配对修正的中位数；体系包括24格点、两种1536格点形状以及3456和6144格点环面。
AI.result: 对于末态准粒子数为奇数且单粒子权重非零的自旋产生态，恢复多粒子权重在24格点上使凹陷变浅，而在两种1536格点形状及3456和6144格点环面上使凹陷变深；一粒子近似在24格点上高估平均凹陷约16-18%，在6144格点样本中低估约33-56%。
AI.conclusion: 即使总自旋强度正确，一粒子近似也可能定量甚至定性误估局域自旋谱凹陷深度；从24格点外推会在四个较大环面上给出与直接计算相反的修正符号。

title: A Fiber-Optic Platform for Cryogenic Laser-Pump Neutron-Probe Magneto-Optical Measurements
summary: We report a fiber-optic laser-pump neutron-probe method for momentum- and frequency-resolved magneto-optical measurements. The technique uses inelastic neutron scattering to measure time-dependent two-point magnetization correlations, S(Q,$\omega$), after resonant photoexcitation at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate it by measuring nonequilibrium thermalization dynamics in Yb-based quantum magnets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种光纤激光泵浦-中子探测方法，可在低温下实现动量与频率分辨的磁光测量，并用于研究Yb基量子磁体的非平衡热化动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有手段难以在光激发后同时获得动量与频率分辨的磁化关联信息，需要将光学泵浦与中子散射探测结合以研究非平衡磁性动力学。
AI.method: 采用光纤导入激光进行共振光激发，并在低温下用非弹性中子散射测量时间依赖的两点磁化关联函数S(Q,ω)。
AI.result: 在Yb基量子磁体中演示了该技术，观测到光激发后的非平衡热化动力学。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了动量与频率分辨的激光泵浦-中子探测磁光测量方法，为研究量子磁体非平衡动力学提供新途径。

title: Quantum-Metric-Driven Hollow Wigner Crystals
summary: Recent studies have revealed the profound influence of Berry curvature on electron crystallization, yet the independent role of the quantum metric remains unclear. Here, we introduce a minimal three-band continuum model with separately tunable quantum metric and Berry flux. Employing the Hartree-Fock approach, we find that a conventional s-wave Wigner crystal can develop a hollow charge distribution with depleted density at lattice sites, without a change in symmetry or topology. We show that this density reconstruction occurs even at vanishing Berry curvature and arises from strong quantum metric and the nontrivial angular structure of the form factor. In our model, the continuous crossover between hollow and conventional WCs is accompanied by anomalous direct exchange interactions, nearly vanishing at intermediate quantum metric but enhanced by over an order of magnitude in the strong-metric regime. These results reveal how quantum metric can reshape both the charge distribution and exchange interactions of electron crystals beyond simple wave-function delocalization.

AI.tldr: 该文通过可独立调控量子度规与Berry通量的三带连续模型，发现量子度规可在不改变对称性和拓扑的情况下，将常规s波Wigner晶体重构为空心电荷分布，并显著改变交换相互作用。
AI.motivation: Berry曲率对电子结晶的影响已被广泛研究，但量子度规在其中独立作用仍不清楚，作者希望分离并揭示量子度规对Wigner晶体电荷分布和相互作用的直接影响。
AI.method: 构建最小三带连续模型，分别可调量子度规和Berry通量；采用Hartree-Fock方法研究电子结晶态，并分析电荷密度重构、形状因子角结构及直接交换相互作用。
AI.result: 常规s波Wigner晶体可演化为晶格位点密度耗尽的空心Wigner晶体，且对称性和拓扑不变；该重构在Berry曲率为零时仍发生，源于强量子度规和形状因子的非平凡角结构。空心态与常规态之间为连续过渡，伴随异常直接交换相互作用：中等量子度规下近乎消失，强量子度规区增强超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 量子度规不仅能通过波函数离域化影响电子晶体，还能独立重塑Wigner晶体的电荷分布和交换相互作用，超越传统波函数离域化图像。

title: Ground-State Manifold Curvature and Phase Transitions in the Kitaev Honeycomb Model
summary: The Kitaev honeycomb model is an exactly solvable spin model whose ground state realizes a quantum spin liquid with gapped Abelian phases and a gapless phase that becomes a non-Abelian phase in a magnetic field. Here we study its phase transitions through the geometry of the ground-state manifold, using the Ricci scalar of the quantum metric. In the three gapped phases we obtain closed-form expressions for the curvature, which is negative and diverges at the critical lines; the three phases are related to one another by an exact change of coordinates. In the gapless phase, the curvature of the infrared-regularized metric is positive and decays inversely with the logarithm of the system size, with a size-independent amplitude that diverges at the phase boundaries, with an exponent different from that of the gapped side. The change of sign and the divergences together reproduce the complete phase diagram. A magnetic field gaps out the gapless phase and plays the role of the infrared cutoff, so that away from the critical lines the curvature of the non-Abelian phase becomes finite and positive, while around the critical lines it opens a crossover region whose width scales quadratically with the field. Since divergences of geometric quantities are often regarded as signatures of phase transitions, the divergence of the Ricci scalar at the critical lines provides a geometric signature of these transitions.

AI.tldr: 该文利用量子度规的Ricci标量研究Kitaev蜂窝模型的基态流形几何，并据此刻画其完整相图与相变。
AI.motivation: Kitaev蜂窝模型基态可实现量子自旋液体，包含有能隙Abelian相、无能隙相及磁场下的非Abelian相；作者希望从基态流形几何而非仅能谱角度给出相变的几何判据。
AI.method: 计算量子度规的Ricci标量：对有能隙三相给出闭合表达式；对无能隙相采用红外正则化度规；并分析磁场作为红外截断对非Abelian相曲率及临界线附近交叉区域的影响。
AI.result: 有能隙三相的曲率为负，在临界线发散，且三相间存在精确坐标变换联系；无能隙相曲率为正，随系统尺寸对数反比衰减，其振幅在相边界发散且指数不同于有能隙侧；曲率符号变化与发散共同复现完整相图；磁场使无能隙相开隙并充当红外截断，使非Abelian相远离临界线时曲率有限且为正，临界线附近交叉区宽度随场强二次缩放。
AI.conclusion: Ricci标量在临界线的发散提供了这些相变的几何特征，表明基态流形曲率可作为识别Kitaev模型相变及区分不同相的有力几何工具。

title: Exact many-body scars of generic spin models from singlet covers
summary: The square-lattice transverse-field Ising model has exact zero-energy eigenstates at any field: products of singlets on alternate plaquette diagonals. A longitudinal field isolates them from a symmetry-protected degeneracy. The mechanism is that a site coupled equally to both ends of a singlet annihilates it. The result thus holds for any spin $s$, anisotropic exchange, a large class of bond disorder and certain three-spin terms. This mechanism decides which lattices host such states: two of the 11 Archimedean lattices (four at $s=1/2$), bcc and quasicrystals with spins on the edges. Singlet pumping cools any state into them.

AI.tldr: 该文指出方格横场Ising模型中存在由交替方格对角线上的单重态乘积构成的精确零能本征态，并给出其普适形成机制与晶格判据。
AI.motivation: 寻找无需精细调参的精确零能本征态，并澄清纵向场如何解除对称保护简并、使这些态可被隔离和利用。
AI.method: 构造单重态乘积态；利用“一个格点若等强耦合到单重态两端则将其湮灭”的局域相消机制，分析纵向场作用，并将结论推广到任意自旋、各向异性交换、大范围键无序及特定三自旋项，进而判定哪些晶格可承载此类态。
AI.result: 该机制给出任意横场下的精确零能态；纵向场可将其从对称保护简并中隔离；适用晶格包括11种Archimedean晶格中的2种（s=1/2时为4种）、bcc晶格以及自旋位于边上的准晶；单重态泵浦可将任意态冷却到这些态。
AI.conclusion: 单重态被两端等强耦合所湮灭是统一而普适的机制，可指导在多种自旋、相互作用与晶格中寻找并制备精确零能单重态乘积态。

title: Projecting Fermions into Exact Scar Towers: Local Protection across Phase Transitions
summary: We construct exact scar towers in $SO(n)$ ($n\ge3$) spin chains by Gutzwiller projection of $n$-flavor flat-band Kitaev chains. The projected roots have only singlet and antisymmetric components on each bond. These local constraints allow a staggered flavor flip to generate an equidistant tower. The root and its first descendant exhaust the two-site configurations that are visited by the tower, leaving an orthogonal bond subspace unvisited. Deformations within this subspace can break $SO(n)$ symmetry and reshape the low-energy physics without altering the exact scar tower. A polarization-selective deformation drives an exact first-order transition from the symmetry-protected topological phase to a ferromagnetic phase. The tower retains its wave functions and absolute energies across the phase transition, including at the gapless point. Exact scars therefore need not inherit the symmetries, order parameters, or criticality of the ground state.

AI.tldr: 通过Gutzwiller投影n味平带Kitaev链，在SO(n)自旋链中构造精确scar塔，并证明其可在不改变波函数与能量的情况下跨越SPT到铁磁的一阶相变。
AI.motivation: 探究精确量子scar是否必然继承基态的对称性、序参量和临界性，并构建可调控的scar塔。
AI.method: 对n味平带Kitaev链作Gutzwiller投影得到SO(n)自旋链；利用投影根态每键仅含单态与反对称分量，以交错味翻转生成等间距scar塔；在scar未访问的正交键子空间内施加形变。
AI.result: 得到精确scar塔；极化选择性形变驱动从对称保护拓扑相到铁磁相的一阶相变，scar塔在相变及无能隙点保持波函数和绝对能量不变。
AI.conclusion: 精确scar无需继承基态的对称性、序参量或临界性，可与低能物理强烈解耦。

title: Critical Topology: A New Perspective for Phase Transitions
summary:
Critical topology has emerged as a form of quantum criticality beyond the Landau paradigm, challenging conventional approaches to classifying universality classes by introducing topological properties as an additional criterion. Despite substantial progress over the past five years, several fundamental questions remain open. Theoretically, can we establish a general criterion for the emergence of critical topology? Can a unified theoretical framework be extended beyond one-dimensional quantum many-body systems? What efficient numerical methods can be developed to investigate critical topological states in higher-dimensional strongly correlated systems? Experimentally, research has so far focused primarily on single-particle critical topology. An important next step is to realize and characterize many-body critical topology in quantum systems using platforms such as Rydberg atom arrays, superconducting quantum processors, and quantum materials.
  Major advances in statistical physics often arise from re-examining fundamental concepts. The theory of critical phenomena developed by Landau, Ginzburg, and Wilson, together with the topological phase transitions pioneered by Kosterlitz and Thouless, has now inspired new discoveries in artificial acoustic metamaterials. These experimental observations mark a beginning rather than an endpoint for research on critical topology, and further advances in this direction are anticipated.

AI.tldr: 该文是对“临界拓扑”这一超越Landau范式的量子临界性方向的展望，梳理其理论、数值与实验开放问题，并指出多体临界拓扑的实现与表征是下一步重点。
AI.motivation: 传统量子临界分类基于Landau范式，而临界拓扑将拓扑性质作为额外判据，可能定义新的普适类；尽管近五年进展显著，仍缺乏一般性判据、统一高维框架、高效数值方法及多体实验实现。
AI.method: 以观点/路线图形式总结理论、数值和实验挑战：建立临界拓扑出现的一般判据，发展超越一维的统一理论框架，开发高维强关联体系中临界拓扑态的高效数值方法，并利用Rydberg原子阵列、超导量子处理器和量子材料等平台进行实验实现与表征。
AI.result: 文章指出当前实验研究主要集中于单粒子临界拓扑，声学超材料中的拓扑相变实验是重要进展但仅为开端；多体临界拓扑的实验实现与表征仍待推进。
AI.conclusion: 临界拓扑是有前景的新兴方向，现有实验观察标志研究起步而非终点；未来需在理论判据、高维强关联数值方法和多体量子平台实验上取得进展。

title: Gyroidal Magnetic Order with Weyl Magnons
summary: The gyroid, a triply periodic minimal surface found widely in nature and materials, has remained largely unexplored as a design principle for magnetic order. We introduce gyroidal magnetic order on the hyperoctagon lattice, the skeletal network of the gyroid, in which each magnetic moment points along the local $C_3$ axis that coincides with the local normal to the gyroid surface. The resulting noncoplanar spin texture constitutes a direct magnetic imprint of the gyroid geometry. We show that this order can be stabilized by single-ion anisotropy, the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, or the symmetric off-diagonal $\Gamma$ interaction combined with the Kitaev interaction, and remains robust against quantum fluctuations. Its magnon spectrum hosts symmetry-enforced pseudospin-1 and pseudospin-1/2 Weyl points that, unlike their electronic counterparts, persist under symmetry-allowed perturbations. Our results establish the gyroid as a geometric platform for magnetic order and symmetry-enforced topological magnon excitations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在陀螺面（gyroid）骨架超八边形晶格上实现“陀螺磁性序”：磁矩沿局域C3轴（即陀螺面法向）排列，形成非共面自旋织构，并产生受对称性保护的赝自旋-1和赝自旋-1/2外尔磁子。
AI.motivation: 陀螺面在自然和材料中广泛存在，但作为磁序设计原则几乎未被探索；作者希望将陀螺面几何直接映射为磁有序，并研究其拓扑磁子激发。
AI.method: 在超八边形晶格上定义陀螺磁性序，使每个磁矩沿与陀螺面局域法向重合的局域C3轴指向；通过单离子各向异性、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，或对称非对角Γ相互作用与Kitaev相互作用组合来分析稳定性，并计算磁子谱。
AI.result: 该非共面自旋织构可由上述相互作用稳定，且对量子涨落鲁棒；其磁子谱中存在对称性强制保护的赝自旋-1和赝自旋-1/2外尔点，并且这些外尔点在对称性允许的微扰下仍保持稳定，不同于电子体系中的对应物。
AI.conclusion: 陀螺面可作为磁性有序的几何平台，并可承载对称性强制保护的拓扑磁子激发。

title: Quantum and classical transport in the underscreened Kondo lattice
summary: We investigate quantum effects in high-spin Kondo-lattice transport as resistivity approaches the classical spin-disorder limit. Using dynamical mean-field theory and the numerical renormalization group, we calculate resistivity, the Seebeck coefficient, and optical conductivity for the paramagnetic single-channel Kondo lattice away from half filling. At intermediate temperatures, the resistivity for large local spin $S$ approaches the double-exchange plateau. Thermopower retains a positive quantum excess even where resistivity is nearly classical. The excess arises from the transport kernel's particle-hole asymmetry. Even the full Kelvin approximation, often accurate for incoherent correlated metals, captures only part of it. Incomplete Kondo screening leaves residual moments and leads to singular Fermi-liquid behavior at low temperatures. For $S=1$, the apparent power-law resistivity is consistent with a $1/\ln^2(T_\rho/T)$ asymptote. Above the Kondo scale $T_K$, weak-coupling resistivity follows $1/\ln^2(T/T_K)$. Above the band and exchange scales, the charge susceptibility decreases as $1/T$, while the effective diffusion constant becomes nearly temperature independent, resulting in linear resistivity. A many-body coherent-potential approximation accounts for the spin dependence of the linear coefficient without adjustable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文用DMFT与NRG研究偏离半满的单通道近藤晶格在高自旋S下的顺磁输运，揭示电阻率接近经典自旋无序极限时仍存在显著量子修正，尤其是热电功率的正量子过量与低温奇异费米液体行为。
AI.motivation: 高自旋近藤晶格中，当电阻率接近经典自旋无序极限时，量子多体效应如何影响电阻率、Seebeck系数和光电导尚不清楚；需要区分经典自旋无序、双交换平台、近藤屏蔽及非相干金属输运，并理解热电功率和线性电阻率的微观来源。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结合数值重整化群（NRG），计算偏离半满的顺磁单通道近藤晶格的电阻率、Seebeck系数和光电导；分析大S极限、Kelvin近似、低温奇异费米液体渐近、高于T_K的弱耦合行为，并用多体相干势近似（CPA）处理自旋依赖的线性系数。
AI.result: 中间温度下，大S电阻率趋近双交换平台；即使电阻率近乎经典，热电势仍保留正量子过量，来源于输运核的粒子-空穴不对称，完整Kelvin近似也只能部分描述。非完全近藤屏蔽留下残余磁矩并导致低温奇异费米液体行为；S=1时表观幂律电阻率与1/ln^2(T_ρ/T)渐近一致，高于T_K时弱耦合电阻率遵循1/ln^2(T/T_K)。高于能带与交换尺度时，电荷磁化率按1/T下降，有效扩散常数近似不依赖温度，从而产生线性电阻率；多体CPA无需可调参数即可解释线性系数的自旋依赖。
AI.conclusion: 量子效应在电阻率接近经典自旋无序极限时仍不可忽略；热电势是探测输运核粒子-空穴不对称的敏感量。高自旋近藤晶格表现出从双交换/近藤区间到低温奇异费米液体及高温线性电阻率的跨区行为，多体CPA可定量联系自旋S与线性电阻率系数。

title: Lincege.jl: LINked Cluster Expansions on a GEneral GEometry
summary: The numerical linked-cluster expansion (NLCE) is a powerful tool for studying properties of quantum lattice models directly in the thermodynamic limit. Here, we introduce Lincege.jl, a versatile, efficient, and easy-to-use package for generating the clusters needed to perform the NLCE on a general finite or infinite lattice. Lincege.jl takes as input only the Bravais lattice vectors, the basis information, and the expansion unit and uses a depth-first search to efficiently generate clusters, their lattice constants, and the sub-cluster information. It outputs final coefficients of the series, expressed in terms of the extensive properties of the clusters, in different orders. The package also contains tools for visualizing the lattice and the generated clusters as well as a classical Ising model solver that can be used as a template for interfacing Lincege.jl with solvers of other lattice models. This package can be installed using the Julia package manager and utilized with example scripts from our GitHub repository at https://github.com/rightleftspin/Lincege.jl. The online documentation, including examples, can be found at https://rightleftspin.github.io/Lincege.jl/stable/.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍 Julia 软件包 Lincege.jl，用于为一般有限或无限晶格上的数值链接簇展开（NLCE）高效生成簇及相关级数系数。
AI.motivation: NLCE 是可直接在热力学极限下研究量子晶格模型性质的有力工具，但需要针对一般晶格高效生成簇、子簇和展开系数；作者希望提供一个通用、高效且易用的实现。
AI.method: Lincege.jl 仅需输入 Bravais 晶格矢量、基信息和展开单元，采用深度优先搜索生成簇、晶格常数及子簇信息，并按不同阶数输出以簇的广延性质表示的最终级数系数；包内还提供晶格与簇可视化工具，以及可作为与其他模型求解器对接模板的经典 Ising 模型求解器。
AI.result: 该包可通过 Julia 包管理器安装，示例脚本位于 GitHub 仓库，在线文档包含示例和使用说明。
AI.conclusion: Lincege.jl 为 NLCE 工作流提供了通用、高效且易扩展的工具，并便于与不同晶格模型求解器集成。

title: Anomalous Field-induced Coherence beyond Single-ion Kondo Physics
summary: The emergence of coherent heavy quasiparticles in Kondo lattices is generally accompanied by a reduction in electrical resistivity at low temperatures. However, certain strongly correlated metals exhibit anomalously large resistivities that persist to very low temperatures, raising fundamental questions about the mechanisms governing charge transport. Here, we report an unusual magnetic field-induced evolution of electronic transport and thermodynamic properties in a Ce-based heavy fermion compound, Ce$_{2}$Rh$_{3}$Ga$_{5}$. At zero field, Ce$_{2}$Rh$_{3}$Ga$_{5}$ undergoes a magnetic transition at $T$$_{0}$ = 0.45 K and exhibits a strongly enhanced low temperature specific heat coefficient, reaching $C$/$T$ = 2.2 J/mol$_{Ce}$-K$^{2}$, but no discernible coherence in its electrical resistivity. Remarkably, applying a magnetic field produces a large negative magnetoresistance and restores coherent metallic behavior, characterized by low-temperature $T$$^2$ resistivity. Although the field dependence of the electronic specific heat coefficient can be described phenomenologically within a single-ion Kondo framework, the same description fails to account for the strong suppression of the residual resistivity and the overall magnetoresistance. These results point to an additional field-sensitive scattering contribution beyond conventional single-ion Kondo physics. The striking resemblance to the long-standing anomalous magnetotransport behavior of UBe$_{13}$, without the complications introduced by superconductivity, establishes Ce$_{2}$Rh$_{3}$Ga$_{5}$ as a platform for investigating the microscopic origin of anomalous scattering and field-induced coherent transport in strongly correlated electron systems.

AI.tldr: Ce2Rh3Ga5在零场下表现出重费米子增强比热但电阻率无相干行为；磁场诱导大负磁阻并恢复低温T^2相干金属输运，揭示单离子Kondo之外的场敏感散射。
AI.motivation: 理解强关联金属中异常大且持续至低温的电阻率，以及Kondo晶格中相干重准粒子形成与电荷输运机制，特别是UBe13类异常磁输运的微观起源。
AI.method: 对Ce基重费米子化合物Ce2Rh3Ga5进行磁输运和热力学测量，包括零场与磁场下电阻率、磁阻和比热；分析C/T的场依赖及低温电阻率幂律，并与单离子Kondo框架比较。
AI.result: 零场下Ce2Rh3Ga5在T0=0.45 K发生磁转变，C/T达2.2 J/molCe-K^2，但电阻率无可辨相干；加场产生大负磁阻，恢复低温T^2电阻率并强烈抑制剩余电阻率。C/T场依赖可由单离子Kondo唯象描述，但该框架无法解释剩余电阻率和整体磁阻的抑制。
AI.conclusion: Ce2Rh3Ga5存在超出常规单离子Kondo物理的场敏感额外散射，且与UBe13的异常磁输运行为高度相似但无超导干扰，可作为研究强关联电子体系中异常散射和场诱导相干输运微观机制的平台。

title: Charge-fluctuation hot lines and superconductivity in Ba$_{1-x}$K$_x$BiO$_3$
summary: The origin of superconductivity near 30~K in Ba$_{0.6}$K$_{0.4}$BiO$_3$ has remained a long-standing puzzle. Tunneling experiments give an electron--boson coupling $\lambda\approx 0.7$--1.2, whereas density-functional calculations give $\lambda\approx 0.3$, concentrated in the breathing mode near 50--70~meV. We propose that the missing coupling of about 0.7 comes from dynamical charge fluctuations at Q=(pi,pi,pi)/a, the ordering vector of the charge-disproportionated parent compound, and introduce an overdamped boson model to describe them. Using a tight-binding fit to the conduction band found from density-functional calculations at $x=0.4$, we show that such a boson scatters electrons strongly only on hot lines of the Fermi surface, small loops around the $\langle 111\rangle$ directions where k and k+Q are both at the Fermi level. We derive closed-form self-energies, quasiparticle residues and band reconstructions, including shadow bands and hot-line pseudogaps for long-range correlations, and show that a sum rule fixes the Fermi-surface-averaged coupling independently of the boson frequency and correlation length. Combining the LDA phonon with an overdamped mode of frequency $\omega_m\approx 25$~meV and coupling $\lambda\approx 0.7$, anisotropic Eliashberg calculations reproduce $T_c\approx 25$--30~K for correlation lengths of two to three lattice spacings and predict a gap enhanced by a factor of 3--4 on the hot loops. For longer correlation lengths an $s$-wave state competes closely with a sign-changing $T_{2g}$ state confined to the hot loops. In the random-phase approximation for an extended Hubbard model, the boson emerges naturally near a charge instability at $R$, but purely electronic fluctuations are too weak and too long-ranged; coupling to the breathing-mode lattice distortion is one possible way to strengthen them.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Ba0.6K0.4BiO3中约30 K超导的“缺失电子-玻色子耦合”可由Q=(π,π,π)/a处的动态电荷涨落提供，并用过阻尼玻色子模型、紧束缚费米面和各向异性Eliashberg理论解释Tc、热线段隙增强及竞争配对态。
AI.motivation: Ba0.6K0.4BiO3中约30 K超导起源长期未解：隧穿给出电子-玻色子耦合λ≈0.7–1.2，而密度泛函计算仅给出λ≈0.3，且主要来自50–70 meV呼吸模，存在约0.7的缺失耦合。
AI.method: 作者将缺失耦合归因于母体电荷歧化序矢量Q=(π,π,π)/a处的动态电荷涨落，建立过阻尼玻色子模型；采用x=0.4的DFT导带紧束缚拟合，推导闭式自能、准粒子残留和能带重构（影子能带、长程关联下的热线段赝隙），并利用求和规则确定与玻色子频率和关联长度无关的费米面平均耦合；最后将LDA声子与ωm≈25 meV、λ≈0.7的过阻尼模结合做各向异性Eliashberg计算，并在扩展Hubbard模型的RPA框架下讨论该玻色子的来源。
AI.result: 该玻色子仅在费米面热线段上强散射，即⟨111⟩方向附近k与k+Q均位于费米面的小环。结合LDA声子和过阻尼模后，对2–3个晶格常数的关联长度可重现Tc≈25–30 K，并预言热环上能隙增强3–4倍；更长关联长度下s波态与局限于热环的变号T2g态接近竞争。RPA中玻色子可在R点电荷不稳定附近自然出现，但纯电子涨落过弱且过长程。
AI.conclusion: Ba0.6K0.4BiO3中约30 K超导可由呼吸模声子加Q=(π,π,π)/a动态电荷涨落共同解释，后者补足约0.7的耦合并在热线段产生强各向异性；纯电子机制不足，与呼吸模晶格畸变耦合可能是增强该涨落的可行途径。

title: Electric polarizabilities with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
summary: While projector quantum Monte Carlo methods are known for producing accurate ground-state energies, the prediction of other properties that encode the electronic response to applied electric and magnetic fields has historically been challenging. In this work we demonstrate that the electric (static) polarizability tensor, which is formally a second-derivative of the energy with respect to electric fields, can be efficiently computed with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo using a correlated sampling finite-difference strategy. With simple Hartree-Fock trial wave functions, we investigate a series of small molecules (some of which are difficult for approximate density functionals), polyacenes of increasing size, and ferrocene as a representative organometallic complex. The methodology is scalable to relatively large molecules involving thousands of basis functions, and with appropriate trial wave functions remains robust for strongly correlated electronic states, as we show for the stretched dinitrogen molecule. This work opens the door to the computation of a host of other second-order molecular properties with auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo, which will inform the ongoing search for optimal trial wave functions and extend benchmark-quality training data sets for the refinement of semi-empirical and machine learning models for quantum chemistry and molecular simulation.

AI.tldr: 该工作表明，使用无相位辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（ph-AFQMC）结合相关采样有限差分策略，可以高效计算分子的静态电极化率张量，并在小分子、多并苯、二茂铁及拉伸N2等体系中验证了可扩展性与强关联鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 投影量子蒙特卡洛虽能给出高精度基态能量，但计算电子对外加电场和磁场的响应性质（如极化率等）长期较困难；本文旨在将AFQMC扩展到此类响应性质。
AI.method: 将静态电极化率视为能量对电场的二阶导数，在ph-AFQMC框架下采用相关采样有限差分策略计算；使用简单Hartree-Fock试探波函数，测试小分子、系列多并苯、二茂铁，并考察拉伸N2的强关联情形。
AI.result: 该方法可高效获得电极化率张量，可扩展至含数千基函数的大分子；在合适试探波函数下对强关联电子态仍保持稳健，并覆盖部分对近似密度泛函较困难的体系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为用AFQMC计算其他二阶分子性质打开了途径，可帮助评估和优化试探波函数，并为半经验模型和机器学习模型提供高质量基准训练数据。

title: Valence band, electron correlation, and possible temperature dependent change in the electronic structure near $E_F$ of a candidate of ambient-pressure nickelate superconductors Sr$_3$Ni$_2$O$_5$Cl$_2$
summary: Photoemission spectroscopy (PES) studies of Sr$_3$Ni$_2$O$_5$Cl$_2$ (Sr3252), a candidate ambient-pressure bilayer nickelate superconductor, have been performed to investigate the electronic structure. Valence band spectra, which are compared with DFT and DFT+U calculations, reveal dominant Ni 3$d$ $t_{2g}$-derived states located around 0.6 eV binding energy with a shoulder around 0.2 eV that can be attributed to states with a dominant Ni 3$d_{3z2-r2}$ character. The overall valence band shape is better reproduced by the simulated spectrum of DFT+U (= 3 eV), providing an experimental estimation of the strength of electron correlation. High-resolution PES near the Fermi level ($E_F$) exhibits marked temperature dependence, which cannot be fully understood by a broadening due to coupling of a photo-hole to phonons alone and suggests change in electronic structure. The results provide fundamental electronic structure information of Sr3252, which is useful to further explore the superconductivity of Sr3252.

AI.tldr: 利用光电子能谱研究了常压双层镍酸盐超导体候选材料Sr3Ni2O5Cl2的电子结构，并发现费米能级附近存在显著温度依赖。
AI.motivation: Sr3Ni2O5Cl2是常压双层镍酸盐超导体的候选材料，需要获得其基础电子结构信息以进一步理解超导电性。
AI.method: 开展价带光电子能谱测量，并与DFT及DFT+U计算结果对比；同时进行费米能级附近的高分辨率变温PES测量。
AI.result: 价带主要由Ni 3d t2g态贡献，位于约0.6 eV结合能处，并在约0.2 eV处出现可归因于Ni 3d3z2-r2特征的肩峰；DFT+U（U=3 eV）模拟更吻合价带形状，给出电子关联强度的实验估计；费米能级附近PES显示明显温度依赖，不能仅用光空穴-声子耦合展宽解释，提示电子结构发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了Sr3Ni2O5Cl2的基础电子结构信息，有助于进一步探索其超导电性。

title: Neutron Spin Resonance as Probe of Triplet Pair Density Waves in CeCoIn$_5$
summary: Spin resonance modes are among the most characteristic collective excitations of unconventional superconductors, yet their microscopic origin remains unresolved. Although commonly interpreted as purely magnetic excitations, this picture does not explain the rich magnetic field evolution of these modes observed in heavy-fermion superconductors. Here we combine inelastic neutron scattering and symmetry analysis to investigate the evolution of the spin resonance modes in the heavy-fermion superconductor CeCoIn$_5$ under an in-plane magnetic field. At high fields, approaching the upper critical field of the superconductor, we discover a third resonance mode with relatively high intensity. We demonstrate that the resonance branches observed experimentally can be interpreted as collective modes of the superconducting condensate involving transitions to excited superconducting states. This framework provides a unified interpretation of the field-induced splitting of the resonance, the newly observed mode at high fields, the relative neutron scattering intensities of each mode, and provides the first direct evidence that a spin resonance mode can be associated with a singlet-triplet excitation of a superconductor.

AI.tldr: 该文通过非弹性中子散射与对称性分析研究重费米子超导体 CeCoIn5 面内磁场下自旋共振模的演化，提出其源于超导凝聚体的集体激发，并首次给出自旋共振模与单态-三重态激发相关的直接证据。
AI.motivation: 自旋共振模是非常规超导体的典型集体激发，但其微观起源尚未解决；仅用纯磁激发图像无法解释重费米子超导体中共振模随磁场的丰富演化。
AI.method: 结合非弹性中子散射和对称性分析，测量 CeCoIn5 在面内磁场下自旋共振模的演化，并与超导态激发和集体模式图像进行比对。
AI.result: 在高场接近上临界场时发现一个强度较高的第三共振模；实验观测到的共振分支可解释为超导凝聚体中涉及激发超导态的集体模式，从而统一解释场致共振劈裂、新模及相对中子散射强度，并首次直接证明自旋共振模可与超导体的单态-三重态激发相关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了重费米子超导体中自旋共振模的统一解释框架，表明共振模并非纯磁激发，而可源于超导凝聚体的集体模式及单态-三重态激发。

title: Oscillatory superconducting proximity effects in a buried Pt interlayer detected by FMR
summary: We investigate superconducting proximity effects in NbN/Pt/Py and NbN/Cu/Py trilayers using broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR). The reduction of the spin-pumping contribution to the Py damping below the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) is used to probe the superconducting correlations and electronic density of state in the buried metallic interlayer. For a Cu interlayer, the damping reduction remains finite up to at least 20 nm, in agreement with the large coherence length above 100nm in Cu. In contrast, the damping reduction for a Pt interlayer exhibits a non-monotonic thickness dependence and is fully suppressed above 5 nm. Using the quasiclassical theory, we are able to explain the oscillation in damping reduction below Tc with the coexistence of superconducting and magnetic proximity effects in Pt, which generates oscillations of the superconducting order parameter and electronic density of state in the exchange-splitted Pt interlayer. Our results establish spin-pumping damping as a sensitive probe of superconducting proximity effects in buried metallic layers.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用宽带铁磁共振测量自旋泵浦阻尼在超导转变温度以下的变化，以探测NbN/Pt/Py和NbN/Cu/Py三明治结构中埋入金属层的超导近邻效应。
AI.motivation: 研究超导近邻效应在埋入金属中间层中的表现，并检验自旋泵浦阻尼是否能作为探测超导关联和电子态密度的灵敏手段。
AI.method: 对NbN/Pt/Py与NbN/Cu/Py三层膜进行宽带铁磁共振测量，提取Py阻尼中的自旋泵浦贡献；以Tc以下阻尼降低为探针，并结合准经典理论分析。
AI.result: Cu中间层的阻尼降低至少在20 nm厚度内仍存在，符合Cu中超过100 nm的长相干长度；Pt中间层的阻尼降低随厚度非单调变化，并在5 nm以上完全消失。准经典理论表明，Pt中同时存在超导近邻与磁性近邻效应，导致交换劈裂Pt层中超导序参量和电子态密度发生振荡，从而解释Tc以下阻尼降低的振荡。
AI.conclusion: 自旋泵浦阻尼可作为探测埋入金属层中超导近邻效应的灵敏探针，并揭示超导与磁性近邻共存下的空间振荡行为。

title: Curling Superconducting Vortices by Nematic Fluxon-Skyrmion Interaction
summary: Superconducting vortex represents a topological entity in type-II superconductors, where the prototypical manifestation of such a macroscopic quantum state holds great promise for applications in future quantum technologies. Deterministic control of the vortex dynamics at the nanoscale is central to enhance superconductors' critical thresholds and design next-generation superconducting quantum devices. However, it is still scientifically challenging due to the intrinsic nature of the vortex pinning landscapes in superconductors. Here, we observe an even-in-field Hall-like signal with about two order of magnitude enhancement in a type-II superconductor/chiral magnet heterostructure, which confines to the field-temperature window where the flux flow coexists with magnetic skyrmions. The polarity of such a giant even-in-field transverse response reverses between orthogonal current directions, suggesting an on-track vortex flow driven by a nematic fluxon-skyrmion interaction analyzed via the extended vortex-viscosity tensor. More critically, a deterministic manipulation of skyrmions at the nanoscale within the hybrid system enables selective and reversible controls over the dissipative behavior and therefore the reconfigurable fluxon transport, mimic the precise control of curling stone in winter Olympic, thereby opening a new avenue towards the exploration of programmable topological and superconducting quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 在第二类超导体/手性磁体异质结中观察到约两个数量级增强的偶场霍尔样信号，其源于通量流与磁斯格明子共存区，并可通过纳米尺度斯格明子操控实现可重构涡旋输运。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度确定性控制超导涡旋动力学对提升超导临界阈值和设计下一代超导量子器件至关重要，但超导体本征钉扎势 landscape 使该目标极具挑战。
AI.method: 构筑第二类超导体/手性磁体异质结构，测量偶场横向响应及其对正交电流方向的依赖性；结合扩展涡旋黏度张量分析通量子-斯格明子相互作用，并在纳米尺度确定性地操控斯格明子。
AI.result: 发现约两个数量级增强的偶场霍尔样信号，局限于通量流与磁性斯格明子共存的场-温窗口；该巨偶场横向响应的极性在正交电流方向间反转；纳米尺度斯格明子操控可选择性、可逆地调节耗散行为，从而实现可重构通量子输运。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，由向列型通量子-斯格明子相互作用驱动的定向涡旋流可被确定性地调控，为可编程拓扑与超导量子器件提供了新途径。

title: A High-Frequency Flux-Driven DC-SQUID Threshold Detector at the Single-Microwave-Photon Energy Scale: A Numerical Feasibility Study
summary: In our recent work (Phys. Rev. B \textbf{113}, 224503 (2026)), we showed numerically that rapidly sweeping the bias current of a current-biased Josephson junction threshold detector (CBJJ-JTD) drives it out of equilibrium. This substantially reduces the effect of thermal noise on microwave detection and may enable threshold detection near the energy of a single microwave photon. The scheme requires very low damping ($\beta \leq 10^{-4}$) and a very fast bias-current sweep ($v/\beta \geq 1$), both of which are difficult to achieve with available junctions and low-pass-filtered cryogenic measurement lines. Here we propose a more experimentally accessible nonequilibrium threshold detector based on a high-frequency flux-driven direct-current superconducting quantum interference device (DC-SQUID) and investigate it by numerically solving the resistively and capacitively shunted junction (RCSJ) equations. The applied flux drives a circulating supercurrent and sustains nonequilibrium phase dynamics throughout the bias-current sweep, removing the need for a fast sweep or for transient oscillations set by the initial phase. Using typical experimental device parameters, we calculate switching-current distributions (SCDs) with and without a microwave input for both driven and undriven SQUIDs. We quantify detection performance using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and their area under the curve (AUC). The simulations show that high-frequency flux drive reduces the impact of thermal noise and enables statistical discrimination of weak microwave pulses at the single-photon energy scale. We also numerically estimate detector characteristics such as phase selectivity and dynamic range.

AI.tldr: 提出并数值研究一种基于高频磁通驱动直流SQUID的非平衡阈值探测器，可在典型实验参数下统计区分单光子能级弱微波脉冲。
AI.motivation: 此前的CBJJ-JTD虽可通过快速扫描偏置电流降低热噪声影响，但需要极低阻尼和极快扫描，实验上难以实现；因此需要更易实施的方案。
AI.method: 采用高频磁通驱动DC-SQUID，通过数值求解RCSJ方程研究其非平衡相位动力学；计算有/无微波输入及驱动/未驱动条件下的切换电流分布，并用ROC曲线和AUC量化探测性能，同时估计相位选择性和动态范围。
AI.result: 高频磁通驱动可维持非平衡相位动力学并降低热噪声影响；仿真表明在典型器件参数下可对弱微波脉冲进行统计判别，达到单光子能量尺度。
AI.conclusion: 高频磁通驱动DC-SQUID是一种更具实验可行性的非平衡阈值探测器方案，有望用于单微波光子能区的弱信号探测。

title: Mixed-State Magnetotransport Below $T_c$ in Type-II Superconducting NbN Thin Films
summary: The transport properties of type-II superconductors in the mixed state below the superconducting transition temperature, $T_c$, remain difficult to interpret because superconducting and dissipative processes coexist in the presence of a magnetic field. To investigate this regime in NbN thin films, we measured the field-dependent sheet resistance ($R^M_{xx}$) and Hall resistance ($R^M_{xy}$) below $T_c$ in Van der Pauw geometry for 4-nm-thick NbN films on sapphire and silicon substrates at driving currents of 1 mA and 2 mA. By combining the longitudinal response with the antisymmetrized Hall signal, we use a phenomenological current-partition model to estimate the dissipative and superconducting current contributions. From this analysis, we estimate the field-dependent superconducting current together with the Hall-derived effective dissipative carrier density and mobility. We also observe an even-in-field transverse signal whose magnitude depends strongly on the driving current. We discuss this signal as a possible mixed-state response involving the magnetic and supercurrent texture of Abrikosov vortices, vortex dynamics, and Cooper-pair current redistribution. The present measurements do not uniquely distinguish vortex, condensate, or combined contributions. The model provides a practical way to compare the longitudinal and transverse mixed-state responses without implying a direct spatial separation of the two current channels.

AI.tldr: 该文通过低于Tc的场依赖纵向片电阻与反对称Hall信号，结合唯象电流分配模型，分析4 nm NbN薄膜混合态中超导电流与耗散电流的贡献，并报道一个随驱动电流显著变化的偶场横向信号。
AI.motivation: 第二类超导体混合态中超导过程与耗散过程共存，使输运性质难以解释；作者希望在NbN薄膜中区分纵向与横向混合态响应中的超导和耗散贡献。
AI.method: 在蓝宝石和硅衬底上的4 nm NbN薄膜中，以Van der Pauw几何在低于Tc时测量场依赖片电阻Rxx^M和Hall电阻Rxy^M，驱动电流为1 mA和2 mA；将纵向响应与反对称化Hall信号结合，采用唯象电流分配模型估计耗散与超导电流贡献，并提取场依赖超导电流、Hall导出的有效耗散载流子密度和迁移率。
AI.result: 分析得到场依赖超导电流及Hall导出的有效耗散载流子密度和迁移率；同时观察到偶场横向信号，其幅度强烈依赖驱动电流。作者将该信号解释为可能涉及Abrikosov涡旋的磁场与超电流织构、涡旋动力学以及Cooper对电流重分布等混合态响应。
AI.conclusion: 现有测量不能唯一区分涡旋、凝聚体或二者联合贡献；该模型提供了比较纵向与横向混合态响应的实用方法，但不意味着两类电流通道在空间上直接分离。

title: Soliton Propagation of Zero Sound in Superfluid $^3$He-B
summary: Nonlinear equations for zero sound interacting with the B-phase collective modes are derived by treating $^3$He-B as a medium of two-level ``molecules'' (Cooper pairs), The nonlinear equations reduce to known results from kinetic theory in the linear response limit. Soliton solutions to the nonlinear equations are discussed in context with the experiments of Polturak et al.

AI.tldr: 该文将^3He-B视为由库珀对构成的二能级“分子”介质，推导零声与B相集体模式相互作用的非线性方程，并讨论孤子解及其与Polturak等人实验的联系。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立零声与^3He-B B相集体模式非线性耦合的理论描述，并解释相关实验中的非线性/孤子现象。
AI.method: 采用库珀对作为二能级“分子”的介质模型推导非线性方程；在线性响应极限下与已知动理论结果对照；进一步求取并讨论孤子解。
AI.result: 得到了零声与B相集体模式相互作用的非线性方程，其在的线性响应极限下退化为动理论的已知结果；给出了孤子解并与Polturak等人的实验背景进行了讨论。
AI.conclusion: 二能级“分子”模型能够统一描述线性与非线性响应，并为理解^3He-B中零声-集体模式耦合及可能观测到的孤子行为提供了理论框架。

title: Auditing two-stage MS/MS molecular retrieval on MassSpecGym v1.5: Reranking gains, candidate priors and spectrum dependence
summary: Two-stage retrieval of molecular structures from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) can benefit from candidate reranking, but benchmark gains may also reflect candidate priors, replicate spectra, precursor mass, and training-set coverage. We audit a two-stage retrieval system on the official MassSpecGym v1.5 split (17,556 test spectra). A data-safe DreaMS encoder and composite molecular fingerprints provide an initial shortlist; a support-gated reranker combines pair scores, candidate-relative peak coverage, and mass-feasibility features. The final system achieves 31.05% Recall@1, a 10.05-point gain over its Stage 1 ensemble, while preserving its 72.62% Recall@20. Replacing the query spectrum with one from a different molecule matched on adduct and precursor mass reduces Recall@1 by 9.0 points (15.3 points under molecule-balanced weighting); nevertheless, a training-mean spectrum retains 13.75% Recall@1, indicating substantial spectrum-independent signal. Mass-feasibility features improve Recall@1 beyond score and coverage controls, while learned peak-fragment similarities do not outperform constant coverage. Errors cluster by molecule, and removing close training neighbours causes a large decline in Stage 1 shortlist recall among initially well-covered molecules. We conclude that candidate-relative mass-feasibility evidence improves front-rank retrieval and spectrum dependence, but does not establish learned structural discrimination or eliminate candidate priors. Evaluation should separately assess shortlist reachability, spectrum dependence, and molecule-level generalization.

AI.tldr: 在MassSpecGym v1.5官方划分上审计两阶段MS/MS分子结构检索，发现重排序增益部分来自质量可行性等候选先验，而非纯谱图学习判别。
AI.motivation: 两阶段检索的候选重排序常报告性能提升，但可能混杂候选先验、重复谱、前体质量和训练集覆盖，需数据安全地审计其真实信号与谱图依赖性。
AI.method: 使用17,556条官方测试谱；以数据安全的DreaMS编码器和复合分子指纹生成初筛短名单；支持门控重排序器融合成对分数、候选相对峰覆盖和质量可行性特征。
AI.result: 最终Recall@1为31.05%，较Stage 1集成提升10.05点，Recall@20保持72.62%。替换为同加合物和前体质量但不同分子的谱使Recall@1降9.0点（分子平衡加权降15.3点）；训练均值谱仍有13.75% Recall@1。质量可行性特征在分数与覆盖控制外提升Recall@1；学习峰-碎片相似性未优于常数覆盖。错误按分子聚集，移除近邻训练样本使初筛召回大降。
AI.conclusion: 候选相对质量可行性证据可改善前列检索和谱图依赖性，但未证明学习到结构判别或消除候选先验；评估应分别考察短名单可达性、谱图依赖性和分子级泛化。

title: Using potential derivatives to reduce the cost of rectangular collocation: a general and versatile approach for computational vibrational spectroscopy without a potential energy surface
summary: We modify the exact Cartesian kinetic energy operator, rectangular collocation approach of Manzhos and Carrington [J. Chem. Phys. 145 (2016) 224110] by using information contained in potential derivatives to decrease the number of required potential points. We show that this makes it possible to substantially reduce the number of collocation points, which is important, in particular, when energies are computed directly ab initio. Vibrational band intensities are also computed. We first demonstrate the method on Cl2CO and compare to high-accuracy Smolyak collocation calculations on an accurate potential energy surface (PES). Sub-cm-1 accuracy is obtained with a few thousand Gaussian basis functions and potential points. A spectrum computed directly from DFT energies and a comparison to GVPT2 (generalized vibrational perturbation theory) are also presented. We then consider LiCO2 as a more anharmonic case, for which a quartic force field potential is less reliable, and which also serves as a surrogate model for a catalytic system (mimicking CO2 bond weakening by charge donation). The rectangular collocation method is used to compute the spectrum of LiCO2 directly from ab initio energies and to compare to GVPT2. The method is implemented as a Claude Skill and is easily usable by anyone on any molecule. The method is a general and versatile tool for anharmonic computational vibrational spectroscopy. It does not require a PES and no coupling is neglected.

AI.tldr: 通过利用势能导数信息改进精确笛卡尔动能算符矩形配点法，大幅减少所需势能点，实现无需PES的从头算非谐振动光谱与谱强度计算。
AI.motivation: 传统矩形配点法需较多势能点，尤其在直接使用从头算能量时成本高；目标是降低配点数并保持高精度，发展通用非谐振动光谱工具。
AI.method: 在Manzhos-Carrington精确笛卡尔动能算符矩形配点框架中引入势能导数信息以减少配点；计算振动带强度；Cl2CO与高精度Smolyak配点及GVPT2比较，并直接用DFT能量计算光谱；LiCO2用从头算能量直接计算并与GVPT2比较，作为催化CO2键削弱代理模型。
AI.result: Cl2CO在准确PES上以数千高斯基函数和势能点达到sub-cm-1精度；直接DFT光谱与GVPT2比较；LiCO2更非谐、四阶力场不可靠，仍可直接从头算能量计算光谱并与GVPT2比较；方法实现为Claude Skill，便于任意分子使用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通用灵活，可用于非谐计算振动光谱，无需构建PES且不忽略耦合。

title: Adaptive Multiset Tree Tensor Networks for Large-Scale Exciton Dynamics
summary: Electronic excitations coupled to vibrational environments play an important role in charge and energy transport in molecular materials. Multiset tree tensor networks provide an efficient ansatz for the dynamics of such systems by allowing different electronic configurations to develop independent environmental correlations. However, typical implementations use fixed bond dimensions, significantly limiting the accessible system size and hence their predictive capabilities for large scale systems. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the adaptive multiset tree tensor network (AMTTN) approach, in which the bond dimensions of each configuration are adapted independently using a local energy variance based expansion scheme. Additionally, configurations can be temporarily frozen whenever they are predicted to remain weakly populated throughout a timestep. For the one-dimensional Holstein model, AMTTN reproduces converged exciton dynamics one to two orders of magnitude faster than fixed bond dimension multiset methods, with the dominant cost determined by the dynamically active region with only weak residual dependence on the lattice size. For a P3HT:PCBM heterojunction, it enables simulations of a model containing 52 oligothiophene units avoiding finite size effects occurring on dynamically relevant time scales, which lead to the previously studied 13 unit model substantially overestimating long time populations of bound charge separated states. Our results show that AMTTN provides a practical method for obtaining converged quantum dynamics simulations of challenging excitonic and non-adiabatic systems for which conventional multiset approaches are prohibitively expensive.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应多集树张量网络（AMTTN），通过独立自适应键维与弱布居构型冻结，实现大规模激子/非绝热量子动力学的收敛模拟。
AI.motivation: 多集树张量网络可让不同电子构型发展独立环境关联，但固定键维限制可模拟体系规模与预测能力。
AI.method: AMTTN 基于局部能量方差对每个构型独立扩展键维，并在预测某构型在一个时间步内保持弱布居时临时冻结该构型。
AI.result: 在一维 Holstein 模型中，AMTTN 比固定键维多集方法快 1–2 个数量级达到收敛激子动力学，主要成本由动态活跃区域决定且对晶格尺寸依赖较弱；在 P3HT:PCBM 异质结中模拟含 52 个低聚噻吩单元的模型，避免动态相关时间尺度上的有限尺寸效应，并表明先前 13 单元模型显著高估束缚电荷分离态的长时布居。
AI.conclusion: AMTTN 为传统多集方法代价过高的大规模激子与非绝热体系提供实用的收敛量子动力学模拟方法。

title: Where does a molecule begin? Threshold masses of three-particle Coulomb systems and a predictive theory of their Born-Oppenheimer offsets
summary: The Born-Oppenheimer (BO) approximation serves as the foundational framework for the contemporary concept of molecular structure, which is central to chemistry and the molecular sciences. Its principal assumption is the treatment of nuclei as infinitely heavy particles. In this work, we test the boundaries of the BO approximation by examining systems with variable nuclear masses to investigate the emergence of molecular structure. We examine the three-particle family {X^+,X^+,e^-} as a function of the mass ratio M = m_X/m_e, using deterministic variational calculations and the exact BO approximation. We accurately compute the threshold masses of all 23 excited levels bound below M = 100 with certified upper bounds. The BO approximation places every one of them too late by a nearly constant amount, 1.2 to 1.6 (0.23 to 0.54 with the adiabatic correction). We explain this constancy with a parameter-free theory, and test it with predictions frozen before the exact calculations: 18 of 18 symmetric levels pass (typical miss 0.003). For unequal nuclear masses none of 7 levels falls within the band, but the theory still captures over 90% of the offset. Where does a molecule begin? The ground state changes character gradually, over a crossover 2.3 decades wide in M. The sharp landmarks are the threshold masses: the first rotational level binds at M = 4.208, in the ortho-type nuclear-spin species, and the first vibrational level at M = 9.526; BO places them at 5.54 and 11.08. Thus, the BO picture orders the spectrum correctly at finite mass and shifts it by an amount that can be computed.

AI.tldr: 该文通过调节核质比 M=m_X/m_e，在 {X^+,X^+,e^-} 三粒子体系中系统检验 Born-Oppenheimer（BO）近似的适用边界，并给出可计算的阈值质量偏移。
AI.motivation: BO 近似将原子核视为无限重，是化学中分子结构概念的基础；作者希望回答分子结构在有限核质量下如何出现，以及 BO 图像在何种质量尺度上失效。
AI.method: 对 {X^+,X^+,e^-} 体系随质量比 M 进行确定性变分计算，并与精确 BO 近似比较；计算 M<100 下全部 23 个束缚激发态的阈值质量并给出严格上界，同时提出无自由参数理论预测阈值偏移。
AI.result: BO 近似将所有阈值质量系统性推迟约 1.2–1.6（加入绝热修正后为 0.23–0.54）；无参数理论解释了该近常量偏移，预先冻结的预测在 18/18 个对称能级上通过，典型误差 0.003；非等核质量 7 个能级虽不在预测带内，但理论仍解释超过 90% 的偏移。基态性质在 M 上经历约 2.3 个数量级的渐变交叉；首个转动能级在 M=4.208（ortho 型核自旋 species）束缚，首个振动能级在 M=9.526，而 BO 分别给出 5.54 和 11.08。
AI.conclusion: 有限核质量下 BO 图像仍能正确排序能谱，但其整体质量偏移可被定量计算；分子结构的出现是渐变过程，阈值质量提供了清晰标志，BO 近似的时间/质量边界可由理论预测。

title: An equivariant classical density functional for ionic fluids at complex interfaces
summary: Predicting the combined effects of ionic packing and long-range electrostatics at complex interfaces is technologically important, but remains challenging without atomistic simulations. Here we present a machine-learned classical density functional for ionic fluids that combines a symmetry-adapted neural free energy for short-range correlations with explicit long-range electrostatics. Trained on three-dimensional equilibrium densities and bulk correlations of the full-Coulomb restricted primitive model, a single functional transfers to charge-patterned particles and atomically structured electrodes. Around anisotropic charged solutes, it reproduces the ionic structure and mean forces from molecular dynamics, including reversals of the bare electrostatic force. At metal electrodes, self-consistent coupling to metal atoms captures the redistribution of ionic and electrode charge and the loading-dependent capacitance enhancement produced by steps and bumps. Combined with mobilities determined independently from bulk molecular dynamics, the same functional describes the main features of charging dynamics and resolves geometry-dependent spatial relaxation. This framework can be extended to more complex ionic fluids, enabling efficient exploration of how composition and geometry control structure and response.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合对称适配神经网络短程自由能与显式长程静电的机器学习经典密度泛函，可统一预测复杂界面处离子堆积与静电耦合。
AI.motivation: 预测离子堆积和长程静电在复杂界面上的联合效应在技术上很重要，但若不进行原子级模拟则难以实现。
AI.method: 构建离子流体的机器学习经典密度泛函：用对称适配神经网络描述短程相关自由能，并显式处理长程静电；在全库仑受限原初模型的三维平衡密度和体相相关函数上训练，使单一泛函可迁移到电荷图案化颗粒和原子结构电极。
AI.result: 在各向异性带电溶质周围，该泛函重现分子动力学给出的离子结构和平均力，包括裸静电力的反向；在金属电极处，与金属原子自洽耦合可捕捉离子与电极电荷重分布以及台阶和凸起引起的负载相关电容增强；结合由体相分子动力学独立确定的迁移率，可描述充电动力学主要特征并解析几何相关的空间弛豫。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可扩展到更复杂离子流体，从而高效探索组成和几何如何控制结构与响应。

title: Handed Ultrafast Dynamics in Chiral Cyanine Nanotubes
summary: We detect helicity-dependent excited state relaxation in a chiral exciton system. Using L-histidine as a chiral inducer, we prepared unbundled, double-walled J-aggregrate nanotubes of an amphiphilic cyanine dye with a net handedness, which gives a large circular dichroism dissymmetry factor ($g_{abs} = 3.6 \times 10^{-2}$). With two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy and circularly polarized pump pulses, we find that the relaxation rates of longitudinal excitons depend on pump helicity (4.5 $ps^{-1}$ for $\langle \textit{RRXX} \rangle$ vs 6 $ps^{-1}$ for $\langle \textit{LLXX} \rangle$, a difference of about 30%) and is the same in the inner and outer tubes. Transverse excitons show no significant dependence. Chirality and pump helicity therefore bias exciton relaxation on the femtosecond timescale for excitons delocalized along the helical structure.

AI.tldr: 该文利用圆偏振泵浦二维电子光谱，发现手性J聚集体纳米管中纵向激子的激发态弛豫速率依赖泵浦光螺旋度，而横向激子无明显依赖。
AI.motivation: 探究手性结构是否能调控激子激发态弛豫动力学，以及泵浦光螺旋度是否能在飞秒尺度上偏置手性激子体系中的能量弛豫。
AI.method: 以L-组氨酸为手性诱导剂，制备两亲性花菁染料的无束双壁J聚集体纳米管，获得净手性和较大圆二色不对称因子（g_abs=3.6×10^-2）；采用二维电子光谱并结合圆偏振泵浦脉冲，比较不同螺旋度泵浦下纵向与横向激子的弛豫速率。
AI.result: 纵向激子弛豫速率随泵浦螺旋度变化：⟨RRXX⟩为4.5 ps^-1，⟨LLXX⟩为6 ps^-1，差异约30%，且在内壁和外壁管中相同；横向激子未显示显著螺旋度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 手性和泵浦光螺旋度可在飞秒时间尺度上偏置沿螺旋结构离域激子的弛豫，表明手性环境可调控激子动力学。

title: RxnScope: Accurate joint generation of product and transition-state pairs from reactants via flow matching
summary: Reaction networks are central to understanding chemical reactivity and guiding reaction design. Constructing them when products are unknown remains a major challenge in computational chemistry, requiring the identification of products and their corresponding transition states (TSs) across elementary steps. Here, we introduce RxnScope, a flow-matching framework that jointly generates paired product-TS geometries from reactants, conditioned on a potentially reactive region. Directed product-to-TS coupling allows evolving rather than fixed product geometries to guide TS generation, while paired outputs enable product-topology ranking to prioritize candidates for validation. RxnScope recovered and validated 95.8% of reference pathways on Transition1x, performed robustly on multicomponent reactions and enabled multistep pathway exploration. In automatic reaction discovery, it achieved low-energy pathway coverage comparable to that of the single-ended growing string method while using only about 2% of its computational cost. These results establish joint product-TS generation as a new strategy for exploring reaction networks from reactants.

AI.tldr: RxnScope 是一种基于流匹配的框架，可从反应物联合生成成对产物-TS 几何结构，并用于反应网络探索与自动反应发现。
AI.motivation: 当产物未知时，构建反应网络仍很困难，需要同时识别各基元步骤的产物及其过渡态（TS）。
AI.method: RxnScope 以潜在反应区域为条件，从反应物联合生成配对的产物-TS 几何结构；通过产物到 TS 的有向耦合，使演化中的产物几何引导 TS 生成；成对输出支持产物拓扑排序，以优先选择待验证候选。
AI.result: 在 Transition1x 上恢复并验证了 95.8% 的参考路径；在多组分反应中表现稳健，并支持多步路径探索；自动反应发现中，以约 2% 的计算成本达到与单端增长弦方法相当的低能路径覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 联合产物-TS 生成可作为从反应物出发探索反应网络的新策略。

title: Restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham theory for arbitrary genealogical spin coupling
summary: We introduce a generalization of restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham (ROKS) theory to a single configuration state function (CSF) with arbitrary genealogical spin coupling. This CSF-ROKS theory establishes a spin-pure density functional extension of the recently developed CSF-based restricted open-shell Hartree-Fock (CSF-ROHF) theory, providing a computationally efficient route to incorporate dynamic electron correlation. The energy is expressed as a weighted sum over unrestricted determinants built from a common set of restricted orbitals, and the number of determinants grows quadratically with the number of open shells. Numerical calculations for N$_2$ and the polyacene series show that CSF-ROKS solutions retain chemically interpretable character. Exchange-correlation functionals preferentially stabilize low-seniority configurations, shifting the onset of polyradical character in polyacenes to longer chains than predicted by CSF-ROHF. Furthermore, CSF-ROKS can be used to target state-specific spin-pure excitations in the vinyl and allyl radicals, and the [Cr(ddpd)$_2$]$^{3+}$ molecular ruby. However, CSF-ROKS incorrectly predicts ferromagnetic coupling in a set of bridged transition metal dimers, indicating that kinetic exchange requires more advanced correlated methods.

AI.tldr: 提出将 restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham (ROKS) 推广到具有任意 genealogical 自旋耦合的单配置态函数 (CSF)，形成自旋纯的 CSF-ROKS 密度泛函方法。
AI.motivation: 在 CSF-ROHF 基础上引入动态电子相关，同时保持自旋纯性和计算效率，避免多参考方法的过高成本。
AI.method: 能量表示为基于同一组 restricted 轨道的无限制行列式的加权和；行列式数目随开壳层数二次增长，可处理任意 genealogical 自旋耦合的单个 CSF。
AI.result: N2 与多并苯系列计算显示解保持化学可解释性；交换相关泛函偏好稳定低 seniority 组态，使多并苯多自由基特征出现推迟到更长链。方法可靶向乙烯基、烯丙基自由基及 [Cr(ddpd)2]3+ 分子红宝石的态特异性自旋纯激发，但在桥联过渡金属二聚体中错误预测铁磁耦合。
AI.conclusion: CSF-ROKS 是高效的自旋纯 DFT 扩展，能纳入动态相关并描述多种自旋纯态，但动交换/ kinetic exchange 仍需更高级相关方法。

title: The replication-energy limit of PQG reduced-density-matrix theory from a single-fragment semidefinite program
summary: Variational two-electron reduced-density-matrix calculations are not size extensive: the energy per fragment can decrease when identical, strictly noninteracting fragments are replicated [M. Nakata and K. Yasuda, Phys. Rev. A 80, 042109 (2009)]. For the $P$, $Q$, and $G$ conditions (PQG) we prove the following. (i) The energy per fragment converges to the minimum of a semidefinite program (SDP) on one fragment. The limit is reached through negative interfragment covariances of order $1/(k-1)$ for $k$ replicas, which cancel the local electron number and spin fluctuations consistently with a global singlet. (ii) The energy per fragment is nonincreasing in the replica count. (iii) It reaches the limit exactly at a finite replica count. (iv) The defect is tied to the local electron-number variance: a sharp local electron number restores additivity without a spin constraint. (v) In chains of identical units the energy per unit has a limit that tends to the same minimum as the coupling vanishes. The key tool is that the $G$ condition [C. Garrod and J. K. Percus, J. Math. Phys. 5, 1756 (1964)] keeps the variances and covariances of one-body operators positive semidefinite without a representing state, so that the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality applies. PQG therefore admits explicitly constructed replicated points whose compensated local fluctuations lower the energy per fragment below the isolated value. Be, CH$_4$, N$_2$, and H$_2$O (STO-6G) and a four-site Hubbard fragment illustrate the results; in these examples the gap to the isolated value persists with three-index conditions $T_1$ and $T_2$.
