AI.tldr: 该文证明在PQG条件下变分两电子约化密度矩阵计算非尺寸广延：非相互作用复本增加时每片段能量可降到单片段半定规划最小值，且缺陷由局域电子数方差控制。
AI.motivation: Nakata和Yasuda发现变分2-RDM计算在复制相同非相互作用片段时每片段能量会下降；本文旨在解释PQG条件下该非尺寸广延性的机制及其与局域电子数和自旋涨落的关系。
AI.method: 利用G条件使单体算符的方差与协方差在无需代表态时保持半正定，从而应用Cauchy-Schwarz不等式；构造显式复本点，以量级1/(k-1)的负片段间协方差抵消局域电子数和自旋涨落并满足全局单重态；分析复本极限、链式极限及局域电子数约束。
AI.result: 证明五点：每片段能量收敛到单片段SDP最小值；随复本数非增；在有限复本数精确达到极限；局域电子数方差很小时无需自旋约束即可恢复可加性；相同单元链在耦合消失时每单元能量趋于同一下限。Be、CH4、N2、H2O（STO-6G）和四格点Hubbard片段示例显示，在T1和T2三指标条件下与孤立值的间隙仍存在。
AI.conclusion: PQG允许显式构造复本点，通过补偿局域涨落降低每片段能量，因此变分2-RDM并非尺寸广延；局域电子数涨落是关键因素，且三指标条件不能消除示例中的非可加间隙。

title: Autonomous Multireference Quantum Chemistry with Artificial Intelligence Agents
summary: Accurately describing chemical reactions that involve strongly correlated electrons remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. Multireference electronic structure methods can address this challenge, but their application requires expert decisions that are di!cult to automate, particularly when the electronic structure changes as chemical bonds form and break. Here we introduce CASPER, an autonomously agentic workflow that performs multireference calculations along chemical reaction pathways. CASPER combines chemical knowledge, electronic structure calculations, and iterative assessment to identify chemically meaningful active spaces and maintain their consistency as bonds form and break. We demonstrate its capabilities on five transition-metal reactions, for which CASPER generates consistent multireference potential energy profiles with minimal human intervention. Importantly, in two reactions, CASPER identifies critical electronic-structure problems that an independent Claude session fails to recognize without the structured workflow. These include an electronic-state crossing and the exclusion of an orbital involved in bond breaking. Our results show the importance of combining language models with chemical knowledge and independent assessment of computational results. Beyond automating calculations, such agents have the potential to help researchers better understand the underlying physics and chemistry and open new opportunities for investigating complex chemical reactivity and generating high-quality quantum chemical data at scale.

AI.tldr: CASPER 是一个自主智能体工作流，可在化学反应路径上执行多参考电子结构计算，自动识别并维持化学上有意义的活性空间，在五个过渡金属反应中生成一致的多参考势能剖面。
AI.motivation: 涉及强关联电子的化学反应难以准确描述；多参考方法虽可处理，但依赖专家判断，尤其在成键/断键导致电子结构变化时难以自动化。
AI.method: CASPER 结合化学知识、电子结构计算和迭代评估，沿反应路径识别化学上有意义的活性空间，并在成键和断键过程中保持其一致性。
AI.result: 在五个过渡金属反应上，CASPER 以极少人工干预生成一致的多参考势能剖面；在其中两个反应中，它识别出独立 Claude 会话在无结构化工作流时未能发现的关键电子结构问题，包括电子态交叉和遗漏参与断键的轨道。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将语言模型与化学知识及对计算结果的独立评估相结合十分重要；此类智能体不仅能自动化计算，还可能帮助理解底层物理化学并推动复杂反应研究与大规模高质量量子化学数据生成。

title: A Constrained Coupled Cluster Approach for Strongly Correlated Electrons
summary: We introduce constrained coupled cluster (cCC), a general framework for imposing arbitrary physical constraints on conventional single-reference coupled cluster amplitudes without rederiving or replacing the underlying coupled cluster residual equations. As a first application, we derive a constraint from the spin-symmetry requirement for an exact wavefunction and demonstrate the resulting approach on strongly correlated problems. Across benchmark Hubbard models, nitrogen and chromium bond breaking, and iron--sulfur cluster spin gaps, the constraint strongly suppresses spin contamination, repairs qualitative failures of conventional coupled cluster, and often brings CCSDT, and in several cases CCSD, into quantitative agreement with exact diagonalization or high-accuracy density matrix renormalization group calculations. The derived constraint adds only a mean-field cost contraction to the coupled cluster calculation and is compatible with any cluster truncation. These results identify numerical constraints as a promising route for extending single-reference coupled cluster machinery into strongly correlated regimes conventionally associated with more complicated electronic structure methods.

AI.tldr: 提出约束耦合簇（cCC）框架，可在不重推或替换传统单参考耦合簇残差方程的情况下，对簇振幅施加任意物理约束；以自旋对称性约束为例，显著抑制强关联体系中的自旋污染并修复常规CC的定性失败。
AI.motivation: 传统单参考耦合簇在强关联区域常出现定性失败和自旋污染，而多参考或复杂电子结构方法成本较高；作者希望在不替换CC残差方程的前提下，通过数值约束扩展单参考CC的适用性。
AI.method: 构建cCC通用框架，对常规单参考CC振幅施加任意物理约束；首先从精确波函数所需的自旋对称性条件导出约束，并将其用于强关联问题。该约束仅增加一个平均场成本的收缩，且兼容任意簇截断（如CCSD、CCSDT）。
AI.result: 在Hubbard模型、N2和Cr2键断裂以及铁硫簇自旋能隙等基准中，该约束强烈抑制自旋污染，修复常规CC的定性失败，并常使CCSDT、若干情况下甚至CCSD与精确对角化或高精度DMRG结果定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 数值约束是扩展单参考耦合簇方法至强关联区域的有前景途径，可用于传统上需要更复杂电子结构方法的场景。

title: What Do Co-Folding Models Learn? Insights from Enhanced Transition Path Sampling
summary: Co-folding models are diffusion-based generative models that sample biomolecular complexes from distributions learned on a large corpus of experimental data. Although these models are powerful for structure prediction, it remains unclear whether the conformational ensembles they learn resemble physically meaningful statistical ensembles. To understand what these models learn, we introduce transition path sampling (TPS), which uses Markov chain Monte Carlo over denoising trajectories to sample the learned distribution. Because its Monte Carlo trajectories resemble biomolecular dynamics, TPS couples directly with enhanced-sampling techniques to recover the full conformational ensemble. Applied to Boltz-2, enhanced TPS reveals physical conformational changes biased toward crystal-like states near the training data, indicating both learned physics and memorization. These results suggest new ways to evaluate and improve co-folding models by jointly assessing structural recovery, proximity to training data, and conformational ensembles.

AI.tldr: 提出用过渡路径采样（TPS）刻画共折叠扩散模型所学构象分布，并在 Boltz-2 上发现其兼具学习到的物理性与对训练数据的记忆。
AI.motivation: 共折叠模型虽能预测生物分子复合物结构，但其学习到的构象集合是否对应物理上有意义的统计系综尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在去噪轨迹上执行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的 TPS，以采样模型学习分布；利用其轨迹类似生物分子动力学的特点，与增强采样结合恢复完整构象系综，并应用于 Boltz-2。
AI.result: 增强 TPS 揭示出物理性构象变化，但偏向训练数据附近的类晶体状态，表明模型同时学到物理规律并存在记忆化。
AI.conclusion: 应联合评估结构恢复、与训练数据接近程度及构象系综，以评价和改进共折叠模型。

title: Real-time optimization with online learning for pressure swing adsorption
summary: Real-time optimization (RTO) of pressure swing adsorption (PSA) units requires a process model that can be evaluated many times at each decision, which favours data-driven surrogates of the cyclic steady state. A surrogate, however, represents the plant only under the conditions covered by its training data, and disturbances that are not among its inputs remain outside its description. This work presents an RTO framework for PSA in which a neural network surrogate, optimized by particle swarm, is updated online with data generated at the plant when plant and model diverge. A rigorous dynamic model of a CH$_4$/CO$_2$ separation, integrated to cyclic steady state, served as virtual plant in three scenarios. In the first, five consecutive RTO events with different objectives ran without disturbance; all constraints were satisfied and the largest deviation between surrogate and plant was 1.7 percentage points. In the second, a step in the CO$_2$ feed fraction from 0.40 to 0.50 reduced the CH$_4$ purity at the operating point in force from 92.3 to 76.9%; after the network was fine-tuned on 43 local samples, the new RTO event returned a feasible optimum with a purity of 90.3%. In the third, a progressive loss of sorbent capacity was detected by the accumulated relative deviation of the CH$_4$ purity from a reference, triggering retraining before any constraint violation. Samples generated across the remaining activity range led to infeasible operation, whereas samples generated at the final activity kept the purity above 92.4% after the move transient.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种用于变压吸附（PSA）实时优化（RTO）的框架：以神经网络代理模型结合粒子群优化，并在装置与模型出现偏差时利用现场数据在线更新代理模型，从而应对未建模扰动和吸附剂性能退化。
AI.motivation: PSA的RTO需要在每次决策中多次评估循环稳态模型，动态机理模型计算代价高，因此适合采用数据驱动代理模型；但代理模型仅在其训练数据覆盖范围内有效，无法描述未作为输入引入的扰动。
AI.method: 构建神经网络代理模型并用粒子群算法优化，在装置与模型不一致时用现场生成的数据在线微调/再训练；以CH4/CO2分离的严格动态模型积分至循环稳态作为虚拟装置，设置无扰动、CO2进料分数阶跃、吸附剂容量渐进损失三个场景验证。
AI.result: 无扰动下连续5次不同目标RTO均满足约束，代理与装置最大偏差1.7个百分点；CO2进料分数由0.40升至0.50使CH4纯度由92.3%降至76.9%，用43个局部样本微调后新RTO获得可行最优纯度90.3%；吸附剂容量渐进损失可通过CH4纯度相对参考的累积偏差检测并在违约前触发再训练，最终活性下采样可使移动 transient 后纯度保持92.4%以上，而跨剩余活性范围采样会导致不可行运行。
AI.conclusion: 在线更新神经网络代理模型可提升PSA实时优化对扰动和吸附剂退化的适应性，但训练样本的生成策略对再训练后的可行性和约束满足至关重要。

title: Analytic nuclear gradients for electronic resonances with the equation-of-motion coupled-cluster method and complex basis functions
summary: We present the general theory for and an efficient implementation of the analytic nuclear gradient for states which are metastable with respect to electronic decay within the equation-of-motion coupled-cluster singles-and-doubles family of methods using complex-scaled basis functions. We highlight the differences of our approach with the complex-absorbing potential method and outline a computational protocol for geometry optimisations and we use the method to compute equilibrium structures and harmonic vibrational frequencies of a number of temporary anion shape resonances and core-ionised Feshbach resonances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并高效实现了基于复标度基函数的EOM-CCSD解析核梯度方法，用于处理对电子衰变亚稳的共振态，并用于几何优化与振动频率计算。
AI.motivation: 电子衰变亚稳态（如形状共振和Feshbach共振）的几何结构与振动性质表征需要可靠的解析核梯度；同时需厘清该方法与复吸收势（CAP）方法的差异。
AI.method: 在EOM-CCSD（单双激发）框架下，采用复标度基函数建立亚稳电子态解析核梯度的一般理论并给出高效实现；讨论其与CAP方法的区别，并提出用于几何优化的计算流程。
AI.result: 利用该方法计算了一系列临时负离子形状共振和核心电离Feshbach共振的平衡结构及谐波振动频率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使EOM-CCSD复标度方法能够高效开展亚稳共振态的几何优化和振动分析，为电子衰变共振态的结构表征提供了实用工具。

title: Quantifying Errors in Chemical Kinetics
summary: The physical structure of kinetic measurements determines the correct statistical framework for quantifying their uncertainties, yet this framework has never been explicitly derived or systematically applied in the chemical kinetics literature. Here, we derive a forward model for kinetic observations from a minimal set of stated assumptions about the measurement process, and identify the correct statistical treatment for each kinetic parameter as an explicit consequence of that model. We then audit the literature pertaining to a well-studied reaction, examining the kinetics of permanganate oxidation, to establish the scale of deviation from the correct framework. We find that of 330 measurements, 35.8% carry no uncertainty quantification of any kind and none are accompanied by a full propagation of all uncertainties. To demonstrate the practical consequences of departing from the correct framework, we reanalyse a representative kinetic dataset, first checking whether the data are consistent with the forward model and then applying the correct procedures. We find that the impacts are modest for the dataset examined, as expected for quantities determined in a low-uncertainty regime, but that uncertainties in activation energy are systematically underestimated when observed rather than assumed measurement precision is used as the basis for regression weights. We highlight that these consequences become substantially more significant at the limits of current experimental methodologies, where measurement uncertainty is large and the correct distributional treatment can no longer be approximated by standard approaches. Based on this, we propose a set of minimum recommendations for error reporting in chemical kinetics that follow directly from our forward model.

AI.tldr: 该文从测量过程的最小假设推导动力学观测的前向模型，明确各动力学参数的正确统计处理，并据此审计文献与重分析数据，提出化学动力学误差报告的最低建议。
AI.motivation: 动力学测量的物理结构决定其不确定度量化应采用的统计框架，但该框架此前未被显式推导或在化学动力学文献中系统应用，导致误差报告与传播不规范。
AI.method: 作者从一组明确假设出发推导动力学观测的前向模型，并将每个动力学参数的正确统计处理作为该模型的直接推论；随后审计高锰酸盐氧化这一研究充分的反应动力学文献，检查330个测量；并选取代表性动力学数据集，先检验数据与前向模型的一致性，再应用正确流程重分析。
AI.result: 330个测量中35.8%完全未给出不确定度量化，且没有一个伴随所有不确定度的完整传播；代表性数据集重分析显示影响在低不确定度情形下较温和，但若以观测而非假设的测量精度作为回归权重，活化能不确定度会被系统性低估；在当前实验方法极限、测量不确定度较大且正确分布处理无法用标准方法近似时，后果会显著放大。
AI.conclusion: 偏离正确统计框架会造成不确定度报告与传播缺陷，尤其在测量不确定度较大时更严重；作者据此提出一组直接源于前向模型的化学动力学误差报告最低推荐规范。

title: Expressive Shallow Networks for Physics-Informed Learning: Why Curvature-Aware Optimization and FP64 Are Not Enough
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often struggle with high-frequency and high-order partial differential equations (PDEs) due to optimization stiffness and spectral bias, despite possessing sufficient approximation capacity. Existing remedies, including modified feature representations, domain decomposition, higher floating-point precision, and curvature-aware optimizers, can improve convergence but largely act as workarounds for optimization difficulties arising from deep architectures rather than addressing their underlying source. We investigate Physics-Informed Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks (PI-SUPNs), which replace deep nonlinear compositions with learnable polynomial expansions, retaining high approximation capacity within a shallow computational graph. On a high-frequency Helmholtz benchmark, PI-SUPNs are the only architecture to successfully recover the solution, while all competing models fail even under FP64 precision and curvature-aware optimization. However, experiments on higher vibrational modes of a fourth-order Euler-Bernoulli beam reveal that architectural improvements alone are insufficient: accurate solutions require the combination of PI-SUPNs, FP64 precision, and curvature-aware optimization. Additionally, Allen-Cahn experiments show that PI-SUPNs achieve lower solution and derivative errors at reduced computational cost, with more favorable loss landscapes than competing architectures. We also establish quasi-local approximation properties and spline-based convergence bounds for SUPNs. Our results show that shallow network architectures are an important mechanism for improving physics-informed trainability, but accurate solutions to the most challenging PDEs can still require FP64 precision and curvature-aware optimization.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 PI-SUPN：用可学习多项式展开替代深层非线性复合，以浅层计算图提升物理信息网络的可训练性；但最困难 PDE 仍需结合 FP64 与曲率感知优化。
AI.motivation: PINN 对高频、高阶 PDE 常因优化刚性和谱偏置而难以收敛，现有特征表示、域分解、高精度和曲率感知优化等多属对深层架构优化困难的规避，而非解决其根源。
AI.method: 研究 Physics-Informed Shallow Universal Polynomial Networks（PI-SUPNs），以浅层网络中的可学习多项式展开保留高逼近能力；在高频 Helmholtz、四阶 Euler-Bernoulli 梁高阶振动模态和 Allen-Cahn 问题上与竞争架构比较，并给出 SUPN 的准局部逼近性质和基于样条的收敛界。
AI.result: PI-SUPN 是唯一成功恢复高频 Helmholtz 解的架构，竞争模型即使在 FP64 和曲率感知优化下仍失败；Euler-Bernoulli 高阶模态需 PI-SUPN、FP64 与曲率感知优化三者结合；Allen-Cahn 中 PI-SUPN 以更低计算成本获得更低的解与导数误差，并具有更有利的损失景观。
AI.conclusion: 浅层网络架构是提升物理信息可训练性的重要机制，但对最具挑战性的 PDE，准确求解仍可能需要 FP64 精度与曲率感知优化相结合。

title: Kinetic versus refill-zone uncertainty in predicted pr--burning of methane-oxygen rotating detonation rocket engines
summary: Rotating detonation rocket engines can lose performance when fresh propellant mixes with hot recirculated combustion products and ignites before the detonation wave arrives. Predicting this pre-burning requires fuel ignition chemistry at high pressure and in product-diluted mixtures, conditions most chemical kinetic mechanisms used in engine simulations were not developed for. With methane as our base fuel, we quantify how strongly predicted pre-burning depends on the choice of mechanism, test the mechanisms against published high-pressure ignition data, and use Bayesian methods to calibrate the most influential uncertain reaction and to assess which measurements would best improve the predictions. As the refill zone is represented by an idealized zero-dimensional model, our results should be viewed as relative comparisons rather than direct engine predictions. Five existing chemical kinetics mechanisms for methane combustion predict refill-zone ignition delays that differ by up to a factor of twenty. Mechanisms without methylperoxy chemistry, including two commonly used in engine simulations, do not reproduce the laboratory data below about 1150 K. Calibrating the CH${_3}$ + HO${_2}$ reaction against these data, while allowing for systematic differences between datasets, increases the relative importance of its chain-terminating channel, consistent with a direct rate measurement. With the data-consistent mechanisms, the remaining kinetic uncertainty in the predicted pre-burnt fraction is, in most cases, several times smaller than the uncertainty arising from the state of the refill zone: the temperature and composition of the recirculated products and the way fresh and burnt gases mix. Improved pre-burning predictions are therefore expected to depend mainly on accurately characterizing the refill zone.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化旋转爆轰火箭发动机回填区预燃对甲烷化学反应机理选择的敏感性，并用高压点火数据校验和贝叶斯校准关键反应；结果表明，数据一致机理下剩余动力学不确定性通常小于回填区状态与混合不确定性。
AI.motivation: 新鲜推进剂与高温回流燃烧产物混合后可能在爆轰波到达前自燃，造成性能损失；预测预燃需要高压、产物稀释条件下的燃料点火化学，而发动机模拟常用机理未必适用于这些条件。
AI.method: 采用理想化零维回填区模型，比较五种甲烷燃烧机理预测的点火延迟；用已发表高压点火数据检验机理；用贝叶斯方法校准影响最大的不确定反应CH3+HO2，并允许数据集间系统偏差，同时评估哪些测量最能改进预测。
AI.result: 五种机理预测的回填区点火延迟最多相差20倍；不含甲基过氧化学的机理（包括两种常用发动机模拟机理）在约1150 K以下不能复现实验数据；校准CH3+HO2后其链终止通道相对重要性增加，与直接速率测量一致；采用数据一致机理时，预测预燃分数的剩余动力学不确定性在多数情况下比回填区状态不确定性小数倍，后者包括回流产物温度、组成及新鲜/燃烧气体混合方式。
AI.conclusion: 改善预燃预测主要取决于更准确表征回填区状态和混合过程；由于使用理想化零维模型，结果应视为相对比较而非直接发动机预测。

title: Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
summary: Conventional machine-learning electronic Hamiltonian (MLEH) models rely on a local-environment approximation and can miss the effects of long-range (LR) interactions and external fields. Here, we introduce MLEH-LR, a framework that incorporates these effects into Hamiltonian prediction. Benchmarks across materials with different polarizations and dimensionalities demonstrate substantial improvements in the accuracy of the predicted Hamiltonians and resulting electronic structures. MLEH-LR enables accurate, large-scale, high-throughput electronic-structure calculations, as demonstrated for zigzag boron nitride ribbons under transverse electric fields. These calculations allow us to formulate a quantitative relation describing the joint width and field dependence of the band gap and to reveal the electronic mechanisms underlying its field response. Our work provides an efficient method and tool for studying electronic structure in materials where long-range electrostatics and external fields play an important role.

AI.tldr: 提出MLEH-LR框架，将长程相互作用和外场效应引入机器学习电子哈密顿量预测，显著提升预测精度并实现大规模高通量电子结构计算。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习电子哈密顿量模型采用局域环境近似，忽略长程相互作用和外部场，导致对极化材料、低维体系及外场下电子结构的描述不准确。
AI.method: 在机器学习电子哈密顿量预测中显式纳入长程静电相互作用和外加电场效应，构建MLEH-LR框架，并在不同极化和维度材料上基准测试；进一步用于横向电场下锯齿型氮化硼纳米带计算。
AI.result: MLEH-LR显著提高预测哈密顿量及衍生电子结构的精度，支持大规模高通量计算；对锯齿型BN纳米带，获得带隙随宽度和电场联合变化的定量关系，并揭示其电场响应的电子机制。
AI.conclusion: MLEH-LR为研究长程静电和外场主导的电子结构提供高效方法与工具。

title: Accelerating wave-scattering simulations with learned search directions
summary: Wave-scattering simulation requires solving a dense boundary-element system for every frequency, incidence and design. Krylov solvers build each search space from scratch, and it grows with problem size. Here we present BEMFormer, a solver that learns to generate search directions across systems of one integral equation and supplies geometry-specific directions through a coarse-grid correction. BEMFormer generalizes to unseen geometries, meshes and excitations, and to acoustic scattering after fine-tuning on eight geometries. It reproduces the measured radar cross-sections of benchmark targets. On a quadcopter with 1.04 million unknowns, 38 times the largest training problem, BEMFormer solves each system 30 times faster than a preconditioned Krylov solver. Both reach a radar cross-section deviation of about 1 dB, comparable to the difference between independent measurements and acceptable for engineering applications. These results show that solving million-unknown scattering problems in minutes is possible when the search space is learned rather than built from scratch.

AI.tldr: BEMFormer 通过学习生成积分方程系统的搜索方向，并利用粗网格校正提供几何特定方向，从而显著加速大规模波散射边界元求解。
AI.motivation: 波散射仿真需对每个频率、入射角和设计求解稠密边界元系统；Krylov 求解器每次从零构建搜索空间，且搜索空间随问题规模增长，导致大规模问题求解昂贵。
AI.method: 提出 BEMFormer：在同一积分方程的不同系统间学习生成搜索方向，并通过粗网格校正注入几何特定信息；模型可泛化到未见几何、网格和激励，经八个几何微调后也可用于声散射。
AI.result: 在基准目标上复现实测雷达散射截面；在 104 万未知量的四旋翼问题上（为最大训练问题的 38 倍），每个系统求解比预条件 Krylov 求解器快 30 倍，两者 RCS 偏差均约 1 dB，与独立测量差异相当，满足工程应用。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将搜索空间学习而非从零构建，可在数分钟内求解百万未知量级散射问题，为大规模波散射仿真提供高效路径。

title: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
summary: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. Numerical predictions are validated against analytical solutions and established BTE solvers across diffusive-to-ballistic regimes. Applications to complex three-dimensional geometries are demonstrated using single-fin, double-fin, and arrayed fin field-effect transistor (FinFET) configurations. Gradient-based inverse learning enables single- and multi-parameter identification, including simultaneous recovery of mode-resolved phonon relaxation times and spatially distributed heat-generation rates in steady-state and transient problems. GPU performance and scalability are evaluated with respect to spatial resolution, angular discretization, and phonon bands, including comparisons with an MPI-based BTE solver. JAX-Nano provides a unified computational framework for three-dimensional phonon transport, automatic differentiation, and inverse parameter identification, enabling sensitivity analysis and optimization of nanoscale thermal systems.

AI.tldr: JAX-Nano 是一个 GPU 加速、端到端可微的声子玻尔兹曼输运方程求解器，用于纳米尺度稳态与瞬态热输运，并支持梯度反演与参数辨识。
AI.motivation: 半导体器件尺寸接近声子平均自由程时，热输运进入弹道/准弹道区，傅里叶定律失效；声子 BTE 可描述非平衡效应但计算挑战大，亟需高效且可微的求解框架。
AI.method: 在统一有限体积框架内集成稳态与瞬态 BTE，支持结构/非结构网格、模式分辨输运、声子散射、体热源和多类边界条件；利用自动微分直接计算对输运属性、边界条件、热源率和几何参数的梯度，无需推导伴随方程；与解析解和已有 BTE 求解器在扩散到弹道区验证，并用于单鳍、双鳍和阵列 FinFET 三维几何；开展单/多参数反演学习及 GPU 性能与可扩展性评估，并与 MPI-BTE 求解器比较。
AI.result: 数值预测在扩散—弹道区与解析解和既有求解器一致；可处理复杂三维 FinFET 构型；梯度反演可同时恢复模式分辨声子弛豫时间和空间分布热源率等单/多参数；评估了空间分辨率、角度离散和声子带对 GPU 性能与可扩展性的影响，并与 MPI 求解器比较。
AI.conclusion: JAX-Nano 为三维声子输运、自动微分和逆参数辨识提供统一计算框架，可用于纳米尺度热系统的灵敏度分析与优化。

title: Digital Models of Widely-Used Powder Characterisation Tools and their Application in DEM Calibration Part III: Packing and Flow Testers
summary: Accurate calibration remains a critical challenge in the field of discrete element method (DEM) simulations. To work towards more standardised and rigorous methods, this research contributes to a growing open-source library of digital models that faithfully replicate powder characterisation instruments. This paper expands that library by developing and validating digital models for two widely used instruments: the GranuFlow flow through an orifice tester and the GranuPack tapped density analyser. These models are designed to replicate the experimental instruments while incorporating computational optimisations to improve efficiency without compromising on accuracy. An example application of the digital models is shown through a calibration case study for two example materials: micro-crystalline cellulose (MCC) and ion exchange resin. The calibrated models show strong agreement with experimental data through cross-validation, yielding a relative percentage error of 0.57\% for the Hausner ratio (the ion exchange resin) and 4.17\% for a Beverloo fitting parameter (MCC). The addition of these validated, open-source models provides the DEM community with further models for more robust, multi-instrument calibration, and potential for more insight into bulk behaviours under different conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文开发并验证了GranuFlow孔口流动测试仪与GranuPack振实密度分析仪的DEM数字模型，并将其用于MCC和离子交换树脂的校准案例。
AI.motivation: DEM模拟中的准确校准仍是关键挑战，领域需要更标准化、严谨的方法以及可复现的开源数字模型库，以支持多仪器校准。
AI.method: 扩展开源数字模型库，构建两个常用粉体表征仪器的数字化模型；在复现实验仪器的同时加入计算优化以提升效率并保持精度；以微晶纤维素（MCC）和离子交换树脂为例开展校准与交叉验证。
AI.result: 校准模型与实验数据吻合良好：离子交换树脂的Hausner比相对百分比误差为0.57%，MCC的Beverloo拟合参数相对百分比误差为4.17%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的经验证开源DEM模型为社区提供了更多多仪器校准工具，有助于提升校准稳健性并深入理解不同条件下的粉体 bulk 行为。

title: A shock-fitting approach to high-order simulation of viscous hypersonic flows based on inviscid implicit shock tracking
summary: This work presents a framework for computing viscous, shock-dominated flows at high Mach and Reynolds numbers in which the bow shock is located by inviscid implicit shock tracking and then treated as a boundary of the viscous computation. The high-order implicit shock tracking (HOIST) method is applied to the Euler equations on a coarse, shock-agnostic mesh to produce a shock-aligned mesh and the shock geometry; the elements upstream of the shock are discarded, the post-shock domain is remeshed to resolve the boundary layer, and the compressible Navier-Stokes equations are solved on it with a high-order interior penalty discontinuous Galerkin method, with the post-shock state prescribed along the shock boundary by the oblique shock relations. Because the shock structure is never resolved, the approach requires neither the extreme element compression nor the specialized formulations that fully coupled viscous shock tracking demands at these conditions; the tracking optimization is confined to the coarse inviscid mesh, and the viscous computation involves no mesh unknowns and no additional nonlinear stabilization. The framework is demonstrated on a Mach 10.6 axisymmetric blunt cone, a Mach 17.6 cylinder, and a Mach 5 sphere in three dimensions, with surface pressure and heat flux in good agreement with experimental measurements and reference computations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将无粘隐式激波追踪与粘性Navier-Stokes计算解耦的框架，用于高马赫数、高雷诺数黏性激波主导流动，并在三维高超声速算例中验证了表面压力与热流预测精度。
AI.motivation: 高马赫数、高雷诺数黏性流动中弓形激波与边界层同时存在，完全耦合的黏性激波追踪需要极端网格压缩和专门公式，计算复杂且鲁棒性差；作者希望避免直接解析激波结构并简化黏性激波计算。
AI.method: 先用高阶隐式激波追踪（HOIST）在粗网格上求解Euler方程，获得激波对齐网格和激波几何；丢弃激波上游单元，对激波后区域重新划分网格以解析边界层；再用高阶内罚间断Galerkin法求解可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，并以斜激波关系在激波边界上施加波后状态。
AI.result: 在Mach 10.6轴对称钝锥、Mach 17.6圆柱和Mach 5球体三个三维算例中，计算得到的表面压力和热流与实验测量及参考计算吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦框架无需解析激波结构，避免了完全耦合黏性激波追踪所需的极端单元压缩和专门稳定化公式；激波追踪优化仅限于粗无粘网格，黏性计算不含网格未知量，能够准确模拟高马赫数黏性激波主导流动。

title: Coarse-Grained Description of Stochastic Neutron Transport in Highly Heterogeneous Reactor Media via Non-Local Feller Boundary Functionals
summary: This paper presents a novel hierarchical coarse-graining framework to model non-Markovian neutron transport within the ultra-heterogeneous, multi-phase subcooled nucleate boiling layer of a nuclear reactor core. By applying Feller's subordination theory to continuous-time random walks, microscopic fluid fluctuations and vapor bubble dynamics are rigorously integrated into macroscopic transport operators through the apparatus of Complete Bernstein Functions (CBF). A modified non-local Fick's law is derived using a $P_1$-Legendre polynomial expansion, mapping the fractal porosity and structural phase boundaries into a stochastically renormalized effective diffusion coefficient. The thermodynamic consistency of the model is grounded within Chentsov's statistical manifolds, demonstrating that granular Poisson-like shot noise yields a geometric-exponential family of distributions characterized by a constant negative information curvature. To evaluate operational safety margins under transient conditions, a generalized Lyapunov functional with a quadratic memory kernel is constructed, and a complex decomposition of the transfer function $H(\omega)$ is performed. The resulting analytical limits are parameterized for a WWER-1000 core layout and translated into an engineering computational sequence suitable for implementation in Mathcad Prime 8 to diagnose the onset of Hopf bifurcations and spatial power oscillations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层粗粒化框架，用于建模反应堆堆芯超异构多相过冷核沸腾层中的非马尔可夫中子输运。
AI.motivation: 在瞬态工况下评估运行安全裕度，并诊断Hopf分岔与空间功率振荡的起始。
AI.method: 将Feller从属理论应用于连续时间随机游走，利用完全Bernstein函数把微观流体涨落和气泡动力学严格融入宏观输运算子；通过P1-Legendre多项式展开推导修正非局域Fick定律，将分形孔隙率和相界面映射为随机重正化有效扩散系数；用Chentsov统计流形保证热力学一致性，说明颗粒型Poisson散粒噪声产生常负信息曲率的几何指数族分布；构造带二次记忆核的广义Lyapunov泛函，并对传递函数H(ω)进行复分解。
AI.result: 得到可解析的安全裕度极限，并针对WWER-1000堆芯布置参数化，转化为可在Mathcad Prime 8中实现的工程计算流程，用于诊断Hopf分岔和空间功率振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将沸腾层微观非马尔可夫动力学与宏观中子输运及安全分析相连接，兼具热力学一致性和工程可计算性，适用于WWER-1000瞬态安全评估。

title: Topological analysis of permeability tensor in anisotropic porous media
summary: The permeability of an anisotropic porous medium is a tensor whose off-diagonal components, which describe the deflection of the macroscopic flux away from the driving force, are small and change sign under reflections. We ask whether direction-aware topological data analysis can predict the full permeability tensor of three-dimensional porous media directly from their geometry. We introduce two direction-aware topological descriptors for flow problems: a cone-based filtration, adapted from our earlier work on the elastic stiffness tensor, and a throat-scale filtration built on the distance transform of the pore space. Using permeability tensors computed with the lattice Boltzmann method, we compare them with a comprehensive set of non-topological baselines, comprising statistical microstructure descriptors and physics-based permeability estimators. The topological descriptors are most informative for the off-diagonal components, which the baselines capture least well. There the throat-scale filtration alone outperforms every non-topological descriptor set, including the union of all statistical descriptors and physics-based estimators, and adding it to the baselines consistently improves the prediction. We also confirm the approach on real rock data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出方向感知的拓扑数据分析方法，直接从三维多孔介质几何预测完整渗透率张量，并重点验证其对非对角分量的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 各向异性多孔介质的渗透率是张量，其非对角分量描述宏观通量相对驱动力的偏转，数值小且会在反射下变号；现有统计微结构描述符和物理估计器对这类分量捕捉较差，因此需要能感知方向并直接由几何预测全张量的方法。
AI.method: 引入两种面向流动问题的方向感知拓扑描述符：一是由弹性刚度张量工作迁移而来的锥形过滤；二是基于孔空间距离变换的喉道尺度过滤。使用格子Boltzmann方法计算渗透率张量，并与统计微结构描述符、物理渗透率估计器等非拓扑基线比较，包括其并集。
AI.result: 拓扑描述符对非对角分量最具信息量；仅喉道尺度过滤即优于所有非拓扑描述符集合（包括统计描述符与物理估计器的并集），且将其加入基线可稳定提升预测。方法在真实岩石数据上也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 方向感知拓扑数据分析能够有效补充现有微结构统计和物理估计方法，尤其改善各向异性多孔介质渗透率张量中非对角分量的预测，并具备在真实岩石上应用的潜力。

title: Cyclic changes of frame for designing non-retracing verification cases for numerical interface tracking
summary: A forward-backward deformation test supplies an exact final interface, but retracing can allow errors from the two halves to cancel. We construct alternative tests by superposing a cyclic change of frame on the same base deformation. The frame returns to its starting pose, preserving the exact final phase and the deformation history up to rigid placement. A small returning translation can keep trajectories close to the retraced ones. A full rotation about a fixed centre or axis gives closed paths with nonzero winding for material labels that stay off that centre or axis. For incompressible base fields the transformed velocity is divergence-free. We construct discretely solenoidal face fluxes for geometric volume-of-fluid advection by circulating the transformed potential. In three TwoPhaseFlow benchmarks, with a shared time grid for each pair, a full-turn frame increased the final cell-average shape discrepancy in all 30 comparisons, with a median factor of 1.50. The fitted convergence exponent decreased in each of the six benchmark-reconstruction comparisons over the tested grids.

AI.tldr: 提出在正反向变形测试上叠加循环坐标系变换的界面输运测试，以避免回撤误差抵消；全周旋转产生非零缠绕闭环，并在TwoPhaseFlow基准中导致更大的形状误差和更低的收敛阶。
AI.motivation: 正反向变形测试虽能给出精确终态界面，但回撤过程可能使两半误差相互抵消，掩盖数值格式缺陷；需要保留精确终态且避免误差抵消的替代测试。
AI.method: 在同一基础变形上叠加返回原位的循环坐标系变换：小返回平移使轨迹接近回撤轨迹，绕固定中心或轴整周旋转使偏离中心或轴的材料标签形成非零缠绕闭环；对不可压基流变换后速度仍无散，通过循环变换势构造离散无散面通量用于几何VOF平流。
AI.result: 在三个TwoPhaseFlow基准中，每对使用共享时间网格：整周坐标系变换在全部30组比较中增大最终单元平均形状偏差，中位倍数为1.50；六组基准重构比较中拟合收敛指数均下降。
AI.conclusion: 循环坐标系变换测试可避免正反向回撤的误差抵消，是更严格的界面平流评估方法；整周旋转显著放大形状误差并降低收敛阶，适用于检验几何VOF等格式的鲁棒性与收敛性。

title: Mass-conservative and phase-consistent transport of phase-confined scalars in front tracking
summary: In front-tracking multiphase-flow simulations, the Lagrangian front defines the interface geometry and phase regions, while phase-confined scalars are transported independently on a fixed Eulerian mesh. This separation can make the scalar inconsistent with the tracked interface: even a conservative high-order scheme smears the scalar across the interface, leaks it into the other phase and distorts near-interface concentrations despite conserving total mass. We present a transport method that maintains consistency between the scalar and the tracked front while preserving global mass conservation. Instead of the cell-averaged concentration, the method transports the phase-averaged concentration, which is smooth across the interface. This concentration is obtained by dividing the cell-averaged concentration by the phase fraction, extended linearly across the interface and advected. The cell-averaged concentration is rebuilt by multiplying the transported concentration by the front's volume-preserving phase fraction. Because this rebuild can alter the total mass, a uniform shift of the phase-averaged concentration restores it. The method is compared with direct transport of the cell-averaged concentration by the same scheme in five three-dimensional cases: three drops (in translation, in a reversible vortex and with a localized source) and a rising bubble with and without dissolved surfactant. In the four cases without surfactant it reduces the error against the exact solution by more than a factor of ten at the finest resolution and converges faster for the drops. In the surfactant-laden bubble, direct transport leaks 5.5-24% of the surfactant into the wake, depending on resolution, whereas the proposed method keeps it in the bubble.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在front-tracking多相流中保持标量与界面一致且全局质量守恒的输运方法。
AI.motivation: Lagrangian前沿定义界面与相区，而相内标量在固定Eulerian网格上独立输运，导致标量与界面不一致：即使守恒高阶格式也会跨界面涂抹、泄漏到另一相并扭曲界面附近浓度。
AI.method: 输运跨界面光滑的相平均浓度：由单元平均浓度除以相分数得到，跨界面线性延拓后平流；再用前沿的体积守恒相分数乘回重建单元平均浓度；若重建改变总质量，则对相平均浓度施加均匀平移以恢复总质量。
AI.result: 在五个三维算例中与同一格式直接输运单元平均浓度比较：三个液滴（平移、可逆涡、局部源）和无/有溶解表面活性剂的上升气泡。无表面活性剂的四个算例在最细分辨率下误差降低超过10倍，液滴算例收敛更快；含表面活性剂气泡中直接输运将5.5–24%表面活性剂泄漏到尾迹（随分辨率变化），而本方法将其保留在气泡内。
AI.conclusion: 该方法保持标量与跟踪前沿一致并维持全局质量守恒，显著提高精度并防止相间泄漏。
